notes.title: PixARK Patch 1.215 Summer's Day!
notes.content:
[p]As the sun blazes high and the days grow longer, we’re excited to bring back our summer events!  This update is all about embracing the joys of summer with a wave of exciting new content, sizzling adventures, and refreshing changes that will make your gaming experience even more enjoyable. Let’s dive into the highlights of this sun-soaked update!  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/24cee6d262355c0517d03e52f58caab05d2ac91c.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Holiday Dodo is BACK![/b][/h3][p]Players can obtain Casual Beachwear/Crab Beachwear/Beach Lounger upon defeating Holiday Dodos at:  Pixark：Novice Grassland/Grassland Skyward：Dawn Island/Woodland [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Summer Sports event back![/b] [/h3][p]This update is packed with exciting content, vibrant summer events, and thrilling sports challenges designed to keep the heat of competition alive. Whether you’re diving into intense sports events, participating in friendly matches, or enjoying the seasonal festivities, there’s something for everyone to enjoy.   [/p][p][/p][p][b]Items：[/b]
Javelin：
-	Primitive Skill, learned at lv6, crafted by hand.
-	Throwing a javelin at a training dummy at a distance will send you a report to your inventory containing results.
-	Medals will be rewarded based on the results: alongside medals as rewards based on the results:
20-50m: Bronze
50-80m: Silver
80-104.8m: Gold
Results beyond 104.8m will be invalid.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/fa455b0ccc946d2bcc8c91f0775839303fc86377.png"][/img]Roadblock Cone:
-  Can be exchanged at Summer Sports Goblin Trading Center with 2 silver medals

Hurdle ：
-  Can be exchanged at Summer Sports Goblin Trading Center with 2 silver medals
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/1671cf147f451a0dede04f04bd8df064eb024356.png"][/img][/p][p]Track Suits：
-  Can be exchanged at Summer Sports Goblin Trading Center:
Head/Hands: 4 silver medals
Top: 6 silver medals & 2 gold medals
Bottom/Shoes: 5 silver medals & 1 gold medal
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/946f35c43509e921978ed4708933579150ee5b69.jpg"][/img][b]Old Events Are Back![/b]
-Boxing Match
Even the creatures are eager for a match during this blazing summer! Explorers can make Boxing Gloves through recipes (lv6) to challenge creatures wearing boxing gloves, which will drop different medals. 
-Gold Medal Challenge: Boxling Cyclops
-Silver Medal Challenge: Boxing Giant Claw Mole
-Bronze Medal Challenge: Boxing Kairuku

Explorers can use the metals they obtain to exchange items at the Summer Sports Goblin Trading Center.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/97ecdd6851960d556ae5c5e3249fcc8cb7da7d44.gif"][/img] Summer Trophy Hat
Explorers will have a chance obtaining a Summer Trophy Hat for their tamed creatures by defeating wild creatures wearing the hat. 
- 20% chance of looting the hat, and 80% chance of looting a bronze medal.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/70455fe0f27a17d2a8cb244dfbf512ee22383514.jpg"][/img]Boxing Cyclops
Spawn Area：Doomlands，Black Rock Mountain，Frozen Land，Crystal Island
Upon defeating it with Boxing Gloves, players will have:
30% chance of obtaining 1 gold medal
70% chance of obtaining 2-5 silver medals

Boxing Giant Claw Mole
Spawn Area：Grassland，Woodland，Desert，Twilight Forest

Upon defeating it with Boxing Gloves, players will have:
30% chance of obtaining 2 silver medals
70% chance of obtaining 2-5 bronze medals

Boxing Kairuku
Spawn Area：Novice Grassland, Grassland, Dawn Island and Woodland. 
Upon defeating it with Boxing Gloves, players will have:
100% chance of obtaining 1-3 bronze medals


Summer Sports Goblin Trading Center
-Can be obtained through looting goblins, the goblin king, or in supply drops.
- Can be used to convert medals and exchange items:
  10 bronze medals to 1 silver medal;
  12 silver medals to 1 gold medal;
  1 gold medal to 8 silver medals;
  1 silver medal to 6 bronze medals.
Sports Uniform (Male/Female)
- Can be exchanged at Summer Sports Goblin Trading Center with silver medals:
Head/Hands: 2 silver medals
Top: 6 silver medals
Bottom/Shoes: 5 silver medals
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/8977ed14d10767040d01ca47e5811b40e54ef130.jpg"][/img]Synthetic race tracks
- Use your imagination to create your very own race tracks! Hurry up! Call your friends and let’s race!
- Can be exchanged at Summer Sports Goblin Trading Center with medals
       -Straight track (can switch into 3 different forms with “Q” button): 2 bronze medals
       -Curve track (can switch into 5 different forms with “Q” button): 2 bronze medals
       -Numbered track (can switch into 5 different forms with “Q” button): 1 silver medal
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/f454f7601a30df4863e92d1378d197df5e4dec23.jpg"][/img]Starter Stand/Race Clock/Finish Line
-Race clock will start when a player activates the Starter Stand within 50 meters.
-Race clock will stop when a player crosses the Finish Line.
-Race clock can show the top three players of a single game.
-Race clock can be set to 100/200/400/800 meter race types.
- For each type of race, you can record a best score, record the player name and race results
-Can be exchanged at Summer Sports Goblin Trading Center with gold medals:
-Starter Stand: 2 gold medals
-Race Clock: 4 gold medals
-Finish Line: 4 gold medals
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/1e5bf36fa1e278fedc454cdfe371c9c1e5652b23.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/f8eb9dff42987a74d2c94a8a97328923899456f9.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/266b1cadba57cb4e96ef0e79f29232a00a36318f.gif"][/img][/p][p]Gold/Silver/Bronze Medal (cosmetic)
-Upon using the item, it will display the medal in front of the character's chest for 2 hours.
-Can be exchanged at Summer Sports Goblin Trading Center with medals: 
            Gold medal(cosmetic): 2 gold medals
            Silver medal (cosmetic): 1 gold medal
            Bronze medal (cosmetic): 1 silver medal

Podium
-Can be exchanged at Summer Sports Goblin Trading Center with 2 gold medals.

Torch
-Can be exchanged at Summer Sports Goblin Trading Center with 1 gold medal.

[/p]

notes.title: PixARK 1.213 7th Anniversary Update
notes.content:
Dear Explorers,
The moment has come.
To celebrate seven years of exploration, creation, and survival—we’re ushering in a powerful new force from the depths of the elemental wilds: Artikel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/e0143dce600ac9a5a4f3c663c928d86c5941636b.jpg[/img]

Now roaming the lands of PixARK, Artikel is no ordinary beast. Born from the resonance of elemental energy, it is a creature of mystery and might—waiting for a worthy tamer to uncover its potential.
Will you earn its trust?
Will you master its elemental forms?
Or will you fall before the storm it brings?
The journey continues, and Artikel awaits.
Thank you for seven incredible years. Here's to the adventures still ahead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/15fa7cf2dad99ebf75922b473f70fd12cf7c51e2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d4bca032edceffcc73c0ad2575d4fe3a8ff91064.jpg[/img]

[b]Taming Method[/b]
Craft an “Artikel Bait” and place it in a mine or Pit area to lure out a wild Artikel.
Once it appears, knock it out and tame it.

[b]Specific spawn locations are as follows[/b]
Pixark：
●	Magical Mine
●	Plateau Magic Pit
●	Plateau Iron Pit
●	Brenstone Mine
●	Plateau Iron Mine
●	Quartz Pit
●	Silver Pit
Skyward：
●	Twilight Woods Mine
●	Mystical Valley Mine
●	Glittering Ridge Mine
●	Crystal Island Mine
●	Blackrock Mountain Mine	

[b]Skills[/b]
Left Click: Basic Attack
Right Click: Elemental Skill Attack
(7 elemental states, each with a unique effect)
C Key: Toggle between Biped and Quadruped stance
X Key: Prism Veil
(During the Prism Veil buff, up to 10 hits can be blocked. Each block consumes one Magic Essence of any type.)

[b]Right Click Skills by Element[/b]
Fire / Red:
Breathes fire forward, dealing damage and applying a burn effect.
Water / Blue:
Fires a stream of water forward, dealing damage and slowing the target.
Wind / Green:
Releases several small tornados forward, causing knockback.
Earth / Yellow:
Launches multiple rocks forward, dealing damage and applying a defense-breaking effect.
Lightning / Purple:
Fires a lightning beam forward that reduces the target’s armor effectiveness.
Light / White:
Shoots multiple radiant projectiles forward, dealing damage and causing blindness.
Dark / Gray:
Fires a death siphon beam forward, dealing damage while partially restoring Artikel’s HP.

[b]Special Abilities[/b]
1.Approach and hold E to open the radial menu, then select “Change Body Color” to switch elemental states.
Each change consumes one Magic Essence of the corresponding color.

2.Each elemental state grants a passive bonus:
Fire / Red: Increases attack power
Water / Blue: Increases swimming speed and health regeneration
Wind / Green: Increases movement speed
Earth / Yellow: Reduces incoming damage
Lightning / Purple: Creates a static field that paralyzes nearby enemies
Light / White: Emits light
Dark / Gray: Grants invisibility to the rider

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/c6a9e3bd76025336bf82f21164b6f2a5e7bc0b8d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/16b2513859a9ec76ee827f2827ea9f2df4c9fc48.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d4e3ad3fd5bc2c31ad2f98d11777db073bfd7738.gif[/img]

Old Dino Skins ARE BACK：
You now have another opportunity to exchange the following bone creature skins at the Tailor’s Workbench:
Bone Rex: 70 Skeleton Essence
Bone Megarock Dragon: 70 Skeleton Essence
Bone Carnosaurus: 30 Skeleton Essence
Bone Trike: 30 Skeleton Essence
Bone Gryphon: 50 Skeleton Essence
Bone Ghost Dragon: 50 Skeleton Essence

notes.title: PixARK Patch 1.212 Children’s Day Event
notes.content:
Dear Explorers!

 We bring you our Children’s Day Event! Hopefully you will enjoy it! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/7705ccd42b336c1ba111a95e48d24d82a93dee32.jpg[/img]


[h2]Old Items Are BACK![/h2]

[h3] Children's Day Costumes! [/h3]

[b]Paperbox Head [/b]
- can be exchanged at Children’s Day Goblin Trading Center with 400 game coins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/b0fb8edd8587c8d85aed49bf28604da3ed107664.jpg[/img]

[b]Little Yellow Duckling Head[/b]
 - can be exchanged at Children’s Day Goblin Trading Center with 400 game coins.

[b] Rain boots [/b]
- can be exchanged at Children’s Day Goblin Trading Center with 400 game coins.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/43310ce7fbb9f8d0bdbc050e50e808c133f01565.jpg[/img]

[b]Fun Swing[/b]
  - Needs both Swing frame and Swing itself, which can be exchanged with 500 games coins each.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/c2947b96b0fb797e0b5486ccc7f591597b6dde25.gif[/img]

[b]Pirate Ship[/b]
  - Needs both Pirate Ship frame and Pirate Ship itself, which can be exchanged with 1200 game coins each.
  - Allows up to 4 players to board at the same time.
  - Electricity is required to power it up.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/61661f5c80bc03968db3f750b3335f0d05676591.gif[/img]

[b]Building Dyes: Shamrock/Parakeet/Seafoam/Mint/Pistachio[/b]

Seafoam and Pistachio will need to be exchanged with 50 game coins at the Children’s Day Goblin Trading Center.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/014b07af0c53ff5a2fc2b8003dd6aada29db717d.png[/img]

[b]Children’s Day Goblin Trading Center[/b]
- Can be obtained by defeating Goblins or Goblin Kings.
- Can also be obtained through Holiday supply drops.
- Used to exchange for Children’s Day event items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/9b3059e149c3579db7a38c6116b07ae13729bdba.jpg[/img]

[b]Children’s Day Costumes[/b]
- Hat: Can be obtained by hitting balloons during the event.
- Top, Leg, Boot, Gloves：Can be exchanged through Children’s Day Goblin Trading Center for 200 game coins each.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/69b3caed7bfcb1098275d74e2d8eea5b36af2bcf.jpg[/img]

[b]Children’s Day Pickaxe/Sickle/Axe[/b]
- Has the same harvest rate as an Iron tool.
- Can be crafted using resources and dyes in Tailor’s Workbench.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/73b9deac70bf39a992849bc02c2c17267efc95b7.jpg[/img]

[b]Carousel[/b]
- Can be exchanged at the Children’s Daily Goblin trading center with 2000 game coins.
- A maximum of 4 players can ride together at a time.
- Needs electricity to function.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/cf5e2725068063d1486de7b1f560af38f2a9fa5c.jpg[/img]

[b]Paintball gun[/b]
- Equip dyes to create graffiti art on floors/structures (not including creatures).
- Can be exchanged at the Children’s Daily Goblin trading center with 500 game coins.
- Graffiti lasts 30 minutes.
	
[b]Candy Bomb[/b]
- Throw different types of candy towards players to transform them into different characters.
- Can be obtained through Children’s Day Goblin Trading Center with 50 game coins.
- Transformation lasts 10 minutes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d248793a0b73a1e0a270347f36a4f1d1ff8b5bc4.jpg[/img]

[b]Candy Arrow[/b]
- New level 15 recipe
- Used to shoot balloons.
- Crafting materials: Flint, Wood, and Tintoberry

[h2]Old Events Are Back As Well![/h2]

[b]Balloon shooting[/b]
-Balloons will Spawn in Novice Grassland/Grassland/Dawn Island/Woodland.
- Must be shot down by Bows with Candy Arrows.
[u]Drops:[/u]
- Balloon Backpack (20% drop rate, lasts 30 minutes)
- Children’s Day Hat Costume (10% drop rate)
- 4-6 Game coins
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/a6ddc642be7749767f62a4ff9e33f1fc328ed9cd.gif[/img]

[b]Candy Supply Drops[/b]
- Supply Drops have a new look with Children’s Day items inside!
[u]Drops:[/u]
- Candy Bomb
- Children’s Day Goblin Trading Center

[b] Tiny Yellow Hat[/b]
Some of the wild creatures found in PixARK are wearing tiny yellow hats. Defeat them for a chance to grab a Tiny Yellow Hat for your own tames and 2-4 Game Coins.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/45e01eb3d62efb9caecd754bf3d1aa63c82d6e54.jpg[/img]

[b]Enabling double harvest rates [/b]

notes.title: PixARK 1.211 Easter Patch Notes
notes.content:
[i]Patch goes live tonight at midnight[/i]

[h2]Easter Bunny Challenge[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/e05e5e3d32f86ec6e194336e73647d729e49f53d.jpg[/img]
Easter Bunny will show its presence at Novice Grassland, Grassland, Dawn Island and Woodland.

Looting the Easter Bunny will grant you 2-5 Silver Egg Tokens and maybe even a Gold Egg Token at a 10% chance.

These tokens can be exchanged for rewards at the Easter Goblin Trading Center.

Using a Carrot Club will deal additional damage to the Easter Bunny
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/dfac92c5a06a660fe3e2e1cdc4036e4bd66fc204.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/bad8efb88b3e9d21408f464151e9f7a1f34cea32.gif[/img]

[h3]Old Items Are BACK! [/h3]
[b]Carrot Club[/b]

Can be exchanged for at Easter Goblin Trading Center with 10 Carrots.
Deals additional damage to the Easter Bunny.
Parasaurus and Triceratops can harvest carrot seeds, which can be planted near the water to obtain carrots.

[b]Bunny Ears[/b]
Can be exchanged at the Easter Goblin Trading center with 1 Gold Egg Token and 20 Silver Egg Tokens.
You can dye the Bunny Ear as well!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/f7581ded92d4b0616549d5a5c879857a17bdc858.jpg[/img]
[b]Easter Eggs[/b]

Can be exchanged for at the Easter Goblin Trading Center with 20 Silver Egg Tokens.
You can dye these Easter Eggs and change their patterns by hitting “Q” button upon placing them in your house.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/2c54b617e21f31ccaf08f43b627b9e2078b9bac7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Creature Reveal: Artikel’s Concept Art Unveiled!
notes.content:
Deep within regions rich in magical minerals, a mysterious and formidable creature roams—Artikel. 

A fusion of various beasts, it possesses the serpentine head of a dragon, razor-sharp fangs, the muscular build of a jaguar, a crocodile’s resilient tail, and a flowing mane adorning its neck. What truly sets Artikel apart, however, is its ability to shift colors based on the elemental environment it inhabits. From its back to the tip of its tail, glowing elemental energy pulsates—blazing like fire in a Fire state, or flickering like eerie black flames in a Dark state.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/6d5e89b3a7e83e81f7202b8102465af707f301aa.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]How to Tame Artikel[/b][/h3]

To earn Artikel’s trust, you must approach it in its slumber and feed it magical minerals. But beware—each feeding will awaken it, triggering an aggressive response. You must quickly retreat and wait for it to return to its resting spot before attempting another offering. Using different types of magical minerals can enhance the taming efficiency.

[h3][b]Elemental States[/b][/h3]

By consuming specific magical minerals, Artikel can temporarily enter a corresponding Elemental State, activating only one at a time:
[list]
[*] Fire: Breathes flames that inflict burning damage. Riders gain cold resistance and immunity to burn effects.
[*] Earth: Encases itself in rocky armor, reducing incoming damage and slightly boosting attack power.
[*] Wind: Unleashes whirlwind breath attacks that deal damage and push back enemies, while also increasing movement speed.
[*] Light: Emits a radiant glow that illuminates its surroundings and can unleash a dazzling flash, frightening smaller creatures.
[*] Lightning: Fires a powerful electric beam—its most devastating elemental attack.
[*] Water: Enhances the rider’s heat resistance and swimming speed. Special attack releases slowing water jets.
[*] Dark: Performs a life-draining leaping strike while granting its rider invisibility, preventing detection by hostile creatures unless attacked.
[/list]
[h3][b]Combat Abilities[/b][/h3]

Basic Attack (Left Click): Switch between bipedal and quadrupedal stances.
●	Bipedal Stance: Executes a chain claw attack, alternating strikes while advancing forward.
●	Quadrupedal Stance: Delivers a powerful frontal bite.
Elemental Ability (Right Click): Activates an elemental attack based on the current Elemental State, usable in both stances.
Stance Switch (C Key): Toggle between standing on two legs or moving on all fours.
Elemental Roar (X Key): Releases a colorful breath effect for cosmetic display.

Are you ready to tame and master Artikel? We’ll continue unveiling more details about its development—stay tuned! Please don’t forget to share your thoughts in the comments!

–[i] The PixARK Team[/i]

notes.title: PixARK 1.207 Lunar New Year Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Steam 1.207 Lunar New Year Patch Notes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/0a80c9e22232d813ca6abbc8e15b0958990908b9.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Items：[/h3]
Red, Blue, White, Yellow, Green Snake Helmet!
Red Snake Helmet can be obtained by challengng the Great Nian Beast.
The other helmets can be exchanged at New Year Goblin Trading Center with 300 red packets each.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/5ba8cb4e73cd56ee5da8718c4a4f34dab0430904.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/9503ff5726efb6e8a6420e812b44d55246773b84.gif[/img]

[h3]Boss Challenge：[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/bfd70a23c1996cf9048d67408ac0b654f6f2b972.jpg[/img]

Great Nian Beast

The Great Nian Beast is a special kind of Nian beast that only appears during the Chinese New Year. It is much larger and stronger than the ordinary Nian beasts, and has the ability to weaken opponents with fear, ignite, slow and exhaust. It will also buff itself with "Inferno"and "Eternal Night" upon taking damage. However, such a powerful creature is only afraid of the traditional Chinese dragon lantern. Explorers can negate most of the debuff by carrying the dragon lantern to challenge it, and you will also deal increased damage and receive decreased damage.

Skills：
1、Swipe： Regular attack
2、Heavy Slam: Slams the ground with its paws, knocking back enemies. 
3、Soul of the Nian Beast: Releases Soul of the NIan Beast to attack the enemies in front, dealing “fear” debuff along the way. (Immune to Dragon Lantern and players carrying dragon lantern)
4、Dance of Blessing: A special kind of dance among the Nian Beasts, which will buff itself with “Force of the Nian,” increasing its damage while taking less damage. It will reflect a portion of the melee damage taken to the attacker. Dragon Tail Lantern can eliminate this buff.
5、Flamethrower: Deals damage and applies an ignite DOT. The ignite DOT can spread among enemies during the “Force of the Nian” buff. (Immune to Dragon Tail Lantern and players carrying dragon tail lantern)
6、Outrage: Slams enemy multiple times and roars at the very end. Each slam deals damage, and slows enemy if it has the “Force of the Nian” buff. The roar decreases enemy attack damage, and decreases enemy defense if it has the “Force of the Nian” buff.   (Immune to Dragon Lantern and players carrying dragon lantern)

Boss will buff itself with “Inferno” during the second phase, which will increase its damage.
Boss will buff itself with “Eternal Night” during the third phase, which will increase its damage while taking less damage. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/2bf8f91ded63ba48be137039c59cf618f2b30ad6.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] It is not easy to challenge the Great Nian Beast, but it is  afraid of Dragon Lanterns. Brave Explorers can take on the challenge by performing the traditional Chinese "Dragon Lantern Dance."
[*] Players can obtain Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail by defeating Nian Beasts at Novice Grassland, Grassland, Dawn Island and Woodland.
[*] Players can initiate the Challenge at the Dragon Lantern Stand.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/7aa0bb371128069f738e220adda205fc04f632a8.jpg[/img]
[i]Rules:[/i]
[list]
[*] Players will need to raise different types of Dragon Lanterns in a “Head-Body-Tail” order to initiate the Challenge.
[*] Only the player holding the Dragon Head Lantern can initiate the challenge.
[*] The first and the final position have to be “Head” and “Tail” respectively. However, there can be up to 5 players holding “Body” in between.
[/list]
[i]Challenge Requirements:[/i]
[list]
[*] At least lvl90 to initiate the challenge.
[*] Challenge can be done once per day.
[*] 1 player holding “Head only” will allow a total of 3 players and 7 creatures into the challenge.
[*] 3 players holding “Head-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 5 players and 8 creatures into the challenge.
[*] 5 players holding “Head-Body-Body-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 8 players and 13 creatures into the challenge.
[*] 7 players holding “Head-Body-Body-Body-Body-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 12 players and 19 creatures into the challenge.
[/list]
[i]Loots: [/i]
[list]
[*] Lantern Dragon (Single Seat) at 100% chance, and another one at a small chance.
[*] Red Tassel Gold Lance at a small chance
[*] 50-100 Red Packets
[*] Chainmail avatar pieces at a small chance.
[*] Daeodon Food Recipe (can increase the effectiveness of the healing ability, and lower food consumption, doesn't work in boss arena)
[*] Red Snake Helmet at 100% chance.
[/list]

[h3]Old Items ARE BACK![/h3]



Nian Beast Avatar
Can be exchanged for at New Year Goblin Trading Center with red packets.
Head：300 Red Packets
Top：200 Red Packets
Bottom：150 Red Packets
Gloves：150 Red Packets
Shoes：150 Red Packets
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/db22d69889edb71e57f7953a48a6a3e9b2d68ab0.jpg[/img]

[b]New Year Goblin Trading Center[/b]
Can be obtained from defeating goblins wearing God of Wealth hat or at event supply drops
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/42c8c7eb2e2615041396a1c3a9b03095567818b7.jpg[/img]

[b]New Year Avatar Set - Chainmail[/b]
Can be exchanged for at New Year Goblin Trading Center with red packets.
[list]
[*] Hat: 300 Red Packets
[*] Top: 200 Red Packets
[*] Bottom:150 Red Packets
[*] Gloves: 150 Red Packets
[*] Shoes: 150 Red Packets
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/cac5f6a288b8911ed4b0972083d083bb24905065.jpg[/img]

Copper quality
Can be exchanged at New Year Goblin Trading Center with 200 red packets

[b]Red Tassel Gold Lance[/b]
Iron quality
Can be obtained from defeating the Great Nian Beast at a low chance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/24c7578c9c7da1fe1529fff6ff8efa0c1f9d5fc5.jpg[/img]

[b]Dragon Lantern Stand:[/b]
Can be used to start the Great Nian Beast Challenge with:
[list]
[*] Dragon Head Lantern
[*] Dragon Body Lantern
[*] Dragon Tail Lantern
[/list]

Can be exchanged for at New Year Goblin Trading Center with 300 Red Packets..
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/65b634ee089b013cc899723f1db75c12fb3da48d.jpg[/img]

[b]Dragon Head/Body/Tail Lantern[/b]
[list]
[*] Defeating Nian Beast will drop Dragon Lantern parts (Head/Body/Tail) at 20% chance.
[*] Dragon Head Lantern: Players can raise the Dragon Head Lantern to deal damage to the Great Nian Beast. (Expires in 6 hours)
[*] Dragon Body Lantern: Players can raise the Dragon Body Lantern to shield themselves. (Expires in 3 hours)
[*] Dragon Tail Lantern: Players can raise the Dragon Tail lantern to remove all buffs on Great Nian Beast. (Expires in 3 hours)
[/list]		
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/a62df3d9a192306ca56867d5c1f33ac24bac1c0b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/c68680dca2470704454fd32d4ad52686b3e2a3e3.jpg[/img]
[b]Mount: Lantern Dragon[/b]
In China, lanterns are indispensable objects for festivals, and the flying Kong Ming lanterns are a symbol of people's aspiration for a better life. Now for the first time in Pixark, players can build their Lantern Dragon with lanterns and enjoy a ride with friends!

Lantern Dragon can have up to 5 seats as you put more parts in!
[list]
[*] Lantern Dragon（Single seat): can be obtained from defeating the Great Nian Beast at a small chance.
[*] Lantern Dragon（Double seat): can be obtained from combining two Lantern Dragon（Single seat）at tailor’s workbench.
[*] Lantern Dragon（Triple seat): can be obtained from combining two Lantern Dragon（Double seat）at tailor’s workbench.
[*] Lantern Dragon（Quadra seat): can be obtained from combining two Lantern Dragon（Triple seat）at tailor’s workbench.
[*] Lantern Dragon（Penta seat): can be obtained from combining two Lantern Dragon（Quadra seat）at tailor’s workbench.
[/list]

[u][b]Permanent lantern dragon (1-4 seats) which can be obtained with Lantern Dragon（Penta seat) and limited time Lantern Dragon（Single seat) at tailor’s workbench![/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/b0597ae766af390ade082b0d9c5593337b4ba990.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/74b4dc234a44bbf1e9a4033b4f6bad4bbe1df591.gif[/img]

[h3]Old Lunar New Year Events Are Back![/h3]

Spawn rate is 50% at the Death Lord Altar in PixARK map and 50% at the Burial Ground Altar in Skyward map.
Rewards: Gargoyle Skin (5% drop rate)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/c9e29279f33a286206a5223911d4798a45b09ac1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/05c734b7557039e9a9bff737e5d873cd63070f6d.jpg[/img]

[b]Lunar New Year Reunion Party[/b]
Placing different Lunar New Year dishes on the table will grant different buffs to the player, along with new year greetings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/7c29e04527c801099650aee604b6b32874c40cc4.jpg[/img]
[b]God of Wealth Hat[/b]
Players can obtain God of Wealth Hat at a small chance by defeating creatures that wearing it (Cosmetic for tamed creatures)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/3d569481272ee2c2c35de1efe7742fdd13725b4a.jpg[/img]
[b]Nian Beasts are Back![/b]
Nian Beasts will be spawning in Novice Grassland, Grassland, Dawn Island and Woodland.
Can only be defeated by the Firecrackers players crafted.

[h3]Optimization[/h3]

notes.title: The second phase of the Creature Submission Event voting is now open!
notes.content:
Dear Explorers,

Since the second phase of the creature brainstorming contest kicked off, ideas have been pouring in like a dazzling constellation of creativity.  Your passion and imagination have breathed life into this event, making it truly unforgettable. After extensive and lively discussions, five extraordinary and powerful creatures have been chosen to take the final stage.  It’s your turn to decide—cast your vote for the creature that inspires you the most and give it the chance to embark on an unforgettable journey!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/f569bd790f5860c3a3952498517bb0d824f25100.jpg[/img]

[h2]Ratarooille[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Basic Info: [/b]A small rodent species that roams the vast grasslands and mysterious woodland. Faced with constant food scarcity, it evolved a pouch-like organ like a kangaroo to store food. Its tiny body grants it remarkable agility, allowing it to dart through the grass to gather edible items.

[*][b]Taming Method: [/b]Craft its special bait using a cooking pot, drop the bait on the ground, and move away (or use bug repellent). The Ratarooille will approach to collect the bait. Repeat this process several times to tame it.

[*][b]Special Effects:[/b] Functions as a shoulder pet, capable of collecting loot from creatures defeated by the player, while providing a weight reduction buff.

[*][b]Combat Ability:[/b] Bite.
[/list]

[h2]Elemantaridea[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Basic Info:[/b]The Elemantaridea is a collective term for four unique types of mantis shrimp. Originally fragile sea creatures, they underwent mutations after being brought to Skyward. Now, they inhabit specific environments such as glacial lakes, lava pools, oil fields, and radiation zones, with their colors and abilities differing based on their habitat. Their small size allows players to carry them on their arms, granting access to their unique powers.

[*][b]Taming Method:[/b]Feed different types of bait based on their color:
White: Meat, ice, snow, or Water Magic Stone.
Red: Meat or Fire Magic Stone.
Blue: Meat or Cobalt Crystal.
Black: Meat or oil.

[*] [b]Special Effects:[/b]Each color of mantis shrimp offers a unique ability for players to utilize.

[*] [b]Combat Abilities:[/b]
White: Consumes food to summon ice spikes for attacks.
Red: Burns enemies with a continuous flame.
Blue: Fires beams of light.
Black: Sprays flammable venom that ignites upon contact with fire, causing devastating burns.
[/list]

[h2]Mudmorpher[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Basic Info:[/b]Resembling a walking pile of clay, this omnivorous creature can be found in areas like Glittering Ridge and swamps.

[*][b]Taming Method:[/b]Feed it chunks of meat or berries. Magic dried fruits are more effective for taming.

[*][b]Skill Effects:[/b]
Passive Skill 1 - Weight Reduction: Its flat, wide body reduces carried weight by 50%.
Passive Skill 2 - Malleable Body: Its soft body reduces physical damage taken by half.
Special Skill 1 - Conversion: Converts materials like Earth Magic  stones, stone, or volcanic rock into dirt. If exposed to water, the dirt can further transform into clay.
Special Skill 2 - Road Layer: Can place dirt or clay blocks stored in its inventory to create paths over uneven terrain.
Active Skill - Extends tentacles from its clay body to attack enemies in front. It also efficiently gathers dirt, sand, and stone blocks without damaging terrain-level blocks.

[*] [b]Rideable: [/b]Ridden without a saddle. However, it cannot automatically traverse terrain more than one block higher.
[/list]

[h2]Artikel[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Basic Info:[/b]A mysterious hybrid creature with traits from various animals. It has a snake-like head with sharp teeth, a jaguar-like muscular body, and a crocodile-like sturdy tail surrounded by a mane that changes color based on its elemental affinity. Artikel radiates elemental energy along its back, reflecting its current element. It dwells alone in regions rich in magical minerals, often found sleeping on mineral deposits that determine its elemental properties.

[*][b]Taming Method:[/b]Sneak up while it’s asleep and feed it magical minerals. Each feeding wakes Artikel, making it highly aggressive. Flee quickly and wait for it to return to sleep before repeating the process. Feeding the right type of magical mineral increases taming efficiency.
[*] 
[*][b]Special Effects:[/b]Can temporarily adopt an elemental state based on the minerals it consumes:
Fire (Red): Breathes fire, grants heat resistance, and immunity to burns.
Earth (Orange): Gains rock armor for damage reduction and increased attack power.
Wind (Green): Unleashes whirlwinds, knocking back enemies and boosting speed.
Light (White): Emits a glowing aura, frightens small creatures, and illuminates a wide area.
Lightning (Purple): Fires powerful lightning bolts, its strongest attack.
Darkness (Gray): Performs life-draining leap attacks, cloaking both itself and its rider.
Water (Blue): Sprays water jets to slow enemies, grants heat resistance, and increases swimming speed.

[*][b]Combat Ability:[/b]Has dual combat stances:
Bipedal Stance: Executes chain claw strikes that advance the creature forward.
Quadrupedal Stance: Performs a powerful forward bite attack.
Elemental Ability (Right Click): It unleashes elemental attacks based on its current elemental affinity. This ability is available in both bipedal and quadrupedal stances.
Pressing the C Key switches between bipedal and quadrupedal stances.
Pressing the X Key triggers an elemental breath roar with a corresponding color, which serves only as a decorative effect.
[/list]

[h2]Herculon[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Basic Info:[/b]Originally a desert-dwelling beetle, it underwent magical mutations in the enchanted forest, growing into a massive and aggressive creature with a durable shell capable of withstanding large predators. Its formidable horns and legs make it a potent fighter.

[*][b]Taming Method:[/b]Combine resin from the Magic Forest with honey in an Industrial Cauldron to create a special bait. Use bug repellent on yourself and place the bait behind the beetle to tame it.

[*][b]Special Effects:[/b]Herculon consumes meat, spoiled meat, and berries. It can also produce a unique healing tonic that provides group buffs. The buff reduces damage taken and increases attack power, making it an excellent ally for tackling ruins.

[*][b]Combat Abilities (Press C to toggle stances) : [/b]
Stance 1: Grounded Stance: Reduces incoming damage by 50%. Attacks may trigger counterstrikes that knock enemies into the air.
Stance 2: Upright Stance: Horn attacks cause bleeding, while claw attacks knock back enemies and reduce their armor. Feeding it honey boosts its respective defense or attack power.
[/list]

[h2]You can open the following link to cast your vote:[/h2]

[b]English Region:[/b] https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdeK7js2nL3CaBRgUWLCdCcx-sse3UnvgzRwsG_TcU3u5lTMw/viewform?usp=header


Thanks to your active participation, the world of Pixark is becoming more vibrant and exciting with each choice you make. Now, the decision is in your hands. Cast your vote for the creature that captivates you the most, and together, let’s witness their legendary adventures unfold in the world of Pixark!

notes.title: Pixark 1.206 Christmas Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/4431a0349165d71f75a0274032b1a01a50e7f119.jpg[/img]

[h2]Puzzle Challenge is back![/h2]

Puzzle pieces are scattered all over the PixARK world. Challenge yourself to find the pieces and complete the puzzle!
Win Christmas rewards after completing the puzzle!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/66c88fc3fa0f0673cffa193704b84329aa5219aa.jpg[/img]

[b]Rewards[/b]
Tyrannosaurus Rex Christmas skin
Tyrannosaurus Rex Christmas saddle skin
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/3fa6566e51c200f7d6d9c093e6ee43bcdc24ea8f.jpg[/img]

Christmas doll suit
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/3268fd393b76294f974f17ae54304dd2e52a7710.jpg[/img]

How to get puzzle pieces
There are a total of 16 puzzle pieces. There is a chance to obtain different pieces in different ways:
Pieces 1 to 10:Participate in snowball fights, mining Christmas snow blocks, and killing creatures wearing Christmas hats.
Pieces 11 to 13:Search airdrop supply boxes.
Pieces 11 to 16:Defeat bosses (Death, Bone Dragon King, Mammoth, Megalodon).

Tips:
Once puzzle is completed, face to the puzzle frame and long press E to get rewards, tribemates nearby can also get rewards. One competed puzzle frame can only get rewards for once, you can get more rewards by compete another frame.

Other ways to get puzzle pieces
You can also use other puzzle pieces to exchange for puzzle piece packs at the Christmas elf station. The pack can randomly give you a puzzle piece (pieces 11 to 16).
Puzzle piece pack: Redeem with 100 of puzzle pieces of any type.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/226e5da5194e0628bc319ad9d12cf45ade9ffce1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Snow Devil is Back![/h2]
The legend has it that the horrifying Snow Devil was born in the land of sheer cold. The perpetual blizzard grants it endless power, allowing it to cast many powerful spells.

[b]Skills:[/b]
[u]Snowball:[/u]
Activating blizzard energy and firing a gigantic snowball from its chest to attack the enemy from a long distance, dealing damage, and lowering enemy speed and cold resistance.
[u]Blizzard:[/u]
Rotating its body and releasing a snow tornado to attack enemies, dealing damage, and lowering enemy speed and cold resistance.
[u]Snow Pillar:[/u]
Summoning a snow pillar to attack enemies on the ground.
[u]One-Punch Devil:[/u]
Gathering energy to its right fist and punching enemies afront, dealing damage, and lowering enemy speed and cold resistance.

[u]Special Abilities:[/u]
Player’s cold resistance is reduced and heat resistance is increased within 50 meters of Snow Devil. The closer the player gets to the Snow Devil, the stronger the effect.
Snow Devil generates an aura of cold air beneath its foot when its HP is under 50%, dealing damage and lowering speed and cold resistance to enemies who touch it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/cd318331f04dbd9d1006278b9ca8356d2bfec43d.gif[/img]

Players can start the Snow Devil challenge by placing “Snow Devil Doll” at the Christmas Fireplace. A Christmas fireplace can be obtained at the Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 200 Christmas tokens. The Snow Devil Doll has a chance of dropping from Christmas gift boxes.

[b]Challenge Prerequisites[/b]
Character level ≥90
A maximum of 10 creatures
A maximum of 5 players
Note: Each character can challenge Snow Devil only once per day.

[b]Boss Loot[/b]
Small chance of obtaining following skins:
[list]
[*] Christmas Dodo Skin
[*] Christmas Pteranodon Skin
[*] Christmas Iguanodon Skin
[*] Christmas Gryphon Skin
[*] Christmas Megarock Dragon Skin
[/list]

and a small chance of obtaining following items:
[list]
[*] Christmas Cape (Limited)
[*] Christmas Cape (Permanent)
[*] Christmas Reindeer Sleigh
[*] 300-600 Christmas Tokens
[*] Tek Storage Box Blueprint
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/01796ff4bdbd5be4ad08901071cdc9d13231150e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Old Events are BACK![/h2]
[h3]Christmas Blessing Tree[/h3]
Decorating a Christmas Tree with various decorations will grant you a Christmas Blessing buff. The Christmas Tree can be acquired with Christmas Tokens at the Christmas Goblin Trade Center. Decorating the tree with Christmas Dolls in five unique colors, will gift players the Christmas Blessing and a Christmas Gift Box.

Christmas Gift Box may contain one or more of the following items:
[list]
[*] Rocking Reindeer
[*] Christmas Painting
[*] Christmas Curtain
[*] Snow Devil Doll
[/list]

Notes:
[list]
[*] Christmas Dolls may be obtained by looting Snowman.
[*] Christmas Goblin Trade Center can be obtained by digging Snow Cubes in Christmas Blizzard or from the Christmas Supply Drop.
[*] Christmas Tokens can be harvested from Snow Cubes in Christmas Blizzard
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/e14fd8268685633e9592ccd2637364ef19451f07.jpg[/img]

[h3]Snowman Fight[/h3]
Snowmen will spawn in Noviceland, Grassland, Dawn island, and Woodland. Players will need to craft Snowballs to attack the Snowmen, which will drop one or more following items: 
[list]
[*] Christmas Candy
[*] Christmas Dolls (50% drop rate)
[*] Snowman Figure
[*] Snowman Costumes
[*] Christmas Token
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/c48c8faabb0ae49ba1722944df64629f90bacce8.jpg[/img]

[h3]Red Hat Creatures[/h3]
Christmas Red Hats have a small chance of dropping from any creature wearing them. Creatures wearing Christmas Red Hats may also drop Christmas Tokens!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/e3c5d34c8e2ad51b047ec4031129cdda71fd9ded.jpg[/img]

[h3]Christmas Supply Drop[/h3]
Santa will be riding his Reindeer Sleigh to give away some gifts! Christmas Supply Drop may contain following items:
[list]
[*] Christmas Paintings (small chance)
[*] Christmas Candy
[*] Christmas Fireworks
[*] Christmas Cape (Limited) (small chance)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/fad65b31a17d2d8826083e2a276d6fb5b84be42d.jpg[/img]

Christmas Snowy Biomes
A majority of the biomes will be enjoying snowy views. During snowy seasons, some biomes might experience a “Christmas Blizzard”. Explorers digging blizzard snow cubes in Christmas Snowy biomes will have a chance of obtaining Christmas Tokens, Christmas Blizzard Snow Cube and Christmas Candy.

Rate Boosts:
[list]
[*] Double Harvest Rates on ores
[*] Higher Exp from defeating Snowmen.
[/list]

[h2]Missed Old Christmas Items? They are BACK![/h2]
[h3]Snowman Costume[/h3]
can be exchanged at Christmas Goblin Trading Center at 150 Christmas Tokens each.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/fbe124512cc00b07a4c5a0a62ad13126ff13e36f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Christmas Goblin Trade Center[/h3]
Christmas Goblin Trade Center can be obtained by digging Snow Cubes in Christmas Blizzard or from the Christmas Supply Drop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/8b2f777936a6eb6021938c8f9b436e0da0c50a76.jpg[/img]

[h3]Christmas Reindeer Costume[/h3]
Can be purchased from Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 500 Christmas Tokens.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/e2a048fa6d0d3b88e15de8213df5028c6f1034cf.jpg[/img]

[h3]Christmas Treant Costume[/h3]
Can be purchased from Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 500 Christmas Tokens.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/13e0e1b3cdbc39c4c6753ffc1f0bf1667e6f113f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Christmas Reindeer Sleigh Saddle[/h3]
Equipping it on a Reindeer allows one player to ride on it and fly across the map. With the Reindeer Christmas Platform Saddle, players can place up to 50 structures behind it. It can be purchased from Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 2000 Christmas Tokens.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/6d84d851cac49f8f97a40b4af7db3939febfb6df.jpg[/img]

[h3]Christmas Hat[/h3]
Players can get in the Christmas Spirit with these Christmas Hats! They can be purchased from the Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 200 Christmas Tokens.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/37ca0f1ed3a125503ee3b30465550701fdb80e6e.jpg[/img]

[h3]Rocking Reindeer, Christmas Paintings, Christmas Curtain [/h3]
Rocking Reindeer - Drop rate of 10% from Christmas Tree Gift Boxes.
Christmas Paintings - Drop rate of 40% from Christmas Tree Gift Boxes.
Christmas Curtain - Drop rate of 30% from Christmas Tree Gift Boxes and Supply Drops.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/0b046f0ee60c1f8436b1b18e18d6ed1ce94bf40a.jpg[/img]

[h3]Christmas Fireplace[/h3]
Obtained from the Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 200 Christmas Tokens
Placing a “Snow Devil Doll” at the Christmas Fireplace will start the Snow Devil Challenge
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/994790f3d9272d8c49bf0dc31173a37d9bc6efd7.jpg[/img]

[h3]Snow Devil Doll[/h3]
Used at Christmas Fireplace to start the Snow Devil Challenge
Can also be used as a Holiday Decor
Can be obtained from Christmas Gift Box

[h3]Creature Christmas Skins[/h3]
All of the following skins have a chance of dropping upon defeating the Snow Devil Challenge, They can be purchased from Christmas Goblin Trade Center with Christmas Tokens:
Christmas Dodo Skin (100 tokens)
Christmas Pteranodon Skin (200 tokens)
Christmas Iguanodon Skin (200 tokens)
Christmas Gryphon Skin (400 tokens)
Christmas Megarock Dragon Skin (400 tokens)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/a0598712cfb939f6733212a39a35c68c1dc1d7d0.jpg[/img]

[h3]Christmas Cape[/h3]
Christmas Cape (Limited) can be obtained either from defeating the Snow Devil or from Christmas supply drops at a small chance.
Christmas Cape (Permanent) can be obtained by defeating the Snow Devil at a small chance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/3748cb41dff1be534350474b372fc245d1ea65ed.gif[/img]

h3]Celebrate 2025! [/h3]
Invite your friends and celebrate 2022 with our new Jumbotron in the sky! On New Year’s Day at 12am (server time), there will be a firework showcase when the big clock reaches zero near the Jumbotron. Come and share an unique experience with friends!~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/7b0a59b53ad0cc2bb1fc0b9d381d6ab1bcabc7ea.jpg[/img]

notes.title: PixARK Patch 1.205 Update
notes.content:

[list]

notes.title: The Second Creature Submission Event Kicks Off Today!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/29d6c51b274d129bd558f40747ab690ff503049c.jpg[/img]

Dear Explorers,

We’ve got exciting news to share! The first Creature Submission Event was a massive success, and the winning creature, Luminara, has officially joined our game. You can now tame this incredible creature and experience its unique abilities firsthand.

But that’s not all—we’re thrilled to announce that the Second Creature Submission Event also begins today! We invite all adventurers to unleash your creativity and passion once again. Share your ideas for new creatures: What do they look like? What special traits or skills do they have? Let us bring your imaginative designs to life!

[h3]How to Participate:[/h3]
Simply leave a comment below this announcement describing the creature you envision!
We’ll carefully evaluate all submissions and create a shortlist of potential creatures.
From there, it’s up to the community to vote on their favorite and decide the next new resident of Pixark!

[h3]Event Phases:[/h3]
1.	Submission Phase: Let your imagination run wild and share your ideas.
2.	Voting Phase: Cast your votes to select the community’s favorite concept.
3.	Production Phase: The winning creature will be brought to life and optimized, so it can join Pixark as soon as possible!

Your overwhelming participation in the last event was a massive inspiration for us, strengthening our resolve to keep moving forward. 

[h3]To build on that momentum, we’re aiming for over [b]500 likes[/b]  and [b]100 comments[/b] this time. [/h3]

Your support will drive us to create even more amazing surprises for you.

So don’t hold back—jump in, share your ideas, and help shape the future of PixARK. Together, we can make the game world even more vibrant and extraordinary!

notes.title: PixARK Patch 1.204 Luminara & Thanksgiving Update
notes.content:
[h1]Luminara[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/878f402b79b80bac8701c562a83e30414595360e.jpg[/img]

The Luminara is a mythical flying creature believed to have been created by the Cobaltans. It is thought to have evolved from a powerful prototype creature exposed to intense cobalt radiation, resulting in its current form. Luminara possesses unparalleled control over radiation, enabling it to switch seamlessly between two states: energy absorption and energy release.

●	Energy Release Mode: Focused on offense, Luminara can penetrate enemy armor and inflict massive damage.
●	Energy Absorption Mode: Prioritizes defense and recovery, granting damage reduction and the ability to heal itself during combat.

[b]Key Abilities:[/b]
●	Immortality and Rebirth:
A tamed Luminara demonstrates an almost immortal ability. Upon death, it leaves behind a Resurrection Egg. Using specific materials, this egg can be reactivated to resurrect the Luminara.

[b]Taming:[/b]
To tame a wild Luminara, provoke it into using its Energy Beam ability, which depletes its radiation energy and has a 20-second cooldown. Keep in mind that if the Luminara doesn’t fire another Energy Beam within 30 seconds, its radiation energy will fully recharge. Once you’ve completely drained its radiation energy, the Luminara will enter a Frenzy state. At this moment, defeat it to obtain a fertilized egg. Incubate the egg under the right conditions to hatch a tamed Luminara.

[b]Hatching:[/b]
In addition to meeting temperature requirements, radiation levels must also be sufficient to hatch a fertilized Luminara egg.

[b]Death and Revival:[/b]
When a tamed Luminara is killed, it transforms into a Resurrection Egg. By consuming specific materials in the Conjuring Cooking Pot (crafted from Magic Workbench), the Luminara can be resurrected.

[b]Controls and Abilities:[/b]
●	Left Click: Basic Attack
●	Right Click:
1.	Energy Beam (Release Mode): Deals damage that penetrates armor.
2.	Energy Drain (Absorption Mode): Inflicts damage while healing itself based on a percentage of the damage dealt.
●	C Key:
1.	Radiation Energy Field (Release Mode): Creates an energy field that boosts the damage and speed of cobalt variant creautres and cobaltstar creatures within its range. (Consumes Void Energy)
2.	Radiation Absorption Field (Absorption Mode): Generates an energy field that grants damage reduction and healing to cobalt variant creautres and cobaltstar creatures within its range. (Consumes Void Energy)
●	X Key: Mode Toggle. Switches Luminara between Release Mode and Absorption Mode (can only be used while on the ground).
●	Hold E: Activate Radiation Mode. In this mode, Luminara emits radiation energy in its surroundings, converting crop seeds in its inventory (carrots, lemons, wheat, corn, potatoes, mushrooms) into irradiated seeds with double yield. (Consumes Void Energy continuously)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ec07707d6ea29838218a1665459695007bda5d36.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/0d8aba213f3f2523c8791395e1b25c3ef6c369c2.gif[/img]

[h1]Thanksgiving Gameplay[/h1]
[b]Thanksgiving Banquet[/b]
Place six different Thanksgiving dishes on the Thanksgiving Dining Table, and then press E to enjoy the treat and be rewarded with the Thanksgiving Buff. Placing Roasted Turkey right at the center of the Thanksgiving Dining Table will bring something special to Explorers.

[b]Pardoned Turkey Event[/b]
In the Noviceland biome, Explorers may find wild Turkeys locked in cages. Players will need to break the cage to free the Turkeys. Once they are freed, Turkeys will drop Turkey eggs that provide rewards.
While freeing the caged Turkeys, explorers have a 30% chance of running into special Pardoned Turkey. Killing the Pardoned Turkey will drop the event item “Turkey Feather,” which can be used to summon Dodorex.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d3d1a56bf3b1444051beea3ff5a4266fc078b804.jpg[/img]

[b]Turkey Challenge - Summoning Dodorex[/b]
•	Upon collecting a certain amount of Turkey Feathers, explorers can use them to summon either a Dodorex (20 mins at 90% chance) or a Dodorex (Permanent at 10% chance) at a cooking pot.

[b]Dodorex[/b]
In the world of Pixark, even the weakest and humblest beings have dreams of becoming something stronger. And the Dodo, who is bullied by everyone, may become an existence to be feared by everyone. Legend has it that some dodos with exceptional talent were blessed by the ancestors of the dodo family and evolved into the most powerful Dodorex. Of course the legend is just a legend, in fact, people believe that Dodorex may be the descendants of Tyrannosaurus rex genetically modified by aliens. The biggest basis for this idea is that people have not yet found evidence of the existence of wild Dodorex.
•	Tamed Dodorex can bite (LMB) and shoot flames (RMB)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/5e49f7d1acc2649e86fd90694164dbdb7e3c3fa4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/330454c8bee4ab2f0c43db9ba509dbf06cc9e3f8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Thanksgiving Items:[/h2]

[b]Thanksgiving Decor:[/b]
May drop from the Supply Drop and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event:

•	Thanksgiving Dining Table
•	Thanksgiving Chair
•	Thanksgiving Recliner
•	Thanksgiving Curtain
•	Thanksgiving Decor Balloon
•	Thanksgiving Wall Decor

[b]Thanksgiving Dishes[/b]
May drop from the Supply Drop and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event.

•	Roasted Turkey
•	Pumpkin Pie
•	Beef Wellington
•	Salad
•	Brownie
•	Sweet Potato

[i]Turkey Hat[/i]
May drop from the Supply Drop and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/bb9120f1690792120b7404d62ebc53ebddcaaf09.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/57c10005d5716d94163c7c3d6749806fdb68a669.png[/img]

[i]Drum-Stick[/i]
May drop from the Supply Drop and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event.

[i]Farmer’s Fork[/i]
May drop from the Supply Drop and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/a782209acfffe660ed5798b49db97fd3da1fcf0f.jpg[/img]

[i]Dodo Chief Hat[/i]
Can be crafted using 30 Turkey Feathers at Tailor’s Workbench.
Can only be equipped on Dodorexes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/c18e082780c2ebe49a8464f3de846f9399c2f295.jpg[/img]

notes.title: PixARK Patch 1.203 Halloween Update
notes.content:
Dear Explorers！ 
We are bringing you our Halloween Patch! Happy Halloween! 

[h3]Old Creatures Come Back![/h3]
[b]Skeleton Horse[/b]

It is a skeleton war horse burning with the flames of hell. Legend has it that the skeleton horse is the mount of the knight of hell, and is the most reliable partner of the knight. It can fly to the sky and dive into the sea like walking on the ground, and the energy from hell also gives it the power of eternal life.

[u]Left click[/u] -  Normal attack

[u]Right click[/u]- Sacrifice: unleashes the flames of hell to inflict continuous damage to enemies within a certain range (damage value correlates to the HP of the  enemy, while damage upper limit correlates to the percentage of melee damage of the skeleton horse)

[u]'C' button[/u] - path of flame, activates its own hell energy, increases its own movement speed  by 50% and melee damage by 30%. Moving will leave a hell flame in place, enemies near the hell flame will take continuous damage (1-50 dmg/0.5 sec)

[i]Fire creatures are immune to the above skills[/i]

[u]Magical Crystal Berry: [/u]The food favored by skeleton horses that replenish their hell energy.  It can be crafted at magic workbench with a dark Magic Stone and a magic berry. 

[b]Where to find it? [/b]
[list]
[*] Skeleton Horse (permanent) can be summoned at “Conjuring Cooking Pot” at 70% chance with:
[list]
[*]  1x Breath Of the Dead
[*]  1x Pegasus DNA
[*]  2x Felhunter DNAs
[*]  5x Scent of the Pumpkin Soul Reaper
[/list]
[*] Upon failing, you will get a tamed Pegasus or a Felhunter.
[*] Defeating following monsters/BOSS will drop the corresponding items:
[list]
[*] Pegasus: Pegasus DNA at 20% chance, 
[*] Pumpkin Soul Reaper:  Scent of the Pumpkin Soul Reaper at 20% chance
[*] Felhunter:  Felhunter DNA at 20% chance 
[*] Death Lord (Boss)/ Bone Wyvern King (Boss): Breath of the Dead at 100% chance.
[/list][/list]Note：
[olist]
[*] “Conjuring Cooking Pot” can be crafted at magic workbench. 
[*] Breath of the Dead can be exchanged with 40  Scents of the Pumpkin Soul Reaper at the Conjuring Cooking Pot.  
[/olist]

Skeleton horse is endowed with strong vitality. Like any other bone creatures, it can resurrect as well.  It can be resurrected at the Conjuring Cooking Pot with 50 Magic Stone of any of the following types: Dark, Fire, Water, Thunder, Light, Earth, and Wind
[u]
Skeleton Horse Saddle:[/u]
Can be exchanged at tailor’s workbench with pumpkins. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/267ca412d493495947fac766e301e3098b982d54.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/a882752200f6fd9110632a9e312d9d69306c7704.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/e02c3890d3a4c72b4df0e2ee0b5c0233c98f6bb7.gif[/img]

[h3]THEY ARE BACK!![/h3]
Upon the arrival of Halloween, so do all those naughty Pumpkin Soul Reapers out there trick or treating. Hurry up and fight them off! 

During the event, Pumpkin Soul Reaper can be found in:
[u]Pixark[/u]: Novice Grassland, Grassland
[u]Skyward:[/u] Dawn Island, Woodland, and Void

Defeating it will drop:
[b]Scent of the Pumpkin[/b]
[b]Pumpkin Seed[/b]
[b]Magic Broom[/b] (7 days)
[b]Flying Firework[/b] (7 days)
[b]Clown Costume[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/e9ba5936c29ebd602db6add1e351fd404a973ab8.jpg[/img]

[h3]Gameplay:  The Great Pumpkin Battle![/h3]

With Halloween fast approaching, we need plenty of pumpkins not only to decorate our homes but also to use them to exchange gifts! Hurry up and call your buddies to plant pumpkins together!

[b]Pumpkin seeds:[/b]
Defeating Pumpkin Soul Reapers will drop pumpkin seeds, which can be used to plant pumpkins.

Pumpkins can be exchanged for various Halloween gifts at the Tailor’s  Workbench

[h3]Costumes! [/h3]

New skeleton costume set can be exchanged at the Tailor’s Workbench with: 
[u]Hat[/u]：400  pumpkins
[u]Top[/u]：200 pumpkins
[u]Hand[/u]：100 pumpkins
[u]Bottom[/u]：200 pumpkins
[u]Foot[/u]：100 pumpkins
[u]Skeleton Horse Saddle[/u]：1000 pumpkins

Knight costume set can be exchanged at the Tailor’s Workbench with: 
[u]Hat[/u]：350  pumpkins
[u]Top[/u]：350 pumpkins
[u]Hand[/u]：150 pumpkins
[u]Bottom[/u]：250 pumpkins
[u]Foot[/u]：150 pumpkins
[u]Sword[/u]：700 pumpkins
[u]Shield[/u]：700 pumpkins

Remember the Scarecrow costume from before? They can be exchanged at 50% discount!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/74d3efc4b4bed3a5496822596722ac62e5f8e2b7.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d24310407b15373ad98197e08d25abfa2f2fcf0e.jpg[/img]

[h3]Old Events ARE BACK![/h3]
[olist]
[*] [b]Clown Supply Drops[/b] - Normal supply drops will turn into Clown Supply Drops. Explorers can obtain Halloween Decors and Halloween Candy Grenades at a chance from these drops.

[*] [b]Pumpkin Hat[/b]: Some creatures will be wearing Pumpkin Hats. There is a chance of them dropping the Hats that you can equip them on your tamed creatures.

[*] [b]Double Harvest rates on Ores and Exp rates[/b]
       Higher Exp from defeating Pumpkin Soul Reapers
[/olist]
[h3]Old Items ARE BACK! [/h3]
[olist]
[*] [b]Flying Firework[/b] (7 days)
 Can be obtained at a chance from defeating Pumpkin Soul Reapers. Expires in 7 days.

[*] [b]Flying Firework[/b] (permanent)
 Can be obtained at a small chance from defeating: Ancient Wyvern King, Aurora Butterfly King and Beach Bully.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/08c9010ea9e03547e00b53c34bb1d93062ec893c.jpg[/img]
 
[*] [b]Halloween Trees, Halloween Gravestones, Pumpkin Candle[/b] and [b]Pumpkin Wall[/b] Decors can be obtained from Clown Supply Drops.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/bd1445f70b44b07a7a1e8e18d3a53aa09a2f92d4.jpg[/img]
[*]  [b]Clown Costume[/b]
        Can be obtained from defeating Pumpkin Soul Reapers at a low rate.

[*][b] Halloween Candy Grenade[/b]
 Throw various Halloween Candy Grenade at other Explorers to transform them into characters wearing various Halloween Masks! The effect lasts for ten minutes. They can be obtained from the Clown Supply Drop. [/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/3a82f9064f284e15d0541f5c9f047c81b11f5b5c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Close Event[/h3]
Close Autumn Event.

Happy Halloween!

notes.title: Pixark Patch 1.202 Autumn Reunion Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/35ee48914d5a3c567cee21d52ad8f7c3e8fdb030.jpg[/img]
[h3]Events[/h3]

[b]Osmanthus Tree Challenge[/b]
Autumn, the season of harvesting, is finally upon us and there are a lot of Osmanthus Trees blossoming on the land of Pixark. In China, it's customary to pick Osmanthus flowers and make Osmanthus drinks in autumn.

Grab the Wu Gang Axe (made in the Tailor's Workbench) to coollect from Osmanthus trees with your friends!

Osmanthus Trees can be found on Novice Grassland, Dawn Island, Grassland, and Woodland.
Explorers can obtain “Mooncake token”  from Osmanthus trees using a Wu Gang Axe 

Mooncake Tokens can be used to exchange gifts from the Mid-Autumn Festival Goblin Trading Center.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ea0211cb898525e3ce48873cfcd02653513de288.gif[/img]

[b]What’s THAT?! 
A [i]Lepursa[/i]?![/b]

Straight from the mad scientist's lair is a strange-looking creature with an equally strange name.  Its unique appearance makes it seem extra-terrestrial, but it shares some familiar features with other creatures. The Lepursa has never before been found in the wild. Although it appears to be a peaceful herbivore, the Lepursa possesses surprising combat expertise - especially after being fed carrots, which stimulate its potential and give it a burst of power. 

Defeating Pegasus, Icebear, Big-Ear Bunny will yield a 20% chance of dropping their respective DNA.
Combine the following DNAs together at the conjuring cooking pot(can be crafted at magic anvil bench) in order to summon the new Lepursa at a 60% chance:[list]
[*] 1 Pegasus DNA
[*] 2 Icebear DNA
[*] 5 Big-Ear Bunny DNA[/list]
Summoning has a 40% chance of failing and DNA will not be refunded in case of failure.Upon failure, one of the following creatures will be summoned instead:
 - Tamed Big-Ear Bunny
 - Tamed Pegasus
 - Tamed Icebear

notes.title: Voting Stage is HERE! Vote for your favorite new Creature !
notes.content:
Dear Explorers,
In the brainstorming phase of the event, we were thrilled to receive hundreds of ideas from enthusiastic explorers worldwide. After intense discussions, we have carefully selected five mysterious and powerful creatures that now have the chance to be implemented into the world of  PixARK.  In this voting stage, You will be able to vote for  2 of the following 5 candidates, and the one with the highest votes will join your adventure. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ed2f13e24bc5064f54fcf1da7936d80dd6e83d37.jpg[/img]


[h3]1.	Jirou Beetle -  The mighty beetle with Herculean strength[/h3]

[b]Introduction: [/b]A common giant beetle evolved by absorbing magical energy, possessing a hard shell and herculean strength. It can switch between bipedal and quadrupedal forms, has a violent temperament, and often conflicts with the Treants. 

[b]Taming Method: [/b]The Jirou Beetle is quite fond of honey jam made from magical tree resins. First, use bug repellent on yourself, then lure Jirou Beetle with the honey jam from behind. Next, slowly gaining its trust by feeding it the honey jam, and increasing the taming effectiveness by battling with the Treants. 

[b]Unique Feature: [/b]Its feces can accelerate the growth of magical plants, increasing their attack speed and damage. 

[b]Combat Ability: [/b]Can switch between attack and defense forms, with attacks that include knockback effects, and defense that is immune to most knockbacks.


[h3]2.	Saurolophus  - The swift and powerful hadrosaurid[/h3]

[b]Introduction: [/b]A herbivorous hadrosaurid dinosaur. Its large size, strong carrying capacity, and fast movement speed make it an excellent carrying mount.It will attack humans and small to medium-sized carnivores that get too close but will flee from larger carnivores.

[b]Taming Method: [/b]First bring a group of at least 5 tamed parasaurs to the Saurolophus to gain its trust, and you can feed it with Saurolophus Kibble made from 50  wheat, 10 thatch, and 20 carrots. After eating, it will roam around without attacking any creatures. You need to protect it from harm for a certain period. After the timer ends, feed it another batch of Saurolophus Kibble to tame it. 

[b]Unique Feature: [/b]Reduces inventory weight, can carry even more with saddle equipped.

[b]Combat Ability: [/b]Can bite, shoulder tackle, assume a defensive stance, and roar to boost ally defense and scare off wild creatures.


[h3]3.	Anomalocaris - The ancient predator of the primordial seas[/h3]

[b]Introduction: [/b]Anomalocaris was one of Earth's earliest dominant predators, ruling the ancient oceans 500 million years ago, long before the dinosaurs appeared. It had a pair of stalked eyes, a large mouth with circularly arranged teeth, giant segmented forelimbs for capturing prey, and rows of side plates for swift swimming. Its striking tail fin and long tail fork enabled it to turn flexibly in water. In Pixark, while it's not the top predator, its swift swimming and formidable attack abilities ensure it holds its own in the perilous ocean environment.

[b]Taming Method:[/b] Use a tamed large marine creature to approach Anomalocaris which will immediately start to attack.  During the process, Anomalocaris may trigger a parasitic skill, attaching to the large marine creature. At this point, players can approach and feed it. After feeding, it will detach and start attacking again. Repeat this process to tame Anomalocaris.

[b]Unique Feature:[/b] Shoulder pet; it can cling to the player’s shoulder, significantly increasing swimming speed and mobility. Its shared-breathing feature allows the player to avoid consuming oxygen underwater and prevents the creature from suffocating on land. In addition, its chromatic camouflage reduces the detection range from wild animals by making the player and Anomalocaris semi-transparent. 

[b]Combat Ability: [/b]Can bite, swipe, entangle, and use chromatic camouflage to lower detection chances.


[h3]4.	Stormweaver - The arachnid master of storms[/h3]

[b]Basic Introduction: [/b]The Stormweaver is a magical beast resembling a giant jumping spider with wind attributes It is incredibly agile and has excellent jumping ability, occasionally using wind magic to fly. Typically, it doesn't attack players or most ordinary creatures but preys on small magical beings, especially those rich in magical stone essences. It has three magic slots on its back, storing wind element energy for three tornadoes. After taming, players can place various elemental cores in these slots to release different types of tornadoes. 

[b]Taming Method:[/b] First, lure the Stormweaver to release all its wind energy. Then, approach it and feed it magic stones. Once it is full, embed three elemental cores into its slots to complete the taming process. The cores can be of wind, water, fire, earth, or lightning attributes. The type of core used during taming determines the tornado attribute it can release. Once embedded, cores cannot be removed or replaced.

[b]Unique Feature: [/b]It possesses levitation and wind abilities, providing a tailwind buff for allies. 

[b]Combat Ability:[/b] bite, air cannons, wind shields, gusts, and storm tornadoes for attack and defense.


[h3]5.	Luminara -  The radiant avian beacon of light[/h3]

[b]Introduction: [/b]Luminara was created by extracting DNA from various creatures such as Argentavis, Gryphons, bone creatures, and ghost dragons, then mutating it with cobalt energy to form a new prototype creature with powerful radiation abilities. When Luminara stays in one place for an extended period, it transforms the land into cobalt land. Initially, the cobalt aliens planned to use these birds to transform the entire land of Pixark. However, they discovered that the land reverted back after Luminara left, leading them to abandon the plan. As a result, the remaining Luminaras were left on Skyward.

[b]Taming Method: [/b]Defeat wild Luminara in a battle to obtain them in egg form. The eggs will hatch and bond with you, resulting in a domesticated Luminara with the same attributes as the wild one. 

[b]Unique Feature: [/b]
-	Immortal: transforms into a glowing egg when HP drops to 0, which can be hatched again. 
-	Radiation: converts plant seeds in its inventory into irradiated seeds, greatly increasing plant yield. 

[b]Combat Ability:[/b] peck, cobalt energy beams, and cobalt energy fields to boost attack and defense, causing radiation damage.

[h3]You can open the following link to cast your vote: [/h3]

 English Region ：[url=https://forms.gle/DrFTUTui3gFUEMN3A]https://forms.gle/DrFTUTui3gFUEMN3A[/url]

Again, thank you to all the explorers who participated in this exciting event! Your enthusiasm and involvement have been truly remarkable. We greatly appreciate your support in helping to shape the future of PixARK. We eagerly await the final results and are excited to see which creatures will join us on this adventurous journey. Your votes will bring new life and excitement to our game, and we can't wait to share the next chapter with you. Stay tuned for the announcement of the winner!

notes.title: Pixark Patch 1.198 Summer's Day
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/24cee6d262355c0517d03e52f58caab05d2ac91c.jpg[/img]

As the sun blazes high and the days grow longer, we’re excited to bring back our summer events!  This update is all about embracing the joys of summer with a wave of exciting new content, sizzling adventures, and refreshing changes that will make your gaming experience even more enjoyable. Let’s dive into the highlights of this sun-soaked update!

[h3]New Creature：Ice Demon Scorpion[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/deb885a798cbd16833a04bd5659ca7e77f83c014.png[/img]
The Ice Demon corpion is a scorpion-like magical beast that dwells in extremely cold regions. Despite its small size, it possesses formidable strength. Its large pincers serve as both powerful weapons for attacking and shields for defending against frontal assaults. The most threatening aspect of the Ice Demon Scorpion is its tail, which can shoot icicle needles.
This creature is imbued with a significant amount of ice element, causing those who approach it to feel an intense chill. Riders must take precautions to stay warm while riding the Ice Demon Scorpion.
One notable weakness of the Ice Demon Scorpion is its inability to move while firing icicle needles. Clever fighters often exploit this flaw to defeat the otherwise mighty creature in battle.

[b]Skills[/b]
LMB：Regular attack. In turret mode, the attack transforms into icicle needle attacks, consuming ice magic stone essence which can be obtained by combining ice and water magic stone within Ice Demon Scorpion’s inventory.
RMB：Toggle into turret mode where regular attacks will transform into icicle needle attacks.
C Button：Adds an ice claw buff where all damages taken by the claws are reduced by half. Regular attacks will have a chance to slow the enemies.

[b]Special Abilities[/b]
1. Increase heat resistance to all players nearby, while reducing the cold resistance.
2. Consumables such as food  in the inventory spoil slower

[b]Spawn Locations：[/b]
Pixark：Frozen Land
Skyward：Crystal Island

[b]Change in Reindeer spawn locations：[/b]
Pixark：Mountian Forest
Skyward：Woodlands 

[h3]Holiday Dodo is BACK![/h3]
Players can obtain Casual Beachwear/Crab Beachwear/Beach Lounger upon defeating Holiday Dodos at:

Pixark：Novice Grassland/Grassland
Skyward：Dawn Island/Woodland

[h3]New Items[/h3]
1. New potion “Great Beast Serum” :

Introducing the Great Beast Serum in ARK defending challenge mode. It is  a potent concoction extracted from the blood of various creatures. This mixed serum can significantly enhance the strength and abilities of dinosaurs, making them even more formidable in battle.

Players can craft it at the ARK tower in the defending challenge with: 
- Dilophosaurus Venom x5
- Mantis Shell x5
- Argentavis Feather x1
- Rex Skull x1
- Werewolf blood x1

BUFF：Using this serum increases the attack power and damage resistance of all tamed dinosaurs near the player by 50%. The effect lasts for 120 minutes. However, this serum can only be used in the ARK Defending Challenge. Upon leaving the Ark Tower, both the serum and its buff will be removed. Each player can craft only one bottle of this serum every 24 hours.

2. Ice Demon  Scorpion Saddle - can be learned at lv70.

[h3]Event Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Closing Children’s Day event. 
[/list]

[h3]Optimization[/h3]
1. Fixed a UI display issue with multiple monitors. 
2. Increase the rewards from ARK Defending Challenges：
- Doubling Equipment Elemental crystal & Equipment Modification Core drop
- Increased drops of: 
[list]
[*] Goblin Wonder Cabin
[*] Goblin King Wonder Cabin
[*] Goblin Summon Scroll
[*] Goblin King Summon Scroll
[*] Werewolf light tower
[*] Werewolf Summon Scroll
[*] Giganotosaurus skin
[*] Cobalt Turret
[*] Cobaltenergy Golem Hammer Summon Scroll
[/list]

[h3]BUG Fixes[/h3]
1. Fixed an issue with tek pillar placement & disappearing issue
2. Fixed an issue with saddles wrongly showing up in the dyeing menu.

[h3]Enable Double Drop Rate[/h3]

[h3]A Thank You[/h3]

We really appreciate all of the participation we have received on the Community Creature Contest so far! Keep up the great suggestions. You have a full month from the announcement posting date, which hopefully gives you plenty of time to brainstorm and share your best community creature creations.

[h3]Helpful Links[/h3]
If you haven't seen the most recent Developer Run Community Creature Contest please check here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/593600/view/4202502468820035906?l=english
[url=https://discord.gg/JbgtNpasYw]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Pixark 1.193 White Day Patch Notes
notes.content:
Dear Explorers！ 

We've heard you loud and clear! The community's voice is incredibly important to us, and we're thrilled to announce that, due to popular demand, we're bringing the Valentine’s Day event back with a White Day twist! Your feedback, enthusiasm, and passion for the game have not gone unnoticed. We truly value your opinions and always look for ways to enhance your gaming experience. This is our way of saying thank you for your continued support and dedication. Stay tuned for more details, and get ready to dive back into the excitement. Let's create more unforgettable moments together!

We will be performing a scheduled maintenance on MAR 14, 2024 (UTC). Further details regarding the maintenance are listed below for your reference:

UTC (Universal Time Coordinated): MAR 14, 07:00 - 10:00
PST (Pacific Standard Time): MAR 14, 0:00 - 3:00
EST (Eastern Standard Time): MAR 14  3:00 -6:00
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/277508764488a76f83b51432a6841ec538cb5472.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Items：[/h2]
The following White Day Style Decors can be obtained from:
    - defeating pink slimes at the  Novice Grassland and the Dawn Island vvv
    - Supply Drops

[h3]White Day Style Structures[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/78d79b7f689fac30cca1bfbc633b61939d1b55a8.jpg[/img]

[h3]White Day Backpack[/h3]
You can use this item to change into a more festive look.
-	Consumable, stackable, permanent.
-	Festive look will expire in 30 mins
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/6e1ae25a5983543a51b32f039e34d9e24c3cbe4c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Don’t forget your old pal![/h2]
Pink Slime - can be found at the Novice Grassland and the Dawn Island. They can also be picked up and carried on top of your head!

Defeating it will drop Valentine’s Day/White Day items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/bf0f982560513da886b45d27d16da6dbe1bfa19f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Valentine’s Day avatars are BACK![/h2]
Pink slimes will appear at Novice Grassland and Dawn Island with a chance to drop Valentine’s Day avatars.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/1d2c3b70cccbabf5a14fecfd524cee9ce97f730d.jpg[/img]

We hope you’re as excited as we are for this new in-game event. As we continue down this pixelated path, we wanted to thank you again for your continued support of our game. PixARK is beloved by all of us and we look forward to sharing with you our plans for the future! But for now, enjoy this mouth watering adventure.

Stay Sweet!
-	The PixARK Team

notes.title: Dinos vs. Robots Fest, Mod Editor, and More!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/8e77b2fde18f9c43b6a2ebfc003e0cda73de81c1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Pixark: Dinos Vs. Robots Fest[/h2]
PixARK is majorly discounted from now until March 4th! For the love of Dinos and Robots, how many Robots do you think could take down one T-Rex? Let us know in the replies!

In other news the Mod Editor was updated. The developers have added all the new assets from 2021 onward. We hope you have enjoyed the community events and we’re looking forward to seeing even more community engagement on Steam. As always please report any bugs to the Bug Report Mega Thread and we will do our best to fix them promptly.

- The PixARK Community Team
