notes.title: Pixark 1.191 Lunar New Year Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Steam 1.191 Lunar New Year Patch Notes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/e2f6a1bb309b893e37e33f9ccc6d30150aa35de6.jpg[/img]

Every performance is a canvas where performers, adorned in elaborate costumes, embody the essence of their characters and deliver an aesthetic show. Build your unique stage with your friends, watch it come true, and let it take over you!

The content below can be crafted at the “Traditional Opera Style Shop,” which can be learned with lv9 primitive skill after purchasing the DLC. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/9434189b7cb32621436f1f2a802545b9ec197b8b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ff098532b753614873d6dff28402fe9a8d131e64.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Boss：[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/bfd70a23c1996cf9048d67408ac0b654f6f2b972.jpg[/img]

Great Nian Beast

The Great Nian Beast is a special kind of Nian beast that only appears during the Chinese New Year. It is much larger and stronger than the ordinary Nian beasts, and has the ability to weaken opponents with fear, ignite, slow and exhaust. It will also buff itself with "Inferno"and "Eternal Night" upon taking damage. However, such a powerful creature is only afraid of the traditional Chinese dragon lantern. Explorers can negate most of the debuff by carrying the dragon lantern to challenge it, and you will also deal increased damage and receive decreased damage.

Skills：
1、Swipe： Regular attack
2、Heavy Slam: Slams the ground with its paws, knocking back enemies. 
3、Soul of the Nian Beast: Releases Soul of the NIan Beast to attack the enemies in front, dealing “fear” debuff along the way. (Immune to Dragon Lantern and players carrying dragon lantern)
4、Dance of Blessing: A special kind of dance among the Nian Beasts, which will buff itself with “Force of the Nian,” increasing its damage while taking less damage. It will reflect a portion of the melee damage taken to the attacker. Dragon Tail Lantern can eliminate this buff.
5、Flamethrower: Deals damage and applies an ignite DOT. The ignite DOT can spread among enemies during the “Force of the Nian” buff. (Immune to Dragon Tail Lantern and players carrying dragon tail lantern)
6、Outrage: Slams enemy multiple times and roars at the very end. Each slam deals damage, and slows enemy if it has the “Force of the Nian” buff. The roar decreases enemy attack damage, and decreases enemy defense if it has the “Force of the Nian” buff.   (Immune to Dragon Lantern and players carrying dragon lantern)

Boss will buff itself with “Inferno” during the second phase, which will increase its damage.
Boss will buff itself with “Eternal Night” during the third phase, which will increase its damage while taking less damage. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/2bf8f91ded63ba48be137039c59cf618f2b30ad6.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] It is not easy to challenge the Great Nian Beast, but it is  afraid of Dragon Lanterns. Brave Explorers can take on the challenge by performing the traditional Chinese "Dragon Lantern Dance."
[*] Players can obtain Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail by defeating Nian Beasts at Novice Grassland, Grassland, Dawn Island and Woodland.
[*] Players can initiate the Challenge at the Dragon Lantern Stand.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/7aa0bb371128069f738e220adda205fc04f632a8.jpg[/img]
[i]Rules:[/i]
[list]
[*] Players will need to raise different types of Dragon Lanterns in a “Head-Body-Tail” order to initiate the Challenge.
[*] Only the player holding the Dragon Head Lantern can initiate the challenge.
[*] The first and the final position have to be “Head” and “Tail” respectively. However, there can be up to 5 players holding “Body” in between.
[/list]
[i]Challenge Requirements:[/i]
[list]
[*] At least lvl90 to initiate the challenge.
[*] Challenge can be done once per day.
[*] 1 player holding “Head only” will allow a total of 3 players and 7 creatures into the challenge.
[*] 3 players holding “Head-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 5 players and 8 creatures into the challenge.
[*] 5 players holding “Head-Body-Body-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 8 players and 13 creatures into the challenge.
[*] 7 players holding “Head-Body-Body-Body-Body-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 12 players and 19 creatures into the challenge.
[/list]
[i]Loots: [/i]
[list]
[*] Lantern Dragon (Single Seat) at 100% chance, and another one at a small chance.
[*] Red Tassel Gold Lance at a small chance
[*] 50-100 Red Packets
[*] Chainmail avatar pieces at a small chance.
[*] Daeodon Food Recipe (can increase the effectiveness of the healing ability, and lower food consumption, doesn't work in boss arena)
[/list]

[h3]Old Items ARE BACK![/h3]

Nian Beast Avatar
Can be exchanged for at New Year Goblin Trading Center with red packets.
Head：300 Red Packets
Top：200 Red Packets
Bottom：150 Red Packets
Gloves：150 Red Packets
Shoes：150 Red Packets

[b]New Year Avatar Set - Chainmail[/b]
Can be exchanged for at New Year Goblin Trading Center with red packets.
[list]

[/list]

Copper quality

[b]Dragon Lantern Stand:[/b]
Can be used to start the Great Nian Beast Challenge with:
[list]

[/list]

Can be exchanged for at New Year Goblin Trading Center with 300 Red Packets..
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/65b634ee089b013cc899723f1db75c12fb3da48d.jpg[/img]

[b]Dragon Head/Body/Tail Lantern[/b]
[list]
[*] Defeating Nian Beast will drop Dragon Lantern parts (Head/Body/Tail) at 20% chance.
[*] Dragon Head Lantern: Players can raise the Dragon Head Lantern to deal damage to the Great Nian Beast. (Expires in 6 hours)

Lantern Dragon can have up to 5 seats as you put more parts in!

notes.title: Pixark 1.190 Christmas Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/76ef340789c44ad725ef910864c5fe233cbd0cee.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Gameplay[/h3]
Puzzle Challenge
Puzzle pieces are scattered all over the PixARK world. Challenge yourself to find the pieces and complete the puzzle!
Win Christmas rewards after completing the puzzle!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/1febbaaa6e396757b0052ddf9063eb7943d25132.jpg[/img]

Rewards
Tyrannosaurus Rex Christmas skin
Tyrannosaurus Rex Christmas saddle skin
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/faf040b62824e7c1cccf2f6414e3c45c8e89d8fc.jpg[/img]
Christmas doll suit
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/70b5715ce340f891b93017f920bbea3cc7502bb3.jpg[/img]

How to get puzzle pieces
There are a total of 16 puzzle pieces. There is a chance to obtain different pieces in different ways:
Pieces 1 to 10:Participate in snowball fights, mining Christmas snow blocks, and killing creatures wearing Christmas hats.
Pieces 11 to 13:Search airdrop supply boxes.
Pieces 11 to 16:Defeat bosses (Death, Bone Dragon King, Mammoth, Megalodon).

Tips:
Once puzzle is completed, face to the puzzle frame and long press E to get rewards,  tribemates nearby can also get rewards. One competed puzzle frame can only get rewards for once, you can get more rewards by compete another frame.

Other ways to get puzzle pieces
You can also use other puzzle pieces to exchange for puzzle piece packs at the Christmas elf station. The pack can randomly give you a puzzle piece (pieces 11 to 16).
Puzzle piece pack: Redeem with 100 of puzzle pieces of any type.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/a33f4068eb754109669ad8c5a2a4b008c51527d2.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Function for LAN game:[/h3]
Added an option for the building irregular placement mode in LAN game.
When creating a LAN game, select this option to enable irregular building placement. Buildings (foundations, walls, and ceilings) then can be spliced together without conforming the original placement rules.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/93031c1d664da56e0c5f82339e48bc95ad304ea0.jpg[/img]

[h3]Snow Devil is Back![/h3]
The legend has it that the horrifying Snow Devil was born in the land of sheer cold. The perpetual blizzard grants it endless power, allowing it to cast many powerful spells.

[b]Skills:[/b]
[u][i]Snowball:[/i][/u]
Activating blizzard energy and firing a gigantic snowball from its chest to attack the enemy from a long distance, dealing damage, and lowering enemy speed and cold resistance.
[u][i]Blizzard:[/i][/u]
Rotating its body and releasing a snow tornado to attack enemies, dealing damage, and lowering enemy speed and cold resistance.
[u][i]Snow Pillar:[/i][/u]
Summoning a snow pillar to attack enemies on the ground.
[u][i]One-Punch Devil:[/i][/u]
Gathering energy to its right fist and punching enemies afront, dealing damage, and lowering enemy speed and cold resistance.

[u]Special Abilities:[/u]
Player’s cold resistance is reduced and heat resistance is increased within 50 meters of Snow Devil. The closer the player gets to the Snow Devil, the stronger the effect.
Snow Devil generates an aura of cold air beneath its foot when its HP is under 50%, dealing damage and lowering speed and cold resistance to enemies who touch it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/cd318331f04dbd9d1006278b9ca8356d2bfec43d.gif[/img]

Players can start the Snow Devil challenge by placing “Snow Devil Doll” at the Christmas Fireplace. A Christmas fireplace can be obtained at the Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 200 Christmas tokens. The Snow Devil Doll has a chance of dropping from Christmas gift boxes.
[u]
Challenge Prerequisites[/u]
[list]
[*] Character level ≥90
[*] A maximum of 10 creatures
[*] A maximum of 5 players
[*] Note: Each character can challenge Snow Devil only once per day.
[/list]
[u]Boss Loot[/u]
[i]Small chance of obtaining following skins:[/i]
[list]
[*] Christmas Dodo Skin
[*] Christmas Pteranodon Skin
[*] Christmas Iguanodon Skin
[*] Christmas Gryphon Skin
[*] Christmas Megarock Dragon Skin
[/list]
[i]and a small chance of obtaining following items:[/i]
[list]
[*] Christmas Cape (Limited)
[*] Christmas Cape (Permanent)
[*] Christmas Reindeer Sleigh
[*] 300-600 Christmas Tokens
[*] Tek Storage Box Blueprint
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/02537fa9cca6ec86d063b1247dc51c14445800f9.jpg[/img]


[h2]Old Events are BACK!
[/h2][h3]Christmas Blessing Tree[/h3]

Decorating a Christmas Tree with various decorations will grant you a Christmas Blessing buff. The Christmas Tree can be acquired with Christmas Tokens at the Christmas Goblin Trade Center. Decorating the tree with Christmas Dolls in five unique colors, will gift players the Christmas Blessing and a Christmas Gift Box.

Christmas Gift Box may contain one or more of the following items:
[list]
[*] Rocking Reindeer
[*] Christmas Painting
[*] Christmas Curtain
[*] Snow Devil Doll
[/list]

[b]Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Christmas Dolls may be obtained by looting Snowman.
[*] Christmas Goblin Trade Center can be obtained by looting Goblins wearing a Christmas Hat or from the Christmas Supply Drop.
[*] Christmas Tokens can be harvested from Snow Cubes in Christmas Blizzard
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/98501877c54eeb393bf3ef7db651cff7de5fceb9.jpg[/img]

[b]Snowman Fight[/b]
Snowmen will spawn in Noviceland, Grassland, Dawn island, and Woodland. Players will need to craft Snowballs to attack the Snowmen, which will drop one or more following items:
[list]
[*] Christmas Candy
[*] Christmas Dolls (50% drop rate)
[*] Snowman Figure
[*] Snowman Costumes
[*] Christmas Token
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/eaa8bf8c80316961635c7002cdf1581b9c51e8f9.jpg[/img]

[b]Red Hat Creatures[/b]

Christmas Red Hats have a small chance of dropping from any creature wearing them. Creatures wearing Christmas Red Hats may also drop Christmas Tokens!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/25d3ceda09b83e62ae29e945fadca4592b0fa97a.png[/img]
		
[b]Christmas Supply Drop[/b]
Santa will be riding his Reindeer Sleigh to give away some gifts! Christmas Supply Drop may contain following items:
[list]
[*] Christmas Paintings (small chance)
[*] Christmas Candy
[*] Christmas Fireworks
[*] Christmas Cape (Limited)  (small chance)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d6ab812d4685e8f70a81fcaf75f0b8388fdf9354.png[/img]

[b]Christmas Snowy Biomes[/b]

A majority of the biomes will be enjoying snowy views. During snowy seasons, some biomes might experience a “Christmas Blizzard”. Explorers digging blizzard snow cubes in Christmas Snowy biomes will have a chance of obtaining Christmas Tokens, Christmas Blizzard Snow Cube and Christmas Candy.

[b]Rate Boosts:[/b]
Double Harvest Rates on ores
Higher Exp from defeating Snowmen.

[h3]New Items:[/h3]
[b]Snowman Costume[/b]
[list]
[*] can be exchanged at Christmas Goblin Trading Center at 150 Christmas Tokens each.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/bd7c5a228bfde6b7cf6004db216436454bc75882.jpg[/img]


[h2]Missed Old Christmas Items? They are BACK![/h2]
[b]Christmas Goblin Trade Center[/b]
[list]
[*] Can be obtained by defeating Snowman or from Supply Drops.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/bd8502b6115a26fa2521ee21b2343930593aece5.jpg[/img]

[b]Christmas Reindeer Costume[/b]
[list]
[*] Can be purchased from Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 500 Christmas Tokens.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/31be07954bc87c20a81deebfff303bd983cc9be7.jpg[/img]

[b]Christmas Treant Costume[/b]
[list]
[*] Can be purchased from Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 500 Christmas Tokens.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/f589476d6586e1691ac3f825a49bc04a4bafc89d.jpg[/img]

[b]Christmas Reindeer Sleigh Saddle[/b]
Equipping it on a Reindeer allows one player to ride on it and fly across the map. With the Reindeer Christmas Platform Saddle, players can place up to 50 structures behind it. It can be purchased from Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 2000 Christmas Tokens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d9336d40134ae9af5b791701f1cb7742f4981058.jpg[/img]

[b]Christmas Hat[/b]
Players can get in the Christmas Spirit with these Christmas Hats! They can be purchased from the Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 200 Christmas Tokens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/924dae4b2c84b00f90243837a1cb7a4d06b9f1c4.jpg[/img]

[b]Rocking Reindeer[/b] - Drop rate of 10% from Christmas Tree Gift Boxes.
[b]Christmas Paintings[/b] - Drop rate of 40% from Christmas Tree Gift Boxes.
[b]Christmas Curtain[/b] - Drop rate of 30% from Christmas Tree Gift Boxes and Supply Drops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/4cf2d1742d11cdd8f410363e95e0e36fa91f79ef.jpg[/img]

[b]Christmas Fireplace[/b]
[list]
[*] Obtained from the Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 200 Christmas Tokens
[*] Placing a “Snow Devil Doll” at the Christmas Fireplace will start the Snow Devil Challenge
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ef794a8655492dcd10c2f95b1b1e2f968cf9e44d.jpg[/img]

[b]Snow Devil Doll[/b]
[list]
[*] Used at Christmas Fireplace to start the Snow Devil Challenge
[*] Can also be used as a Holiday Decor
[*] Can be obtained from Christmas Gift Box
[/list]   

[b]Creature Christmas Skins[/b]
All of the following skins have a chance of dropping upon defeating the Snow Devil Challenge, They can be purchased from Christmas Goblin Trade Center with Christmas Tokens:
[list]
[*] Christmas Dodo Skin (100 tokens)
[*] Christmas Pteranodon Skin (200 tokens)
[*] Christmas Iguanodon Skin (200 tokens)
[*] Christmas Gryphon Skin (400 tokens)
[*] Christmas Megarock Dragon Skin (400 tokens)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/0f292e6078ab985f6af9b842af345cd243f6759f.jpg[/img]

[b]Christmas Cape[/b]
Christmas Cape (Limited) can be obtained either from defeating the Snow Devil or from Christmas supply drops at a small chance.
Christmas Cape (Permanent) can be obtained by defeating the Snow Devil at a small chance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/3748cb41dff1be534350474b372fc245d1ea65ed.gif[/img]

Run into bugs? Help us squash them by reporting any bugs or issues here: 
http://bit.ly/2YMJQ3x

notes.title: Pixark 1.188 Thanksgiving Patch
notes.content:
[h2]Steam Pixark 1.188 Thanksgiving Patch Notes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/003ff92c0583aa572892a88dd8a9da5de667dbca.jpg[/img]

Added "Creative Mode" in LAN game.
You can now enter the Creative Mode in LAN game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d2018fe46e6766f85a3f96f1970962c287728f4f.jpg[/img]

The host will be in Creative Mode by default, and press Esc and choose Host Administration to manage other players and activate/deactivate their creative mod.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/4ccd3d3c0dd88e34792434c4b0ee3a7a7928afc1.jpg[/img]

[h3][u]Thanksgiving Gameplay[/u] [/h3]

[b]Thanksgiving Banquet[/b]
Place six different Thanksgiving dishes on the Thanksgiving Dining Table, and then press E to enjoy the treat and be rewarded with the Thanksgiving Buff. Placing Roasted Turkey right at the center of the Thanksgiving Dining Table will bring something special to Explorers.

[b]Pardoned Turkey Event[/b]
In the Noviceland biome, Explorers may find wild Turkeys locked in cages. Players will need to break the cage to free the Turkeys. Once they are freed, Turkeys will drop Turkey eggs that provide rewards. 
While freeing the caged Turkeys, explorers have a 30% chance of running into special Pardoned Turkey. Killing the Pardoned Turkey will drop the event item “Turkey Feather,” which can be used to summon Dodorex.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ef1f35f83c40a8167bcefc768cde45ac55064029.jpg[/img]
[b]Turkey Challenge - Summoning Dodorex[/b]
[list]
[*] Upon collecting a certain amount of Turkey Feathers, explorers can use them to summon either a Dodorex (20 mins at 90% chance) or a Dodorex (Permanent at 10% chance) at a cooking pot.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ad2a513442da8aa5d7dced861e18d78dd74e7d33.gif[/img]

[b]Dodorex[/b]
In the world of Pixark, even the weakest and humblest beings have dreams of becoming something stronger. And the Dodo, who is bullied by everyone, may become an existence to be feared by everyone. Legend has it that some dodos with exceptional talent were blessed by the ancestors of the dodo family and evolved into the most powerful Dodorex. Of course the legend is just a legend, in fact, people believe that Dodorex may be the descendants of Tyrannosaurus rex genetically modified by aliens. The biggest basis for this idea is that people have not yet found evidence of the existence of wild Dodorex.
[list]
[*] Tamed Dodorex can bite (LMB) and shoot flames (RMB)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/c88c0fba5deb52109bcb0714fbea803189851320.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/5d5169b14791ea7318d9e9bb7c4f112e830d9ccb.jpg[/img]
[h3][u]Thanksgiving Items:[/u][/h3]
[b]Thanksgiving Decor:[/b]
May drop from the Supply Drop and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event:
[list]
[*] Thanksgiving Dining Table
[*] Thanksgiving Chair
[*] Thanksgiving Recliner
[*] Thanksgiving Curtain
[*] Thanksgiving Decor Balloon
[*] Thanksgiving Wall Decor
[/list]

[b]Thanksgiving Dishes[/b]
May drop from the Supply Drop and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event.
[list]
[*] Roasted Turkey
[*] Pumpkin Pie
[*] Beef Wellington
[*] Salad
[*] Brownie
[*] Sweet Potato
[/list]

[b]Thanksgiving Equipment Skin[/b]
[i]Turkey Hat[/i] 
May drop from the Supply Drop and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/4a7a70e9475e13987f10a887cf85c41df9a1aa80.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/cc721c29e76af5eb7af4e0cece32fdab9d81f35a.png[/img]

[i]Drum-Stick[/i]
May drop from the Supply Drop and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event.

[i]Farmer’s Fork[/i]
May drop from the Supply Drop and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/c7aecb317cc79aa89a5b07515bea029f94854f27.jpg[/img]
[i]Dodo Chief Hat
[/i]Can be crafted using 30 Turkey Feathers at Tailor’s Workbench.
Can only be equipped on Dodorexes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ff1091019ac6b4ea586dc8ae29ce3a67f11fcd73.jpg[/img]

[h3][u]Others[/u] [/h3]
End Halloween Events except the event relate to the summon of skeleton horse.

[h3][u]BUG Fixes[/u] [/h3]
1. Fix the issue where the wood ceiling can't be placed.
2. Fix the issue where under some certain circumstance player respawn with low health/food.

Run into bugs? Help us squash them by reporting any bugs or issues here: 
http://bit.ly/2YMJQ3x

notes.title: Steam 1.185 Halloween Patch Notes
notes.content:
Dear Explorers！ 
We are bringing you our Halloween Patch! Happy Halloween! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/543c9189983e769e1e4466d6d17d9488fc41600c.jpg[/img]
New Creatures:

Carcharodontosaurus 
The Carcharodontosaurus lived in North Africa during the Cretaceous period and earned its name due to its tooth shape resembling that of a shark. This species was a massive and fierce predator, possibly even more formidable than the larger Spinosaurus that coexisted in the same region. In the world of Pixark, the Carcharodontosaurus is considered a top-tier predator that rivals the Giganotosaurus in power. It shares a massive size and a more aggressive nature, especially when it enters the special "Bloodlust" state. It is easier to control compared to the Giganotosaurus. However, it is less powerful than the Giganotosaurus in terms of stats, and it cannot enter most challenges. To date, no wild Carcharodontosaurus has been discovered in the world of Pixark; all known domesticated Carcharodontosaurus are hatched from eggs obtained by challenging the Mega Carcharodontosaurus.

Its eggs can be obtained by challenge the new BOSS Mega Carcharodontosaurus.

New BOSS:
Mega Carcharodontosaurus 
A colossal and likely genetically modified or enhanced dinosaur, the Mega Carcharodontosaurus is significantly more potent than its regular counterpart. It possesses a more aggressive temperament, and anyone attempting to challenge it must be well-prepared, as the Mega Carcharodontosaurus is one of the most dangerous creatures in Pixark. Defeating it will drop a fertilized Mega Carcharodontosaurus egg with random levels.

Ability 1: Normal Attack, inflicting a "Shredded" state on enemies for 9 seconds (reduces HP regen and stamina).
Ability 2: Tail swing,  inflicting a knockback effect.
Ability 3: War Cry, activated in the second phase. The Mega Carcharodontosaurus lets out a roar that induces "Fear" in nearby dinosaurs and starts accumulating the "Bloodlust" state over the next 30 seconds. For every 20,000 damage dealt, it gains 1 point of "Bloodlust" and also receives a 10-second "Rampage" effect. Each point of "Bloodlust" increases its attack by 5%, and HP regen by 1 per second. When the "Bloodlust" reaches the maximum, it will deal x1.5 damage and an HP regen of 10 points per second. "Rampage" grants the Mega Carcharodontosaurus approximately a 20% increase in movement speed and enhanced stun resistance.

Can be challenge at Ancient Wyvern King Challenge Gate.

New Creatures:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d86875553cd6cd2674b60c2d535e1973b5d23f95.jpg[/img]
Yutyrannus
The Yutyrannus is a large carnivorous dinosaur that lived in ancient China during the Cretaceous period. It was one of the largest predators in the region and was well-adapted to cold environments with its feathers. In the world of Pixark, its long feathers covering its head and neck make it very majestic and stand out. Besides its formidable strength, its unique roar plays a significant role in battles.

Spawn biomes: Frozen Land, Crystal Island

Prairie Dog
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/17d6b0d80071be9b186cbc3376f44b25e48cbc3b.jpg[/img]
The prairie dog is a highly social, burrowing rodent known for its stout and slow-moving build. Despite being physically small and vulnerable to numerous natural predators, prairie dogs exhibit a high level of alertness. When they live in colonies, they often designate sentinels to stand guard and alert the group to potential threats. In the world of Pixark, prairie dogs still occupy a low position in the food chain. However, they serve a valuable role when tamed by humans. Tamed prairie dogs can help alert players to nearby threats, including dangerous creatures or other rival players, by using different alert sounds. Additionally, some players enjoy keeping prairie dogs as pets on their heads whose loud warning sounds can temporarily scare away any approaching enemy. 

Spawn biomes: Woodland, Grassland

[h3]Old Creatures Come Back![/h3]
[b]Skeleton Horse[/b]

It is a skeleton war horse burning with the flames of hell. Legend has it that the skeleton horse is the mount of the knight of hell, and is the most reliable partner of the knight. It can fly to the sky and dive into the sea like walking on the ground, and the energy from hell also gives it the power of eternal life.

[u]Left click[/u] -  Normal attack

[u]Right click[/u]- Sacrifice: unleashes the flames of hell to inflict continuous damage to enemies within a certain range (damage value correlates to the HP of the  enemy, while damage upper limit correlates to the percentage of melee damage of the skeleton horse)

[u]'C' button[/u] - path of flame, activates its own hell energy, increases its own movement speed  by 50% and melee damage by 30%. Moving will leave a hell flame in place, enemies near the hell flame will take continuous damage (1-50 dmg/0.5 sec)

[i]Fire creatures are immune to the above skills[/i]

[u]Magical Crystal Berry: [/u]The food favored by skeleton horses that replenish their hell energy.  It can be crafted at magic workbench with a dark Magic Stone and a magic berry. 

[b]Where to find it? [/b]
[list]
[*] Skeleton Horse (permanent) can be summoned at “Conjuring Cooking Pot” at 70% chance with:
[list]
[*]  1x Breath Of the Dead
[*]  1x Pegasus DNA
[*]  2x Felhunter DNAs
[*]  5x Scent of the Pumpkin Soul Reaper
[/list]
[*] Upon failing, you will get a tamed Pegasus or a Felhunter.
[*] Defeating following monsters/BOSS will drop the corresponding items:
[list]
[*] Pegasus: Pegasus DNA at 20% chance, 
[*] Pumpkin Soul Reaper:  Scent of the Pumpkin Soul Reaper at 20% chance
[*] Felhunter:  Felhunter DNA at 20% chance 
[*] Death Lord (Boss)/ Bone Wyvern King (Boss): Breath of the Dead at 100% chance.
[/list][/list]Note：
[olist]
[*] “Conjuring Cooking Pot” can be crafted at magic workbench. 
[*] Breath of the Dead can be exchanged with 40  Scents of the Pumpkin Soul Reaper at the Conjuring Cooking Pot.  
[/olist]

Skeleton horse is endowed with strong vitality. Like any other bone creatures, it can resurrect as well.  It can be resurrected at the Conjuring Cooking Pot with 50 Magic Stone of any of the following types: Dark, Fire, Water, Thunder, Light, Earth, and Wind
[u]
Skeleton Horse Saddle:[/u]
Can be exchanged at tailor’s workbench with pumpkins. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/267ca412d493495947fac766e301e3098b982d54.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/a882752200f6fd9110632a9e312d9d69306c7704.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/e02c3890d3a4c72b4df0e2ee0b5c0233c98f6bb7.gif[/img]

[h3]THEY ARE BACK!![/h3]
Upon the arrival of Halloween, so do all those naughty Pumpkin Soul Reapers out there trick or treating. Hurry up and fight them off! 

During the event, Pumpkin Soul Reaper can be found in:
[u]Pixark[/u]: Novice Grassland, Grassland
[u]Skyward:[/u] Dawn Island, Woodland, and Void

Defeating it will drop:
[b]Scent of the Pumpkin[/b]
[b]Pumpkin Seed[/b]
[b]Magic Broom[/b] (7 days)
[b]Flying Firework[/b] (7 days)
[b]Clown Costume[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/e9ba5936c29ebd602db6add1e351fd404a973ab8.jpg[/img]

[h3]Gameplay:  The Great Pumpkin Battle![/h3]

With Halloween fast approaching, we need plenty of pumpkins not only to decorate our homes but also to use them to exchange gifts! Hurry up and call your buddies to plant pumpkins together!

[b]Pumpkin seeds:[/b]
Defeating Pumpkin Soul Reapers will drop pumpkin seeds, which can be used to plant pumpkins.

Pumpkins can be exchanged for various Halloween gifts at the Tailor’s  Workbench

[h3]Costumes! [/h3]

New skeleton costume set can be exchanged at the Tailor’s Workbench with: 
[u]Hat[/u]：400  pumpkins
[u]Top[/u]：200 pumpkins
[u]Hand[/u]：100 pumpkins
[u]Bottom[/u]：200 pumpkins
[u]Foot[/u]：100 pumpkins
[u]Skeleton Horse Saddle[/u]：1000 pumpkins

Knight costume set can be exchanged at the Tailor’s Workbench with: 
[u]Hat[/u]：350  pumpkins
[u]Top[/u]：350 pumpkins
[u]Hand[/u]：150 pumpkins
[u]Bottom[/u]：250 pumpkins
[u]Foot[/u]：150 pumpkins
[u]Sword[/u]：700 pumpkins
[u]Shield[/u]：700 pumpkins

Remember the Scarecrow costume from before? They can be exchanged at 50% discount!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/74d3efc4b4bed3a5496822596722ac62e5f8e2b7.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d24310407b15373ad98197e08d25abfa2f2fcf0e.jpg[/img]

[h3]Old Events ARE BACK![/h3]
[olist]
[*] [b]Clown Supply Drops[/b] - Normal supply drops will turn into Clown Supply Drops. Explorers can obtain Halloween Decors and Halloween Candy Grenades at a chance from these drops.

[*] [b]Pumpkin Hat[/b]: Some creatures will be wearing Pumpkin Hats. There is a chance of them dropping the Hats that you can equip them on your tamed creatures.

[*] [b]Double Harvest rates on Ores and Exp rates[/b]
       Higher Exp from defeating Pumpkin Soul Reapers
[/olist]
[h3]Old Items ARE BACK! [/h3]
[olist]
[*] [b]Flying Firework[/b] (7 days)
 Can be obtained at a chance from defeating Pumpkin Soul Reapers. Expires in 7 days.

[*] [b]Flying Firework[/b] (permanent)
 Can be obtained at a small chance from defeating: Ancient Wyvern King, Aurora Butterfly King and Beach Bully.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/08c9010ea9e03547e00b53c34bb1d93062ec893c.jpg[/img]
 
[*] [b]Halloween Trees, Halloween Gravestones, Pumpkin Candle[/b] and [b]Pumpkin Wall[/b] Decors can be obtained from Clown Supply Drops.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/bd1445f70b44b07a7a1e8e18d3a53aa09a2f92d4.jpg[/img]
[*]  [b]Clown Costume[/b]
        Can be obtained from defeating Pumpkin Soul Reapers at a low rate.

[*][b] Halloween Candy Grenade[/b]
 Throw various Halloween Candy Grenade at other Explorers to transform them into characters wearing various Halloween Masks! The effect lasts for ten minutes. They can be obtained from the Clown Supply Drop. [/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/3a82f9064f284e15d0541f5c9f047c81b11f5b5c.jpg[/img]

Adjustments:
Adjusted the distance between players and the Ark Tower when entering the "Guardian Ark Tower" instance.
Extended the power supply time of the Alien Turret batteries to 1800 seconds.
Adjusted the Teck Saddle bullet time to 1 second.
Added an additional loot package for the final boss in the tower defense hard mode, Cobalt Star Commander. (Includes a saddle exclusive to the Southern Colossal Dragon, Cobalt Star Firepower Soldier Summon Scroll, and Cobalt Star Firepower Turret)

BUG Fixes:
Fixed the issue where equipment attributes did not function correctly after a character's revival.
Fixed the problem with the attributes number and value limits of the enchantment for some weapons.
Fixed the issue where players could gain extra points after leveling up while offline.
Fixed the incorrect damage types for Teck Swords and Teck Gauntlets.
Fixed the problem where items in the Ark inventory were not cleared after a tower defense event.

Happy Halloween!

notes.title: PixARK Patch 1.182 Children’s Day Event
notes.content:
Dear Explorers!

 We bring you our Children’s Day Event! Hopefully you will enjoy it! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/7705ccd42b336c1ba111a95e48d24d82a93dee32.jpg[/img]


[h2]Old Items Are BACK![/h2]

[h3] Children's Day Costumes! [/h3]

[b]Paperbox Head [/b]
- can be exchanged at Children’s Day Goblin Trading Center with 400 game coins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/b0fb8edd8587c8d85aed49bf28604da3ed107664.jpg[/img]

[b]Little Yellow Duckling Head[/b]
 - can be exchanged at Children’s Day Goblin Trading Center with 400 game coins.

[b] Rain boots [/b]
- can be exchanged at Children’s Day Goblin Trading Center with 400 game coins.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/43310ce7fbb9f8d0bdbc050e50e808c133f01565.jpg[/img]

[b]Fun Swing[/b]
  - Needs both Swing frame and Swing itself, which can be exchanged with 500 games coins each.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/c2947b96b0fb797e0b5486ccc7f591597b6dde25.gif[/img]

[b]Pirate Ship[/b]
  - Needs both Pirate Ship frame and Pirate Ship itself, which can be exchanged with 1200 game coins each.
  - Allows up to 4 players to board at the same time.
  - Electricity is required to power it up.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/61661f5c80bc03968db3f750b3335f0d05676591.gif[/img]

[b]Building Dyes: Shamrock/Parakeet/Seafoam/Mint/Pistachio[/b]

Seafoam and Pistachio will need to be exchanged with 50 game coins at the Children’s Day Goblin Trading Center.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/014b07af0c53ff5a2fc2b8003dd6aada29db717d.png[/img]

[b]Children’s Day Goblin Trading Center[/b]
- Can be obtained by defeating Goblins or Goblin Kings.
- Can also be obtained through Holiday supply drops.
- Used to exchange for Children’s Day event items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/9b3059e149c3579db7a38c6116b07ae13729bdba.jpg[/img]

[b]Children’s Day Costumes[/b]
- Hat: Can be obtained by hitting balloons during the event.
- Top, Leg, Boot, Gloves：Can be exchanged through Children’s Day Goblin Trading Center for 200 game coins each.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/69b3caed7bfcb1098275d74e2d8eea5b36af2bcf.jpg[/img]

[b]Children’s Day Pickaxe/Sickle/Axe[/b]
- Has the same harvest rate as an Iron tool.
- Can be crafted using resources and dyes in Tailor’s Workbench.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/73b9deac70bf39a992849bc02c2c17267efc95b7.jpg[/img]

[b]Carousel[/b]
- Can be exchanged at the Children’s Daily Goblin trading center with 2000 game coins.
- A maximum of 4 players can ride together at a time.
- Needs electricity to function.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/cf5e2725068063d1486de7b1f560af38f2a9fa5c.jpg[/img]

[b]Paintball gun[/b]
- Equip dyes to create graffiti art on floors/structures (not including creatures).
- Can be exchanged at the Children’s Daily Goblin trading center with 500 game coins.
- Graffiti lasts 30 minutes.
	
[b]Candy Bomb[/b]
- Throw different types of candy towards players to transform them into different characters.
- Can be obtained through Children’s Day Goblin Trading Center with 50 game coins.
- Transformation lasts 10 minutes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d248793a0b73a1e0a270347f36a4f1d1ff8b5bc4.jpg[/img]

[b]Candy Arrow[/b]
- New level 15 recipe
- Used to shoot balloons.
- Crafting materials: Flint, Wood, and Tintoberry

[h2]Old Events Are Back As Well![/h2]

[b]Balloon shooting[/b]
-Balloons will Spawn in Novice Grassland/Grassland/Dawn Island/Woodland.
- Must be shot down by Bows with Candy Arrows.
[u]Drops:[/u]
- Balloon Backpack (20% drop rate, lasts 30 minutes)
- Children’s Day Hat Costume (10% drop rate)
- 4-6 Game coins
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/a6ddc642be7749767f62a4ff9e33f1fc328ed9cd.gif[/img]

[b]Candy Supply Drops[/b]
- Supply Drops have a new look with Children’s Day items inside!
[u]Drops:[/u]
- Candy Bomb
- Children’s Day Goblin Trading Center

[b] Tiny Yellow Hat[/b]
Some of the wild creatures found in PixARK are wearing tiny yellow hats. Defeat them for a chance to grab a Tiny Yellow Hat for your own tames and 2-4 Game Coins.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/45e01eb3d62efb9caecd754bf3d1aa63c82d6e54.jpg[/img]

[b]Enabling double harvest rates [/b]

[h3]Changes/Optimization[/h3]
[list]
[*] The slots of Sweet Shop's inventory has been increased to 50.
[/list]

tags.feature: - Added three new playable heroes: Queen of Pain, Slark, and Templar Assassin
- Added the Highlights feature.

notes.title: PixARK Patch 1.180
notes.content:
[h2]Event Changes:[/h2]
Closing St. Patrick’s Day Events

[h2]Optimization:[/h2]
1．	Potions/Plants exchanged from the ARK Defending Challenge can no longer be taken out of the Challenge. 
2．	Defending Coins obtained from the ARK Defending Challenge can no longer be taken out of the Challenge. 
3．	Reduced the amount of Fungus Beast spawn in Hard mode. 
4．	Industrial Smelter can now produce glass. 

[h2]BUG Fixes:[/h2]
1．	Fixed an issue where creatures cannot be teleported out of the Challenge in Normal mode. 
2．	Fixed an issue where monsters can remain from the previous Challenge. 

[h2]Server Optimization Notice:[/h2]
In the interest of server optimization and increasing player density to encourage more interaction, we will be optimizing data for some servers with few player activities. Save files for these servers will be available soon to anyone wishing to download them for their own private servers. As an online multiplayer game, we hope that an increase in player density will enable explorers to interact with each other and enjoy the game together. 
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause you and thank you for your patience and understanding.
We will be optimizing data on the following servers 15 days after the announcement!
The following servers will be affected:
Asia-Chaos-skyward1
Asia-Chaos-skyward2
Asia-Chaos-theland1
Asia-Chaos-theland2

We will also be launching new seasoned PVP servers with regular wipes, more details will be announced later. We hope explorers will enjoy the game!

notes.title: Patch 1.177 St. Patrick's Day Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/29f7f2456bea9251d010dece4343caf82956c8ae.jpg[/img]
St. Patrick’s Day is upon us again! We are excited to bring back some of the classic events for our fellow Explorers to enjoy! 

[b]The patch is scheduled to go live tonight.[/b]

Servers will be down for a few hours to implement the following changes:

[h1]Old Items are back![/h1]
[list]
[*] Holiday Ribbon Cracker
[*] Balloon Arch
[*] St. Patrick’s Day Bed/table/chair/shelf/flower pot/painting
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/86c7ab9f557414460b9d427a2450aea7dc5a5aae.gif[/img]

* Can be exchanged for at St. Patrick’s Day goblin trading center with Shamrocks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/33f111f0347f771166a8bf61a7a1d21fdc808b4c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/78e4b740d8468ca849d8e6178f6709b2d42a4435.jpg[/img]

[h3]St. Patrick's Day Goblin Trading Center[/h3]
[list]
[*] Can be obtained by defeating Goblins or Goblin Kings
[*] Can also be obtained through Holiday supply drops
[*] Used to exchange for St. Patrick’s Day event items
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/bb4ae6602c3e9e6001d5766d476715f5dfa31018.jpg[/img]

[h3]St. Patrick’s Day Costumes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Hat: [/b]Can be obtained through St. Patrick’s Day Goblin Trading Center using 4-leaf clover
[*] [b]Top: [/b]Can be obtained through St. Patrick’s Day Wishing tree and red handkerchief event at a certain rate
[*] [b]Leg, Boot, Gloves: [/b]Can be obtained through St. Patrick’s Day Goblin Trading Center using Shamrocks
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/b4958397ac47bf50315519683ce597d9e5a908ce.jpg[/img]

[h3]St. Patrick’s Day Wishing Tree[/h3]
Obtained through St. Patrick’s Day Goblin Trading center. Upon tying Red Handkerchief (which is also obtained through St. Patrick’s Day Goblin Trading Center) to the tree, the following rewards can be obtained:
[list]
[*] St. Patrick’s Day Top avatar
[*] 4-leaf Clover
[*] Cobalt Organic Matter
[*] DarkGreen Creature Coloring
[*] Green Dye
[*] Dark Green Dye
[/list]

[h3]Shamrocks and 4-Leaf Clovers[/h3]
[list]
[*] Shamrock seeds can be obtained by harvesting regular grass using Parasaur/Iguanodon
[*] Planting the seed will either allow you to harvest Shamrocks or 4-leaf clovers
[*] Using greenhouse allows Shamrock seeds to grow much faster
[*] Can be used at St. Patrick’s Day goblin trading center to exchange event items
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d41efae489b4c3989774ca312bc9a878f4a8c192.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/e30d5a96f4a0645cebdb826a152da504def48d11.jpg[/img]

[h1]Additional Changes[/h1]
[h3]Supply drops will be Pot of Gold Shaped and contain:[/h3]
[list]
[*] St. Patrick’s Day Goblin Trading Center
[*] Red handkerchief
[/list]
[h3]Water will be turning green during the event![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/8540fd1876a25aafd9fe6219ba62e7b0eae0703a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Adjustments[/h1]
[list]
[*] Goblin King rewards can now have items with different qualities.
[*] Lowered the explosion damage dealt by Smallalarms in ARK Defending Challenge.
[*] Lowered the explosion damage dealt by the first Boss in ARK Defending Challenge Master mode.
[*] Increased duration&HP of magical plants in ARK Defending Challenge.
[*] Doubled defending coin in Master mode. 
[*] Increased defending coin drop in 5th round of Master mode. 
[*] In Master mode, Giganotosaurus, Rex, Rex(Golden Forest), Megarock Dragon, Spinosaurus and wyverns will deal 30% additional damage and receive 30% less damage.  
[*] Daeodon will deal 300%, 300%, 390% more damage in Beginner, Expert and Master mode respectively, and receive 95%, 95% and 96.5% less damage respectively.
[*] Nian Beast will deal 130%, 130%, 169% more damage in Beginner, Expert and Master mode respectively, and receive 63%, 63%, 81% less damage respectively. 
[*] Increased chance of HP regen buff appearing and increased regen rate. 
[*] All Bosses and monsters in Master mode will receive a 30% nerf on HP and damage.
[/list]

[h1]BUG Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with first person point of view of female characters.
[/list]

notes.title: Pixark 1.175 Lunar New Year Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Steam 1.175 Lunar New Year Patch Notes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/e2f6a1bb309b893e37e33f9ccc6d30150aa35de6.jpg[/img]
[h3]New Boss：[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/bfd70a23c1996cf9048d67408ac0b654f6f2b972.jpg[/img]

Great Nian Beast

The Great Nian Beast is a special kind of Nian beast that only appears during the Chinese New Year. It is much larger and stronger than the ordinary Nian beasts, and has the ability to weaken opponents with fear, ignite, slow and exhaust. It will also buff itself with "Inferno"and "Eternal Night" upon taking damage. However, such a powerful creature is only afraid of the traditional Chinese dragon lantern. Explorers can negate most of the debuff by carrying the dragon lantern to challenge it, and you will also deal increased damage and receive decreased damage.

Skills：
1、Swipe： Regular attack
2、Heavy Slam: Slams the ground with its paws, knocking back enemies. 
3、Soul of the Nian Beast: Releases Soul of the NIan Beast to attack the enemies in front, dealing “fear” debuff along the way. (Immune to Dragon Lantern and players carrying dragon lantern)
4、Dance of Blessing: A special kind of dance among the Nian Beasts, which will buff itself with “Force of the Nian,” increasing its damage while taking less damage. It will reflect a portion of the melee damage taken to the attacker. Dragon Tail Lantern can eliminate this buff.
5、Flamethrower: Deals damage and applies an ignite DOT. The ignite DOT can spread among enemies during the “Force of the Nian” buff. (Immune to Dragon Tail Lantern and players carrying dragon tail lantern)
6、Outrage: Slams enemy multiple times and roars at the very end. Each slam deals damage, and slows enemy if it has the “Force of the Nian” buff. The roar decreases enemy attack damage, and decreases enemy defense if it has the “Force of the Nian” buff.   (Immune to Dragon Lantern and players carrying dragon lantern)

Boss will buff itself with “Inferno” during the second phase, which will increase its damage.
Boss will buff itself with “Eternal Night” during the third phase, which will increase its damage while taking less damage. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/2bf8f91ded63ba48be137039c59cf618f2b30ad6.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] It is not easy to challenge the Great Nian Beast, but it is  afraid of Dragon Lanterns. Brave Explorers can take on the challenge by performing the traditional Chinese "Dragon Lantern Dance."
[*] Players can obtain Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail by defeating Nian Beasts at Novice Grassland, Grassland, Dawn Island and Woodland.
[*] Players can initiate the Challenge at the Dragon Lantern Stand.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/7aa0bb371128069f738e220adda205fc04f632a8.jpg[/img]
[i]Rules:[/i]
[list]
[*] Players will need to raise different types of Dragon Lanterns in a “Head-Body-Tail” order to initiate the Challenge.
[*] Only the player holding the Dragon Head Lantern can initiate the challenge.
[*] The first and the final position have to be “Head” and “Tail” respectively. However, there can be up to 5 players holding “Body” in between.
[/list]
[i]Challenge Requirements:[/i]
[list]
[*] At least lvl90 to initiate the challenge.
[*] Challenge can be done once per day.
[*] 1 player holding “Head only” will allow a total of 3 players and 7 creatures into the challenge.
[*] 3 players holding “Head-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 5 players and 8 creatures into the challenge.
[*] 5 players holding “Head-Body-Body-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 8 players and 13 creatures into the challenge.
[*] 7 players holding “Head-Body-Body-Body-Body-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 12 players and 19 creatures into the challenge.
[/list]
[i]Loots: [/i]
[list]
[*] Lantern Dragon (Single Seat) at 100% chance, and another one at a small chance.
[*] Red Tassel Gold Lance at a small chance
[*] 50-100 Red Packets
[*] Chainmail avatar pieces at a small chance.
[*] Daeodon Food Recipe (can increase the effectiveness of the healing ability, and lower food consumption, doesn't work in boss arena)
[/list]

[h3]New Items:[/h3]
[b]New Avatars[/b]
Nian Beast Avatar
Can be exchanged for at New Year Goblin Trading Center with red packets.
Head：300 Red Packets
Top：200 Red Packets
Bottom：150 Red Packets
Gloves：150 Red Packets
Shoes：150 Red Packets
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/db22d69889edb71e57f7953a48a6a3e9b2d68ab0.jpg[/img]


[h3]Old Items ARE BACK![/h3]
[b]New Year Goblin Trading Center[/b]
Can be obtained from defeating goblins wearing God of Wealth hat or at event supply drops
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/42c8c7eb2e2615041396a1c3a9b03095567818b7.jpg[/img]

[b]New Year Avatar Set - Chainmail[/b]
Can be exchanged for at New Year Goblin Trading Center with red packets.
[list]
[*] Hat: 300 Red Packets
[*] Top: 200 Red Packets
[*] Bottom:150 Red Packets
[*] Gloves: 150 Red Packets
[*] Shoes: 150 Red Packets
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/cac5f6a288b8911ed4b0972083d083bb24905065.jpg[/img]
[b]Red Tassel Lance[/b]
Copper quality
Can be exchanged at New Year Goblin Trading Center with 200 red packets

[b]Red Tassel Gold Lance[/b]
Iron quality
Can be obtained from defeating the Great Nian Beast at a low chance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/24c7578c9c7da1fe1529fff6ff8efa0c1f9d5fc5.jpg[/img]

[b]Dragon Lantern Stand:[/b]
Can be used to start the Great Nian Beast Challenge with:
[list]
[*] Dragon Head Lantern
[*] Dragon Body Lantern
[*] Dragon Tail Lantern
[/list]

Can be exchanged for at New Year Goblin Trading Center with 300 Red Packets..
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/65b634ee089b013cc899723f1db75c12fb3da48d.jpg[/img]

[b]Dragon Head/Body/Tail Lantern[/b]
[list]
[*] Defeating Nian Beast will drop Dragon Lantern parts (Head/Body/Tail) at 20% chance.
[*] Dragon Head Lantern: Players can raise the Dragon Head Lantern to deal damage to the Great Nian Beast. (Expires in 6 hours)
[*] Dragon Body Lantern: Players can raise the Dragon Body Lantern to shield themselves. (Expires in 3 hours)

notes.title: Patch Update 1.174
notes.content:
Greetings Explorers!

Happy New Year!

We hope everyone’s been enjoying the holiday festivities and the FREE NEW Wonder Under Water Expansion! Build the underwater base of your dreams, if you haven’t downloaded it yet, get it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2244940/PixARK__Wonder_in_Water__Expansion_Pack/

We’re excited to see all of your explorations and adventures in the seas!

For those who have been trying their luck with the ARK Defending Challenge, we’ve made some optimizations to make the experience smoother. Two new Christmas Carpets have also been added!

We’ve addressed a few bugs as well.

Check out the details below:

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h3]Optimization：[/h3]
[list]
[*] ARK Defending Challenge beginner mode now can be entered at lv80
[*] You will now have 5 mins to pick up your loot in ARK Defending Challenge instead of 1.5 mins. 
[*] Two new Christmas Carpets
[*] Some localization optimization
[/list]

[h3]BUG Fixes：[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with incorrect loots in beginner mode of ARK Defending Challenge
[*] Fixed an issue where creatures are spawned incorrectly in ARK Defending Challenge.
[*] Fixed an issue with Tek generator not showing correct power supply range upon unlocking.
[*] Fixed an issue where snow house structures cannot be placed.
[*] Fixed an issue where players can disconnect upon transmitting items.
[/list]

notes.title: 《Wonder In Water》Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/eec3f066e67bde1893cf27cf6f741c9e3f48c087.jpg[/img]

Dear Explorers,

In this patch, we bring you a brand new building experience as well as a new challenge defending ARK against Cobalt aliens.


[h3][b]New Underwater Structures[/b][/h3]
By learning Cobalt technology, you will master the art of building underwater. Take a look at the new structures and build your favorite underwater base!

[b]Vacuum Compartment[/b]
Vacuum compartment is a cubical frame with a side length of 6 meters. It needs to be placed underwater and powered with a TEK generator preferably. It is a sealed compartment that drains the space while filling it with air, allowing the player to breathe and place structures in it. You can expand the frame by removing the sides to attach another structure. Note that if the removed surface is exposed to water, the water will fill the entire compartment. Each surface can also be locked by holding E. Once locked, the surface cannot be removed until unlocking it, preventing the player from accidentally removing a surface that is in contact with water.

[b]Vacuum Compartment Moonpool[/b]
It functions exactly like a normal Vacuum compartment but has a hatch on its downside for entrance.

Both blueprints can be obtained from the ARK Defend Challenge

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/8777d2d8eb445c4829e3fc9832c138261450a07c.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]ARK Defend Challenge[/b][/h3]

Players can now participate in ARK Defend through an ARK Defending Portal. 

Life has become calm and peaceful on Skyward, but it seems it won’t be for long! A newly hatched dino broke out of its shell, causing a purple light to tear through the night sky, opening up a rift. Countless cosmic rays pour through the rift and brutally tear the ARK shields apart. The energy of the ARK is scattered and collected by the Cobalt Aliens on their spaceship as it glows brighter! The planet survived under the blessing of the ARK, however, the Cobalt Aliens are starting to manipulate creatures to attack the ARK once again.  Darkness has fallen and hope has faded. However, in the depths of despair, we’ve found the heart to grow stronger. Get ready and defend against the Cobalt Alien attacks once more, for the dawn will eventually come.

The Ark will reward players for their courage and victory. Collecting all the energy in the following places will reward you different set of equipment:
            -Magic Island : Royal Knight Set
            -Ice and Fire Island: Royal Set
            -Cobalt Star Battlefield: War God Set

Additional rewards include chance of:
            - Goblin Wonder Cabin exchange coupons
            -  Tek energy cubes
            - Vacuum compartment blueprint  
             - Vacuum compartment moonpool blueprint 
             - Exclusive saddle 
             - Giganotosaurus skin 
             - Equipment Modification Core 
             - Equipment Elemental crystal

Collecting all the energy has a chance to drop new structures and a permanent summoning scroll of a rare creature. The Goblin Wonder Cabin will allow you to try your luck using their exchange coupons. The Werewolf Sculpture will add a nice touch to your buildings! The Cobalt Star Turret will provide the best protection for your base!

Clear the Cobalt Star Battlefield to truly shatter the Cobalt Aliens' malevolence. You will be rewarded with a chance to win a permanent summoning scroll for the rare BOSS creature Cobalt Energy Golem Hammer!


There will be a total of three difficulties:
-	Beginner: Magic Island
-	Expert: Ice and Fire Island
-	Master: Cobalt Star Battlefield

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/208eb489e4bfd165ddada81045ee2b75645bfe84.jpg[/img]

[b]How to Participate： [/b]
You can start the challenge by placing items at the ARK Defending Portal if you meet all the requirements. A corresponding portal will open after the countdown, which will teleport all players and their creatures from the same tribe into the challenge. Players  will have 90 mins to clear.

Rules：

1.	ARK Defending Portal may be crafted at Exquisite Architectural Hut.
2.	ARK Defending Portal may be placed at any spot on the map.
3.	ARK Defending Portal requires resources to activate the challenge. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/0b64071d084822388181a7d1c3913791e2804bd2.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/11e604cc08edabd03b364f790113e62d2979e3e9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/e14feead6c13814f2d16b35b2e85ce0a9ff2eff7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/7c29d49d3cbff071e9196e06ef018224af9f9c4b.jpg[/img]

4.	The 90 mins countdown begins once every player has teleported.
5.    Manipulated creatures will attack the ARK in the challenge. Defeating them will automatically collect energy, which will be displayed as a score. 
6. There will be a total of 50 waves of creatures, with each wave 90 seconds apart. 
                    - Upon defeating an entire wave, the next wave will spawn in 10 seconds. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/bb89466404c09da1c6ec669938e54be3ee2dbcfd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d82c3c261989ac7f6692104bd52a264c546fe4d5.jpg[/img]


7. There will be buffs and debuffs spawning across the map. Both you and your enemy can benefit from these. 
8. Defeating elites and Bosses will have a chance to obtain Defending Coin, which can be used to exchange magical plants/potions at the ARK to assist your battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/5795e714104c8e87a1fff84a6ad33757582f5cdb.jpg[/img]

 -  Magical Plant can slow the attacks from the opponent. The higher its level, the longer it persists. More Defending Coins are required for higher levels.

-	Magic Potion can increase HP, attack, defense, and stamina once consumed. The higher its level, the more powerful it will be. More Defending Coins are required for higher levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/9b6de87eb965f873499fc2678c4a18428223d636.jpg[/img]

Challenge Termination/Failure：
1.	You can terminate the challenge anytime at the ARK. You will have 10 minutes to pick up any loot.
2.	Your challenge will fail if the ARK HP reaches 0, and you will have 10 minutes to pick up any loot,
3.	If all players are defeated in the challenge, they will be teleported out and can gather their rewards at the ARK Defending Portal.
 

You will be able to clear the challenge and collect your loot if you：
1.	Clear all waves in 90 mins.
2.	Defeat all creatures in every wave，
3.	The ARK HP is above 0. 
You will have 10 mins to pick up all your rewards any loot at the end.

Challenge Requirements:
1.	Beginner - Magic Island：
Minimum level：80
Maximum Player：3
Maximum Creature：5（No Giganotosaurus）
2.	Expert- Ice and Fire Island:
Minimum level：90
Maximum Player：5
Maximum Creature：10（Up to 5 Giganotosaurus）
3.	Master - Cobalt Alien Battlefield
Minimum level：90
Maximum Player：8
Maximum Creature：15

Each difficulty can be entered once per 24 hours per character. 


Rewards：
Beginner - Magic Island possible rewards：
-	Goblin Wonder Cabin
-	Goblin King Wonder Cabin
-	Goblin Summon Scroll
-	Goblin King Summon Scroll
-	Vacuum compartment blueprint  
-	Vacuum compartment moonpool blueprint
-	Exclusive Saddles with additional stats for Giganotosaurus, Megarock dragon, Ghost dragon, Spinosaurus, Gryphon, Ice bear, Quetzalcoatlus, Armadillo, and Hippocampus
-	Royal Knight Set
-	Goblin Wonder Cabin Exchange Coupon

Expert: Ice and Fire Island possible rewards：

-	Goblin King Wonder Cabin
-	Goblin King Summon Scroll
-	Werewolf light tower
-	Werewolf Summon Scroll
-	Exclusive Saddles with additional stats for Giganotosaurus, Megarock dragon, Ghost dragon, Spinosaurus, Gryphon, Ice bear, Quetzalcoatlus, Armadillo, and Hippocampus
-	Royal Set
-	Equipment Modification Core
-	Equipment Elmental Crystal
-	Goblin Wonder Cabin Exchange Coupon


Master - Cobalt Alien Battlefield possible rewards:

-	Werewolf light tower
-	Werewolf Summon Scroll
-	Cobalt Turret
-	Exclusive Saddles with additional stats for Giganotosaurus, Megarock dragon, Ghost dragon, Spinosaurus, Gryphon, Ice bear, Quetzalcoatlus, Armadillo, and Hippocampus
-	War God Set
-	Equipment Modification Core
-	Equipment Elmental Crystal
-	Goblin Wonder Cabin Exchange Coupon
-	Cobaltenergy Golem Hammer Summon Scroll

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/31c84d28763c59b415deac8221a8e941837afb53.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/9922fb2cc96f8e19553c04160891869b6f6af8ab.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/b052197137b3f80f64e41422c4b30af9bbb27f53.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ccc08d853d2963e29456497de3855b1f3402acf0.jpg[/img]


[h3] [b]Equipment Modification[/b][/h3]

[b]1、Equipment Modification Station[/b]
Firearm Worktable is now renamed to Equipment Modification Station

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/50cb984b02b1485840303321f8d801a86a85c3ed.jpg[/img]

[b]2、Equipment Modification[/b]
-	Equipment Modification Core obtained from the ARK Defend Challenge can be used to modify certain equipment at the Equipment Modification Station. It will grant extra stats and change the appearance of the equipment.
-	Three types of equipment can be modified: Magic set, Primal Bone set, and Tek set, which will require 2, 5, and 8 Equipment Modification Core respectively.
-	Modification will boost the stats of the equipment randomly, and can be overridden by additional modifications. 
-	The following stats are boosted randomly by the modification: Armor, Durability, Thermal Insulation, and Radiation Resistance. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/8c99eef6a8494877199184a2eb91d7ca590c24a2.jpg[/img]

How to modify：
1、	Open Equipment Modification Station
2、	Input your selected Armor and Equipment Modification Cores
3、	Put Armor you wish to modify into the slot.
4、	Under the “Modify” tab, click the button at the bottom right corner.


3、	Equipment Enchantment
The Equipment Elemental Crystal (Wind/Fire/Light/Earth/Water) obtained from the ARK Defend Challenge can be used to enchant equipment for additional stat boosts at the Equipment Modification Station
Three types of equipment can be enchanted: Magic set, Primal Bone set, and 
Tek set, which will cost 5 elemental crystals of the same kind. 


Element	Stat Boost
Water	HP
Fire	Damage
Light	Stamina
Wind	Movement Speed
Earth	Resistance

When a player equips 5 pieces of enchanted Armor with the same element, it will activate an additional boost. 
Element	Set Stat Boost
Water	HP
Fire	Damage
Light	Stamina
Wind	Movement Speed
Earth	Damage Reduction
How to enchant：
1、	Open Equipment Modification Station
2、	Input the Armor and Equipment Elemental Crystals
3、	Put the armor you wish to modify into the slot.
4、	Under the “Enchant” tab, click the enchant button.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ac5927d732de385242a1d8e541b8f80e4dda2e5b.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d12dc1bb263eae5f5e2ecefe3498904213a72249.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Pixark Christmas Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/76ef340789c44ad725ef910864c5fe233cbd0cee.jpg[/img]
[h3]Snow Devil is Back![/h3]
The legend has it that the horrifying Snow Devil was born in the land of sheer cold. The perpetual blizzard grants it endless power, allowing it to cast many powerful spells.

[b]Skills:[/b]
[u][i]Snowball:[/i][/u]
Activating blizzard energy and firing a gigantic snowball from its chest to attack the enemy from a long distance, dealing damage, and lowering enemy speed and cold resistance.
[u][i]Blizzard:[/i][/u]
Rotating its body and releasing a snow tornado to attack enemies, dealing damage, and lowering enemy speed and cold resistance.
[u][i]Snow Pillar:[/i][/u]
Summoning a snow pillar to attack enemies on the ground.
[u][i]One-Punch Devil:[/i][/u]
Gathering energy to its right fist and punching enemies afront, dealing damage, and lowering enemy speed and cold resistance.

[u]Special Abilities:[/u]
Player’s cold resistance is reduced and heat resistance is increased within 50 meters of Snow Devil. The closer the player gets to the Snow Devil, the stronger the effect.
Snow Devil generates an aura of cold air beneath its foot when its HP is under 50%, dealing damage and lowering speed and cold resistance to enemies who touch it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/cd318331f04dbd9d1006278b9ca8356d2bfec43d.gif[/img]

Players can start the Snow Devil challenge by placing “Snow Devil Doll” at the Christmas Fireplace. A Christmas fireplace can be obtained at the Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 200 Christmas tokens. The Snow Devil Doll has a chance of dropping from Christmas gift boxes.
[u]
Challenge Prerequisites[/u]
[list]
[*] Character level ≥90
[*] A maximum of 10 creatures
[*] A maximum of 5 players
[*] Note: Each character can challenge Snow Devil only once per day.
[/list]
[u]Boss Loot[/u]
[i]Small chance of obtaining following skins:[/i]
[list]
[*] Christmas Dodo Skin
[*] Christmas Pteranodon Skin
[*] Christmas Iguanodon Skin
[*] Christmas Gryphon Skin
[*] Christmas Megarock Dragon Skin
[/list]
[i]and a small chance of obtaining following items:[/i]
[list]
[*] Christmas Cape (Limited)
[*] Christmas Cape (Permanent)
[*] Christmas Reindeer Sleigh
[*] 300-600 Christmas Tokens
[*] Tek Storage Box Blueprint
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/02537fa9cca6ec86d063b1247dc51c14445800f9.jpg[/img]


[h2]Old Events are BACK!
[/h2][h3]Christmas Blessing Tree[/h3]

Decorating a Christmas Tree with various decorations will grant you a Christmas Blessing buff. The Christmas Tree can be acquired with Christmas Tokens at the Christmas Goblin Trade Center. Decorating the tree with Christmas Dolls in five unique colors, will gift players the Christmas Blessing and a Christmas Gift Box.

Christmas Gift Box may contain one or more of the following items:
[list]
[*] Rocking Reindeer
[*] Christmas Painting
[*] Christmas Curtain
[*] Snow Devil Doll
[/list]

[b]Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Christmas Dolls may be obtained by looting Snowman.
[*] Christmas Goblin Trade Center can be obtained by looting Goblins wearing a Christmas Hat or from the Christmas Supply Drop.
[*] Christmas Tokens can be harvested from Snow Cubes in Christmas Blizzard
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/98501877c54eeb393bf3ef7db651cff7de5fceb9.jpg[/img]

[b]Snowman Fight[/b]
Snowmen will spawn in Noviceland, Grassland, Dawn island, and Woodland. Players will need to craft Snowballs to attack the Snowmen, which will drop one or more following items:
[list]
[*] Christmas Candy
[*] Christmas Dolls (50% drop rate)
[*] Snowman Figure
[*] Snowman Costumes
[*] Christmas Token
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/eaa8bf8c80316961635c7002cdf1581b9c51e8f9.jpg[/img]

[b]Red Hat Creatures[/b]

Christmas Red Hats have a small chance of dropping from any creature wearing them. Creatures wearing Christmas Red Hats may also drop Christmas Tokens!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/25d3ceda09b83e62ae29e945fadca4592b0fa97a.png[/img]
		
[b]Christmas Supply Drop[/b]
Santa will be riding his Reindeer Sleigh to give away some gifts! Christmas Supply Drop may contain following items:
[list]
[*] Christmas Paintings (small chance)
[*] Christmas Candy
[*] Christmas Fireworks
[*] Christmas Cape (Limited)  (small chance)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d6ab812d4685e8f70a81fcaf75f0b8388fdf9354.png[/img]

[b]Christmas Snowy Biomes[/b]

A majority of the biomes will be enjoying snowy views. During snowy seasons, some biomes might experience a “Christmas Blizzard”. Explorers digging blizzard snow cubes in Christmas Snowy biomes will have a chance of obtaining Christmas Tokens, Christmas Blizzard Snow Cube and Christmas Candy.

[b]Rate Boosts:[/b]
Double Harvest Rates on ores
Higher Exp from defeating Snowmen.

[h3]New Items:[/h3]
[b]Snowman Costume[/b]
[list]
[*] can be exchanged at Christmas Goblin Trading Center at 150 Christmas Tokens each.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/bd7c5a228bfde6b7cf6004db216436454bc75882.jpg[/img]


[h2]Missed Old Christmas Items? They are BACK![/h2]
[b]Christmas Goblin Trade Center[/b]
[list]
[*] Can be obtained by defeating Snowman or from Supply Drops.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/bd8502b6115a26fa2521ee21b2343930593aece5.jpg[/img]

[b]Christmas Reindeer Costume[/b]
[list]
[*] Can be purchased from Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 500 Christmas Tokens.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/31be07954bc87c20a81deebfff303bd983cc9be7.jpg[/img]

[b]Christmas Treant Costume[/b]
[list]
[*] Can be purchased from Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 500 Christmas Tokens.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/f589476d6586e1691ac3f825a49bc04a4bafc89d.jpg[/img]

[b]Christmas Reindeer Sleigh Saddle[/b]
Equipping it on a Reindeer allows one player to ride on it and fly across the map. With the Reindeer Christmas Platform Saddle, players can place up to 50 structures behind it. It can be purchased from Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 2000 Christmas Tokens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d9336d40134ae9af5b791701f1cb7742f4981058.jpg[/img]

[b]Christmas Hat[/b]
Players can get in the Christmas Spirit with these Christmas Hats! They can be purchased from the Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 200 Christmas Tokens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/924dae4b2c84b00f90243837a1cb7a4d06b9f1c4.jpg[/img]

[b]Rocking Reindeer[/b] - Drop rate of 10% from Christmas Tree Gift Boxes.
[b]Christmas Paintings[/b] - Drop rate of 40% from Christmas Tree Gift Boxes.
[b]Christmas Curtain[/b] - Drop rate of 30% from Christmas Tree Gift Boxes and Supply Drops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/4cf2d1742d11cdd8f410363e95e0e36fa91f79ef.jpg[/img]

[b]Christmas Fireplace[/b]
[list]
[*] Obtained from the Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 200 Christmas Tokens
[*] Placing a “Snow Devil Doll” at the Christmas Fireplace will start the Snow Devil Challenge
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ef794a8655492dcd10c2f95b1b1e2f968cf9e44d.jpg[/img]

[b]Snow Devil Doll[/b]
[list]
[*] Used at Christmas Fireplace to start the Snow Devil Challenge
[*] Can also be used as a Holiday Decor
[*] Can be obtained from Christmas Gift Box
[/list]   

[b]Creature Christmas Skins[/b]
All of the following skins have a chance of dropping upon defeating the Snow Devil Challenge, They can be purchased from Christmas Goblin Trade Center with Christmas Tokens:
[list]
[*] Christmas Dodo Skin (100 tokens)
[*] Christmas Pteranodon Skin (200 tokens)
[*] Christmas Iguanodon Skin (200 tokens)
[*] Christmas Gryphon Skin (400 tokens)
[*] Christmas Megarock Dragon Skin (400 tokens)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/0f292e6078ab985f6af9b842af345cd243f6759f.jpg[/img]

[b]Christmas Cape[/b]
Christmas Cape (Limited) can be obtained either from defeating the Snow Devil or from Christmas supply drops at a small chance.
Christmas Cape (Permanent) can be obtained by defeating the Snow Devil at a small chance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/3748cb41dff1be534350474b372fc245d1ea65ed.gif[/img]

notes.title: Pixark 1.172 Thanksgiving Patch
notes.content:
[h2]Steam Pixark 1.172 Thanksgiving Patch Notes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/003ff92c0583aa572892a88dd8a9da5de667dbca.jpg[/img]

[h3][u]Thanksgiving Gameplay[/u] [/h3]

[b]Thanksgiving Banquet[/b]
Place six different Thanksgiving dishes on the Thanksgiving Dining Table, and then press E to enjoy the treat and be rewarded with the Thanksgiving Buff. Placing Roasted Turkey right at the center of the Thanksgiving Dining Table will bring something special to Explorers.

[b]Pardoned Turkey Event[/b]
In the Noviceland biome, Explorers may find wild Turkeys locked in cages. Players will need to break the cage to free the Turkeys. Once they are freed, Turkeys will drop Turkey eggs that provide rewards. 
While freeing the caged Turkeys, explorers have a 30% chance of running into special Pardoned Turkey. Killing the Pardoned Turkey will drop the event item “Turkey Feather,” which can be used to summon Dodorex.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ef1f35f83c40a8167bcefc768cde45ac55064029.jpg[/img]
[b]Turkey Challenge - Summoning Dodorex[/b]
[list]
[*] Upon collecting a certain amount of Turkey Feathers, explorers can use them to summon either a Dodorex (20 mins at 90% chance) or a Dodorex (Permanent at 10% chance) at a cooking pot.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ad2a513442da8aa5d7dced861e18d78dd74e7d33.gif[/img]

[b]Dodorex[/b]
In the world of Pixark, even the weakest and humblest beings have dreams of becoming something stronger. And the Dodo, who is bullied by everyone, may become an existence to be feared by everyone. Legend has it that some dodos with exceptional talent were blessed by the ancestors of the dodo family and evolved into the most powerful Dodorex. Of course the legend is just a legend, in fact, people believe that Dodorex may be the descendants of Tyrannosaurus rex genetically modified by aliens. The biggest basis for this idea is that people have not yet found evidence of the existence of wild Dodorex.
[list]
[*] Tamed Dodorex can bite (LMB) and shoot flames (RMB)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/c88c0fba5deb52109bcb0714fbea803189851320.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/5d5169b14791ea7318d9e9bb7c4f112e830d9ccb.jpg[/img]
[h3][u]Thanksgiving Items:[/u][/h3]
[b]Thanksgiving Decor:[/b]
May drop from the Supply Drop and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event:
[list]
[*] Thanksgiving Dining Table
[*] Thanksgiving Chair
[*] Thanksgiving Recliner
[*] Thanksgiving Curtain
[*] Thanksgiving Decor Balloon
[*] Thanksgiving Wall Decor
[/list]

[b]Thanksgiving Dishes[/b]
May drop from the Supply Drop and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event.
[list]
[*] Roasted Turkey
[*] Pumpkin Pie
[*] Beef Wellington
[*] Salad
[*] Brownie
[*] Sweet Potato
[/list]

[b]Thanksgiving Equipment Skin[/b]
[i]Turkey Hat[/i] 
May drop from the Supply Drop and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/4a7a70e9475e13987f10a887cf85c41df9a1aa80.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/cc721c29e76af5eb7af4e0cece32fdab9d81f35a.png[/img]

[i]Drum-Stick[/i]
May drop from the Supply Drop and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event.

[i]Farmer’s Fork[/i]
May drop from the Supply Drop and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/c7aecb317cc79aa89a5b07515bea029f94854f27.jpg[/img]
[i]Dodo Chief Hat
[/i]Can be crafted using 30 Turkey Feathers at Tailor’s Workbench.
Can only be equipped on Dodorexes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ff1091019ac6b4ea586dc8ae29ce3a67f11fcd73.jpg[/img]

End Halloween Events.

notes.title: Steam 1.171 Halloween Patch Notes
notes.content:
Dear Explorers！ 
We are bringing you our Halloween Patch! Happy Halloween! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/5af13278f3a65552c0d2e4e14b483695a1b1a727.png[/img]

[h3]A Fantastic Beast and Where to Find It[/h3]
[b]Skeleton Horse[/b]

It is a skeleton war horse burning with the flames of hell. Legend has it that the skeleton horse is the mount of the knight of hell, and is the most reliable partner of the knight. It can fly to the sky and dive into the sea like walking on the ground, and the energy from hell also gives it the power of eternal life.

[u]Left click[/u] -  Normal attack

[u]Right click[/u]- Sacrifice: unleashes the flames of hell to inflict continuous damage to enemies within a certain range (damage value correlates to the HP of the  enemy, while damage upper limit correlates to the percentage of melee damage of the skeleton horse)

[u]'C' button[/u] - path of flame, activates its own hell energy, increases its own movement speed  by 50% and melee damage by 30%. Moving will leave a hell flame in place, enemies near the hell flame will take continuous damage (1-50 dmg/0.5 sec)

[i]Fire creatures are immune to the above skills[/i]

[u]Magical Crystal Berry: [/u]The food favored by skeleton horses that replenish their hell energy.  It can be crafted at magic workbench with a dark Magic Stone and a magic berry. 

[b]Where to find it? [/b]
[list]
[*] Skeleton Horse (permanent) can be summoned at “Conjuring Cooking Pot” at 70% chance with:
[list]
[*]  1x Breath Of the Dead
[*]  1x Pegasus DNA
[*]  2x Felhunter DNAs
[*]  5x Scent of the Pumpkin Soul Reaper
[/list]
[*] Upon failing, you will get a tamed Pegasus or a Felhunter.
[*] Defeating following monsters/BOSS will drop the corresponding items:
[list]
[*] Pegasus: Pegasus DNA at 20% chance, 
[*] Pumpkin Soul Reaper:  Scent of the Pumpkin Soul Reaper at 20% chance
[*] Felhunter:  Felhunter DNA at 20% chance 
[*] Death Lord (Boss)/ Bone Wyvern King (Boss): Breath of the Dead at 100% chance.
[/list][/list]Note：
[olist]
[*] “Conjuring Cooking Pot” can be crafted at magic workbench. 
[*] Breath of the Dead can be exchanged with 40  Scents of the Pumpkin Soul Reaper at the Conjuring Cooking Pot.  
[/olist]

Skeleton horse is endowed with strong vitality. Like any other bone creatures, it can resurrect as well.  It can be resurrected at the Conjuring Cooking Pot with 50 Magic Stone of any of the following types: Dark, Fire, Water, Thunder, Light, Earth, and Wind
[u]
Skeleton Horse Saddle:[/u]
Can be exchanged at tailor’s workbench with pumpkins. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/267ca412d493495947fac766e301e3098b982d54.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/a882752200f6fd9110632a9e312d9d69306c7704.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/e02c3890d3a4c72b4df0e2ee0b5c0233c98f6bb7.gif[/img]

[h3]THEY ARE BACK!![/h3]
Upon the arrival of Halloween, so do all those naughty Pumpkin Soul Reapers out there trick or treating. Hurry up and fight them off! 

During the event, Pumpkin Soul Reaper can be found in:
[u]Pixark[/u]: Novice Grassland, Grassland
[u]Skyward:[/u] Dawn Island, Woodland, and Void

Defeating it will drop:
[b]Scent of the Pumpkin[/b]
[b]Pumpkin Seed[/b]
[b]Magic Broom[/b] (7 days)
[b]Flying Firework[/b] (7 days)
[b]Clown Costume[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/e9ba5936c29ebd602db6add1e351fd404a973ab8.jpg[/img]

[h3]Gameplay:  The Great Pumpkin Battle![/h3]

With Halloween fast approaching, we need plenty of pumpkins not only to decorate our homes but also to use them to exchange gifts! Hurry up and call your buddies to plant pumpkins together!

[b]Pumpkin seeds:[/b]
Defeating Pumpkin Soul Reapers will drop pumpkin seeds, which can be used to plant pumpkins.

Pumpkins can be exchanged for various Halloween gifts at the Tailor’s  Workbench

[h3]Costumes! [/h3]

New skeleton costume set can be exchanged at the Tailor’s Workbench with: 
[u]Hat[/u]：400  pumpkins
[u]Top[/u]：200 pumpkins
[u]Hand[/u]：100 pumpkins
[u]Bottom[/u]：200 pumpkins
[u]Foot[/u]：100 pumpkins
[u]Skeleton Horse Saddle[/u]：1000 pumpkins

Knight costume set can be exchanged at the Tailor’s Workbench with: 
[u]Hat[/u]：350  pumpkins
[u]Top[/u]：350 pumpkins
[u]Hand[/u]：150 pumpkins
[u]Bottom[/u]：250 pumpkins
[u]Foot[/u]：150 pumpkins
[u]Sword[/u]：700 pumpkins
[u]Shield[/u]：700 pumpkins

Remember the Scarecrow costume from before? They can be exchanged at 50% discount!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/74d3efc4b4bed3a5496822596722ac62e5f8e2b7.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d24310407b15373ad98197e08d25abfa2f2fcf0e.jpg[/img]

[h3]Old Events ARE BACK![/h3]
[olist]
[*] [b]Clown Supply Drops[/b] - Normal supply drops will turn into Clown Supply Drops. Explorers can obtain Halloween Decors and Halloween Candy Grenades at a chance from these drops.

[*] [b]Pumpkin Hat[/b]: Some creatures will be wearing Pumpkin Hats. There is a chance of them dropping the Hats that you can equip them on your tamed creatures.

[*] [b]Double Harvest rates on Ores and Exp rates[/b]
       Higher Exp from defeating Pumpkin Soul Reapers
[/olist]
[h3]Old Items ARE BACK! [/h3]
[olist]
[*] [b]Flying Firework[/b] (7 days)
 Can be obtained at a chance from defeating Pumpkin Soul Reapers. Expires in 7 days.

[*] [b]Flying Firework[/b] (permanent)
 Can be obtained at a small chance from defeating: Ancient Wyvern King, Aurora Butterfly King and Beach Bully.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/08c9010ea9e03547e00b53c34bb1d93062ec893c.jpg[/img]
 
[*] [b]Halloween Trees, Halloween Gravestones, Pumpkin Candle[/b] and [b]Pumpkin Wall[/b] Decors can be obtained from Clown Supply Drops.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/bd1445f70b44b07a7a1e8e18d3a53aa09a2f92d4.jpg[/img]
[*]  [b]Clown Costume[/b]
        Can be obtained from defeating Pumpkin Soul Reapers at a low rate.

[*][b] Halloween Candy Grenade[/b]
 Throw various Halloween Candy Grenade at other Explorers to transform them into characters wearing various Halloween Masks! The effect lasts for ten minutes. They can be obtained from the Clown Supply Drop. [/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/3a82f9064f284e15d0541f5c9f047c81b11f5b5c.jpg[/img]

Happy Halloween!

[h3]New Events[/h3]

[b]Osmanthus Tree Challenge[/b]
Autumn, the season of harvesting, is finally upon us and there are a lot of Osmanthus Trees blossoming on the land of Pixark. In China, it's customary to pick Osmanthus flowers and make Osmanthus drinks in autumn.

Grab the Wu Gang Axe (made in the Tailor's Workbench) tco ollect from Osmanthus trees with your friends!

Osmanthus Trees can be found on Novice Grassland, Dawn Island, Grassland, and Woodland.
Explorers can obtain “Mooncake token”  from Osmanthus trees using a Wu Gang Axe 

Mooncake Tokens can be used to exchange gifts from the Mid-Autumn Festival Goblin Trading Center.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ea0211cb898525e3ce48873cfcd02653513de288.gif[/img]

[b]What’s THAT?! 
A [i]Lepursa[/i]?![/b]

Straight from the mad scientist's lair is a strange-looking creature with an equally strange name.  Its unique appearance makes it seem extra-terrestrial, but it shares some familiar features with other creatures. The Lepursa has never before been found in the wild. Although it appears to be a peaceful herbivore, the Lepursa possesses surprising combat expertise - especially after being fed carrots, which stimulate its potential and give it a burst of power. 

Defeating Pegasus, Icebear, Big-Ear Bunny will yield a 20% chance of dropping their respective DNA.
Combine the following DNAs together at the conjuring cooking pot(can be crafted at magic anvil bench) in order to summon the new Lepursa at a 60% chance:[list]
[*] 1 Pegasus DNA
[*] 2 Icebear DNA
[*] 5 Big-Ear Bunny DNA[/list]
Summoning has a 40% chance of failing and DNA will not be refunded in case of failure.Upon failure, one of the following creatures will be summoned instead:
 - Tamed Big-Ear Bunny
