notes.title: Pixark Summer Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/24cee6d262355c0517d03e52f58caab05d2ac91c.jpg[/img]
[h2]New BOSS——Mega Giganotosaurus[/h2]
The Giganotosaurus is one of the creatures standing at the top of the food chain. With its gigantic body size, aggressive temper. and powerful attack, the actual combat power will worth the time you invest in. However, the Giganotosaurus has two major drawbacks that cannot be ignored. First, Giganotosaurus is highly impulsive and irritable, and once provoked, it will attack all creatures around indiscriminately. The other drawback is due to its huge size, which does not allow it to challenge elite creatures/BOSS in most challenges. 

[u]Skills:[/u]
[list]
[*] Crunch: While in rage mode during Phase 2/3, its attack will deal an addtional 2%/5% max HP to enemies. 
[*] Roar: enemies around it will be confused and uncontrollable.
[*] Berserk: its attack will increase upon taking damage.
[/list]

[u]Drops：[/u]
[list]
[*] One fertilized Giganotosaurus egg (100% chance) 
[*] Tek Storage Box blueprint
[*] Sauce Meat blueprint
[/list]

[u]Challenge：[/u]
[list]
[*] Players will need to summon the “Ancient Gate” and use energy stone to teleport and challenge the Mega Giganotosaurus. 
[*] Ancient gate recipe can be learned at lv90 and crafted at the Inscription Book
[*] Energy stone recipe can be learned at lv90 and crafted at the Alchemy Stove
[*] Only one challenge can be started at each Ancient Gate with a  cooldown time of 24 hours.
[/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/da420bd57d97a3f684a7b054f3649d221d80edb4.jpg[/img]   
[h3] New Creature[/h3]
[b]Giganotosaurus[/b]
The Giganotosaurus once lived in Argentina, South America, during the Cretaceous period. With its huge body size, powerful and agile bite. and as sharp as a steel knife teeth, the actual combat power may be comparable to Tyrannosaurus rex. In Pixark, the Giganotosaurus is one of the creatures standing at the top of the food chain with a super aggressive power that far surpasses the ordinary Tyrannosaurus Rex. The Giganotosaurus is impulsive and irritable, and once enraged, it will attack all creatures around it indiscriminately, even friendly ones. So far, no wild Giganotosaurus has been found in the land of Pixark. All known domesticated Giganotosaurus are hatched from eggs obtained by challenging the Mega Giganotosaurus.


[u]LMB[/u]：Regular attack
[u]RMB[/u]：Roar（No actual effect）
[u]Passive[/u]：Giganotosaurus will enter the "berserk" state when its rage bar reaches 100%. In addition, upon taking a single hit with a damage of 25% of its maximum HP, it will instantly enter the "berserk" state. The "berserk" state will enrage all giganotosaurus within a certain range for 20 seconds, attacking all creatures and players.  When the rage bar has not reached 100%,  each 1% rage increase will increase the maximum damage by 1%. After entering the "berserk" state, the rage bar returns to zero.


[h3]Spinosaurus[/h3]
Spinosaurus was an aquatic or semi-aquatic dinosaur that lived in the Cretaceous period. With a huge body size but a slender mouth, its actual combat power is far less than a Tyrannosaurus rex. However, it might not be the case in Pixark, and certainly not if it is in water. Spinosaurus can travel effortlessly in water, and is the nemesis of all aquatic creatures.

[u]LMB[/u]：Regular attack
[u]RMB[/u]：Switch between moving in 2&4 feet. 
[u]C button[/u]：A roar that can confuse all surrounding creatures in water.
[u]Passive[/u]：Enters a “humid” state when in water, increasing its attack by 15%, movement speed by 20%, and takes 20% less damage. The humid state will wear off upon leaving water for 30 seconds. 

[u]Spawn[/u]：
Pixark：Frozen Land
Skyward：Crystal Island

[b]Lystrosaurus[/b]
Lystrosaurus will spawn at Grassland and Woodland. 

The Lystrosaurus is a small, docile herbivore. Wild Lystrosaurus will only run away slowly even after being attacked. It is at the bottom of the food chain; however, people who have domesticated Lystrosaurus found out that it learns very quickly and can accumulate experience faster than other creatures. Not only that, it will also affect the surrounding creatures so that they get a exp rate boost.

Trait: After petting it, it will boost the exp gaining rates of other creatures within a certain range. The higher the level of the Lystrosaurus, the faster this rate boost will be.  The effect lasts for 10 minutes, and the bonus effect provided by multiple Lystrosaurus cannot be stacked.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/f4fb71fb4d4d9d593d2d4e53b242911aa9433b4c.png[/img]
[h3]New Creature Breeding[/h3]
Void Manta, Rock Drake, Nian Beast and Felhunter will now be available for breeding purposes. 

[h3]Old Items Are BACK! [/h3]
[b]Carrot Club[/b]

Can be exchanged for at Easter Goblin Trading Center with 10 Carrots.
Deals additional damage to the Easter Bunny.
Parasaurus and Triceratops can harvest carrot seeds, which can be planted near the water to obtain carrots.

[b]Bunny Ears[/b]
Can be exchanged at the Easter Goblin Trading center with 1 Gold Egg Token and 20 Silver Egg Tokens.
You can dye the Bunny Ear as well!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/f7581ded92d4b0616549d5a5c879857a17bdc858.jpg[/img]
[b]Easter Eggs[/b]

Can be exchanged for at the Easter Goblin Trading Center with 20 Silver Egg Tokens.
You can dye these Easter Eggs and change their patterns by hitting “Q” button upon placing them in your house.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/2c54b617e21f31ccaf08f43b627b9e2078b9bac7.jpg[/img]
[b]Procoptodon Skin[/b]
Can be exchanged for at the Easter Goblin Trading Center with 3 Gold Egg Tokens and 100 Silver Egg Tokens.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/fafc5f31cd506868daa4022d96ac0f02e4e273ac.jpg[/img]
Flower Green and Violet Purple color dyes can be exchanged at the Easter Goblin Trading Center with 10 Silver Egg Tokens.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/9e87a1d6f57c0360ba1bda211230aca85ec3d495.jpg[/img]
[b]Easter Goblin Trading Center[/b]
Can be obtained through looting goblins, the goblin king, or in supply drops.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/0944681a5c3e8ec217de1c5be238decdb3c3b23d.jpg[/img]
[b]Skeleton Dino Skins[/b]
You can now exchange Skeleton skin of following creatures at Tailor’s Workbench with Skeleton Essence!
Rex : 70 Skeleton Essence
Megarock Dragon: 70 Skeleton Essence
Carnotaurus: 30 Skeleton Essence
Triceratops : 30 Skeleton Essence
Gryphon: 50 Skeleton Essence
Ghost dragon : 50 Skeleton Essence

Skeleton Essence Drop Rate:

50% upon looting Skeleton Rex/Megarock Dragons
30% upon looting other Skeleton creatures

[b]Double Harvest Rates on mining. [/b]


[h3]BUG Fixes and Optimization[/h3]
[b]Optimization：[/b]
Pixblocks will now show the stats of the creatures inside. 
Mecha Tiger avatar,2 sets olf Summer Avatars and 3 sets of School Uniforms will be available for dying purposes. 
Snow Devil Doll can no longer be picked up after placing it at the Christmas Fireplace.
Tek Helmet toggle mode will now be activated by double-clicking “P” button.

[b]BUG Fix：[/b]
Fixed an issue where HP decreases incorrectly when baby wyverns are starving. 
Fixed an issue where food consumption rate is incorrect with baby wyverns.

notes.title: Patch 1.155 St. Patrick's Day Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/29f7f2456bea9251d010dece4343caf82956c8ae.jpg[/img]
St. Patrick’s Day is upon us again! We are excited to bring back some of the classic events for our fellow Explorers to enjoy! 

[b]The patch is scheduled to go live tonight.[/b]

Servers will be down for a few hours to implement the following changes:

[h1]Items[/h1]
[list]
[*] Holiday Ribbon Cracker
[*] Balloon Arch
[*] St. Patrick’s Day Bed/table/chair/shelf/flower pot/painting
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/86c7ab9f557414460b9d427a2450aea7dc5a5aae.gif[/img]

* Can be exchanged for at St. Patrick’s Day goblin trading center with Shamrocks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/33f111f0347f771166a8bf61a7a1d21fdc808b4c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/78e4b740d8468ca849d8e6178f6709b2d42a4435.jpg[/img]

[h1]Old Items are back![/h1]
[h3]St. Patrick's Day Goblin Trading Center[/h3]
[list]
[*] Can be obtained by defeating Goblins or Goblin Kings
[*] Can also be obtained through Holiday supply drops
[*] Used to exchange for St. Patrick’s Day event items
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/bb4ae6602c3e9e6001d5766d476715f5dfa31018.jpg[/img]

[h3]St. Patrick’s Day Costumes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Hat: [/b]Can be obtained through St. Patrick’s Day Goblin Trading Center using 4-leaf clover
[*] [b]Top: [/b]Can be obtained through St. Patrick’s Day Wishing tree and red handkerchief event at a certain rate
[*] [b]Leg, Boot, Gloves: [/b]Can be obtained through St. Patrick’s Day Goblin Trading Center using Shamrocks
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/b4958397ac47bf50315519683ce597d9e5a908ce.jpg[/img]

[h3]St. Patrick’s Day Wishing Tree[/h3]
Obtained through St. Patrick’s Day Goblin Trading center. Upon tying Red Handkerchief (which is also obtained through St. Patrick’s Day Goblin Trading Center) to the tree, the following rewards can be obtained:
[list]
[*] St. Patrick’s Day Top avatar
[*] 4-leaf Clover
[*] Cobalt Organic Matter
[*] DarkGreen Creature Coloring
[*] Green Dye
[*] Dark Green Dye
[/list]

[h3]Shamrocks and 4-Leaf Clovers[/h3]
[list]
[*] Shamrock seeds can be obtained by harvesting regular grass using Parasaur/Iguanodon
[*] Planting the seed will either allow you to harvest Shamrocks or 4-leaf clovers
[*] Using greenhouse allows Shamrock seeds to grow much faster
[*] Can be used at St. Patrick’s Day goblin trading center to exchange event items
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d41efae489b4c3989774ca312bc9a878f4a8c192.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/e30d5a96f4a0645cebdb826a152da504def48d11.jpg[/img]

[h1]Additional Changes[/h1]
[h3]Supply drops will be Pot of Gold Shaped and contain:[/h3]
[list]
[*] St. Patrick’s Day Goblin Trading Center
[*] Red handkerchief
[/list]
[h3]Water will be turning green during the event![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/8540fd1876a25aafd9fe6219ba62e7b0eae0703a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Pixark 1.152 Lunar New Year Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Steam 1.152 Lunar New Year Patch Notes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/c48d8c1b3e2f2ac48f040722d3e60be3de40c692.jpg[/img]
[h3]New Boss：[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d298ac41c71fc5a80c771197f58237416e46e7a7.jpg[/img]
[b]Mechanical Tiger[/b]

A huge, heavily armored mechanical tiger with a powerful electric charge attack. Perhaps its sudden appearance is again related to the Cobalt aliens. (Dragon Lantern and players carrying Dragon Lantern can significantly weaken the boss when it uses Furious Roar.)
[list]
[*] It is not easy to challenge the great Mechanical Tiger, but they are afraid of Dragon Lanterns. Brave Explorers can take on the challenge by performing the traditional Chinese "Dragon Lantern Dance"
[*] Players can obtain Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail by defeating Nian Beasts at Novice Grassland, Grassland, Dawn Island and Woodland.
[*] Players can initiate the Bull Demon Challenge at the Dragon Lantern Stand.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/7aa0bb371128069f738e220adda205fc04f632a8.jpg[/img]
[i]Rules:[/i]
[list]
[*] Players will need to raise different types of Dragon Lanterns in a “Head-Body-Tail” order to initiate the Challenge.
[*] Only the player holding the Dragon Head Lantern can initiate the challenge.
[*] The first and the final position have to be “Head” and “Tail” respectively. However, there can be up to 5 players holding “Body” in between.
[/list]
[i]Challenge Requirements:[/i]
[list]
[*] At least lvl90 to initiate the challenge.
[*] Challenge can be done once per day.
[*] 1 player holding “Head only” will allow a total of 3 players and 7 creatures into the challenge.
[*] 3 players holding “Head-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 5 players and 8 creatures into the challenge.
[*] 5 players holding “Head-Body-Body-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 8 players and 13 creatures into the challenge.
[*] 7 players holding “Head-Body-Body-Body-Body-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 12 players and 19 creatures into the challenge.
[/list]
[i]Loots: [/i]
[list]
[*] Lantern Dragon (Single Seat) at 100% chance, and another one at a small chance.
[*] Red Tassel Gold Lance at a small chance
[*] 50-100 Red Packets
[*] Chainmail avatar pieces at a small chance.
[*] Daeodon Food Recipe (can increase the effectiveness of the healing ability, and lower food consumption, doesn't work in boss arena)
[*] 2-4 Energy Parts - Type α  at 100% chance. 
[*] 1-3 Energy Parts - Type β at 100% chance. 
[*] 1-2 Energy Parts - Type γ at 20% chance. 
[*] Mechanical Tiger Rocket Launcher at 5% chance. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/625d587b59ac2cb5d18f5124c3ce0e254487a032.gif[/img]
[i]Skills [/i]
[list]
[*] Basic Attack: Claw swipe/Bite, dealing damage to enemy in front of it.  
[*] Shoulder Tackle：Slightly build up strength and slam its right shoulder against enemies in front of it, dealing a huge amount of damage.
[*] Tail Snipe：Swinging its tail and launch the tip of the tail against its enemies, knocking back the target and slowing its speed for a short period of time. 
[*] Voltorb：Slightly lean back to build up strength, then open its mouth to shoot out a charged orb. Enemies hit by the orb will take damage and lower their speed. 
[*] Volt Beam：Crouching its body and launch a railgun beam against enemies in front of it. Dealing explosive damage and knocking back the enemies. 
[*] Furious Roar：Roaring to the sky and buff itself with electric bolts, dealing 30% additional damage and lowering incoming damage by 30%.
[/list]

[h3]New Items:[/h3]
[b]New Avatars[/b]
[i]Mechanical Tiger Armor Set[/i] - Can be exchanged at the New Year Goblin Trading Center.
[list]
[*] Helmet：2 Energy Parts - Type α & 1  Energy Parts - Type β
[*] Top：5 Energy Parts - Type α ; 3  Energy Parts - Type β; 2 Energy Parts - Type γ
[*] Gloves: 3 Energy Parts - Type α & 2  Energy Parts - Type β 
[*] Bottom: 4 Energy Parts - Type α ; 3  Energy Parts - Type β; 1 Energy Parts - Type γ
[*] Shoes： 4 Energy Parts - Type α ; 3  Energy Parts - Type β; 1 Energy Parts - Type γ
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/76d6fc18e4a2c9ec6821f5f8d9f52d12b4d7cbbb.jpg[/img]
[b]New Weapon：[/b]
[i]Mechanical Tiger[/i] - Rocket Launcher
[list]
[*] Can be obtained from defeating Mechanical Tiger Boss at 5% chance
[*] Can be exchanged with:
[list]
[*]  30 Energy Parts - Type α and 
[*]  30 Energy Parts - Type β
[/list][/list]
at the New Year Goblin Trading Center.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/5f7981f7cbd10b7760274a08631f296f0c01c928.gif[/img]
[i]Mechanical Tiger Doll:[/i] 
[list]
[*] Can be exchanged with:
[list]
[*] 15 Energy Parts - Type α and 
[*] 10 Energy Parts - Type β
[/list][/list]
at the New Year Goblin Trading Center.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/00f9afe2cf4226ec71e6c1bff58531668bde263b.jpg[/img]
Energy Parts:
[list]
[*] Can be obtained from defeating Mechanical Tiger Boss. 
[*] Can be exchanged at the New Year Goblin Trading Center:
[list]
[*] 2 Energy Parts - Type α   = 1  Energy Part - Type β
[*] Energy Parts - Type α + 10 Energy Parts - Type β = 1 Energy Part - Type γ
[/list][/list]

[h3]Old Items ARE BACK![/h3]
[b]New Year Goblin Trading Center[/b]
Can be obtained from defeating goblins wearing God of Wealth hat or at event supply drops
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/42c8c7eb2e2615041396a1c3a9b03095567818b7.jpg[/img]

[b]New Year Avatar Set - Chainmail[/b]
Can be exchanged for at New Year Goblin Trading Center with red packets.
[list]
[*] Hat: 300 Red Packets
[*] Top: 200 Red Packets
[*] Bottom:150 Red Packets
[*] Gloves: 150 Red Packets
[*] Shoes: 150 Red Packets
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/cac5f6a288b8911ed4b0972083d083bb24905065.jpg[/img]
[b]Red Tassel Lance[/b]
Copper quality
Can be exchanged at New Year Goblin Trading Center with 200 red packets

[b]Red Tassel Gold Lance[/b]
Iron quality
Can be obtained from defeating the Mechanical Tiger Boss at a low chance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/24c7578c9c7da1fe1529fff6ff8efa0c1f9d5fc5.jpg[/img]

[b]Dragon Lantern Stand:[/b]
Can be used to start the Mechanical Tiger Boss Challenge with:
[list]
[*] Dragon Head Lantern
[*] Dragon Body Lantern
[*] Dragon Tail Lantern
[/list]

Can be exchanged for at New Year Goblin Trading Center with 300 Red Packets..
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/65b634ee089b013cc899723f1db75c12fb3da48d.jpg[/img]

[b]Dragon Head/Body/Tail Lantern[/b]
[list]
[*] Defeating Nian Beast will drop Dragon Lantern parts (Head/Body/Tail) at 20% chance.
[*] Dragon Head Lantern: Players can raise the Dragon Head Lantern to deal damage to the Mechanical Tiger. (Expires in 6 hours)
[*] Dragon Body Lantern: Players can raise the Dragon Body Lantern to shield themselves. (Expires in 3 hours)
[*] Dragon Tail Lantern: Players can raise the Dragon Tail lantern to remove all buffs on Mechanical Tiger. (Expires in 3 hours)
[/list]		
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/a62df3d9a192306ca56867d5c1f33ac24bac1c0b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/c68680dca2470704454fd32d4ad52686b3e2a3e3.jpg[/img]
[b]Mount: Lantern Dragon[/b]
In China, lanterns are indispensable objects for festivals, and the flying Kong Ming lanterns are a symbol of people's aspiration for a better life. Now for the first time in Pixark, players can build their Lantern Dragon with lanterns and enjoy a ride with friends!

Lantern Dragon can have up to 5 seats as you put more parts in!
[list]
[*] Lantern Dragon（Single seat): can be obtained from defeating the Mechanical Tiger at a small chance.
[*] Lantern Dragon（Double seat): can be obtained from combining two Lantern Dragon（Single seat）at tailor’s workbench.
[*] Lantern Dragon（Triple seat): can be obtained from combining two Lantern Dragon（Double seat）at tailor’s workbench.
[*] Lantern Dragon（Quadra seat): can be obtained from combining two Lantern Dragon（Triple seat）at tailor’s workbench.
[*] Lantern Dragon（Penta seat): can be obtained from combining two Lantern Dragon（Quadra seat）at tailor’s workbench.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/b0597ae766af390ade082b0d9c5593337b4ba990.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/74b4dc234a44bbf1e9a4033b4f6bad4bbe1df591.gif[/img]

[h3]Old Lunar New Year Events Are Back![/h3]
[b]Boss: Flame Demon[/b]
Spawn rate is 50% at the Death Lord Altar in PixARK map and 50% at the Burial Ground Altar in Skyward map.
Rewards: Gargoyle Skin (5% drop rate)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/c9e29279f33a286206a5223911d4798a45b09ac1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/05c734b7557039e9a9bff737e5d873cd63070f6d.jpg[/img]

[b]Lunar New Year Supply Drop[/b]
Supply Beacon will change its shape to a Chinese Lucky Bag, containing our Lunar New Year gift for explorers.
Rewards: Spring Festival dishes (restores Food and HP), Spring Festival Fireworks, New Year Goblin Trading Center, Red Packets.

[b]Lunar New Year Reunion Party[/b]
Placing different Lunar New Year dishes on the table will grant different buffs to the player, along with new year greetings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/7c29e04527c801099650aee604b6b32874c40cc4.jpg[/img]
[b]God of Wealth Hat[/b]
Players can obtain God of Wealth Hat at a small chance by defeating creatures that wearing it (Cosmetic for tamed creatures)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/3d569481272ee2c2c35de1efe7742fdd13725b4a.jpg[/img]
[b]Nian Beasts are Back![/b]
Nian Beasts will be spawning in Novice Grassland, Grassland, Dawn Island and Woodland.
Can only be defeated by the Firecrackers players crafted.
Rewards: Lunar New Year Dishes, Spring Festival Decors and blueprints, Red Packets.

[h3]Double Harvest Rates on Mining!

Double Exp Rates![/h3]

[h3]Optimization[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tek Storage Box slots increase from 300 to 550. 
[*] You can now enable mating without creatures being in wandering mode. 
[*] Tek grenade can now be damaged by auto turret. 
[/list]


Run into bugs? Help us squash them by reporting any bugs or issues here: 
http://bit.ly/2YMJQ3x

notes.title: Pixark 1.151 New Year's Eve Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Pixark 1.151 New Year's Eve Patch Notes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/2dad8ce2e007ca9105371dace2e74d10a9ed5144.jpg[/img]
[h3]New Boss：[/h3]
[b]Yeti[/b]
Bigby and Tinnie are the Yeti brothers who live in the land of the sheer cold. The older brother Bigby is stout and hasty while the little brother is timid, careful and stays on Bigby’s back all day. Their personalities complement each other and they know each other too well. Challenging  them will be a tough battle.  

[u]Boss Skills[/u]
[list]
[*] Fury Swipe: Deals damage to enemies hit. 
[*] War Cry: Creates a snow tornado in front of them, pushing the enemies away and dealing damage.
[*] Frost Shot: Creates and pushes an arrow made of ice that can explode after a short period of time.
[*] Ice Beam: Tinnie will cast  an ice beam that deals direct damage to anyone who mounts on creatures. 
[*] Frost Breath: Breathes out freezing air that lowers the speed of the enemies. 
[*] Snowball Blast: Bigby will cough and create a gigantic snowball, kicking it and dealing damage to enemies.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/cdbe41eb53d1365e0468f7982b8cb4b907c4d91c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/546aaba8d754f2d57ef11e5f0aadb6d7591a72eb.gif[/img]


Players can start the Yeti challenge by placing “Snow Devil Doll” at the Christmas Fireplace. A Christmas fireplace can be obtained at the Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 200 Christmas tokens. The Snow Devil Doll has a chance of dropping from Christmas gift boxes.

Note: Snow Devil Dolls can start Yeti and Snow Devil challenges. 

[b]Challenge Prerequisites[/b]
[list]
[*] Character level ≥90
[*] A maximum of 10 creatures
[*] A maximum of 5 players
[*] Note: Each character can challenge Yeti  only once per day and it DOES NOT share cooldown with Snow Devil boss. 
[/list]

[u]Boss Loot:[/u]
A chance of dropping following Snow House blueprints:
[list]
[*] Snow House foundation blueprint
[*] Snow House Wall blueprint
[*] Snow House Ceiling blueprint
[*] Snow House Door blueprint
[*] Snow House Window blueprint
[*] Snow House Stairs blueprint
[*] Snow House Ladder blueprint
[*] Snow House Fence blueprint
[*] Snow House Roof blueprint
[/list]
and 100~200 Christmas tokens.

 These blueprints can be crafted at the Construction Hut. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/88df793853e3843d6f40693411e57a671317da0d.jpg[/img]

A chance of dropping following Yeti Dolls:
[list]
[*] Giant Yeti Doll
[*] Giant Yeti Doll (Permanent)  at a low chance
[*] Small Yeti Doll
[*] Small Yeti Doll (Permanent) at a low chance
[/list]

The giant Yeti Doll can decorate your base with its festive lights when connected to a power generator.  
		
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/53038b462d6f5f47cf6390a10b62b78513aa7eb4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/84b77e06637cd3900114e6cf02d04c3c25c03554.gif[/img]

[h3]Celebrate 2022! [/h3]
Invite your friends and celebrate 2022 with our new Jumbotron in the sky! On New Year’s Day at 12am (server time), there will be a firework showcase when the big clock reaches zero near the Jumbotron. Come and share an unique experience with friends!~


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/7b0a59b53ad0cc2bb1fc0b9d381d6ab1bcabc7ea.jpg[/img]


Run into bugs? Help us squash them by reporting any bugs or issues here: 
http://bit.ly/2YMJQ3x

Please follow our Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, and Official Website for further news and updates for PixARK on Steam, PS4, Xbox One X, and Nintendo Switch.

notes.title: Pixark 1.149 Christmas Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Pixark 1.149 Christmas Patch Notes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/76ef340789c44ad725ef910864c5fe233cbd0cee.jpg[/img]
[h3]Snow Devil is Back![/h3]
The legend has it that the horrifying Snow Devil was born in the land of sheer cold. The perpetual blizzard grants it endless power, allowing it to cast many powerful spells.

[b]Skills:[/b]
[u][i]Snowball:[/i][/u]
Activating blizzard energy and firing a gigantic snowball from its chest to attack the enemy from a long distance, dealing damage, and lowering enemy speed and cold resistance.
[u][i]Blizzard:[/i][/u]
Rotating its body and releasing a snow tornado to attack enemies, dealing damage, and lowering enemy speed and cold resistance.
[u][i]Snow Pillar:[/i][/u]
Summoning a snow pillar to attack enemies on the ground.
[u][i]One-Punch Devil:[/i][/u]
Gathering energy to its right fist and punching enemies afront, dealing damage, and lowering enemy speed and cold resistance.

[u]Special Abilities:[/u]
Player’s cold resistance is reduced and heat resistance is increased within 50 meters of Snow Devil. The closer the player gets to the Snow Devil, the stronger the effect.
Snow Devil generates an aura of cold air beneath its foot when its HP is under 50%, dealing damage and lowering speed and cold resistance to enemies who touch it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/cd318331f04dbd9d1006278b9ca8356d2bfec43d.gif[/img]

Players can start the Snow Devil challenge by placing “Snow Devil Doll” at the Christmas Fireplace. A Christmas fireplace can be obtained at the Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 200 Christmas tokens. The Snow Devil Doll has a chance of dropping from Christmas gift boxes.
[u]
Challenge Prerequisites[/u]
[list]
[*] Character level ≥90
[*] A maximum of 10 creatures
[*] A maximum of 5 players
[*] Note: Each character can challenge Snow Devil only once per day.
[/list]
[u]Boss Loot[/u]
[i]Small chance of obtaining following skins:[/i]
[list]
[*] Christmas Dodo Skin
[*] Christmas Pteranodon Skin
[*] Christmas Iguanodon Skin
[*] Christmas Gryphon Skin
[*] Christmas Megarock Dragon Skin
[/list]
[i]and a small chance of obtaining following items:[/i]
[list]
[*] Christmas Cape (Limited)
[*] Christmas Cape (Permanent)
[*] Christmas Reindeer Sleigh
[*] 300-600 Christmas Tokens
[*] Tek Storage Box Blueprint
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/02537fa9cca6ec86d063b1247dc51c14445800f9.jpg[/img]


[h2]Old Events are BACK!
[/h2][h3]Christmas Blessing Tree[/h3]

Decorating a Christmas Tree with various decorations will grant you a Christmas Blessing buff. The Christmas Tree can be acquired with Christmas Tokens at the Christmas Goblin Trade Center. Decorating the tree with Christmas Dolls in five unique colors, will gift players the Christmas Blessing and a Christmas Gift Box.

Christmas Gift Box may contain one or more of the following items:
[list]
[*] Rocking Reindeer
[*] Christmas Painting
[*] Christmas Curtain
[*] Snow Devil Doll
[/list]

[b]Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Christmas Dolls may be obtained by looting Snowman.
[*] Christmas Goblin Trade Center can be obtained by looting Goblins wearing a Christmas Hat or from the Christmas Supply Drop.
[*] Christmas Tokens can be harvested from Snow Cubes in Christmas Blizzard
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/98501877c54eeb393bf3ef7db651cff7de5fceb9.jpg[/img]

[b]Snowman Fight[/b]
Snowmen will spawn in Noviceland, Grassland, Dawn island, and Woodland. Players will need to craft Snowballs to attack the Snowmen, which will drop one or more following items:
[list]
[*] Christmas Candy
[*] Christmas Dolls (50% drop rate)
[*] Snowman Figure
[*] Snowman Costumes
[*] Christmas Token
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/eaa8bf8c80316961635c7002cdf1581b9c51e8f9.jpg[/img]

[b]Red Hat Creatures[/b]

Christmas Red Hats have a small chance of dropping from any creature wearing them. Creatures wearing Christmas Red Hats may also drop Christmas Tokens!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/25d3ceda09b83e62ae29e945fadca4592b0fa97a.png[/img]
		
[b]Christmas Supply Drop[/b]
Santa will be riding his Reindeer Sleigh to give away some gifts! Christmas Supply Drop may contain following items:
[list]
[*] Christmas Paintings (small chance)
[*] Christmas Candy
[*] Christmas Fireworks
[*] Christmas Cape (Limited)  (small chance)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d6ab812d4685e8f70a81fcaf75f0b8388fdf9354.png[/img]

[b]Christmas Snowy Biomes[/b]

A majority of the biomes will be enjoying snowy views. During snowy seasons, some biomes might experience a “Christmas Blizzard”. Explorers digging blizzard snow cubes in Christmas Snowy biomes will have a chance of obtaining Christmas Tokens, Christmas Blizzard Snow Cube and Christmas Candy.

[b]Rate Boosts:[/b]
Double Harvest Rates on ores
Higher Exp from defeating Snowmen.

[h3]New Items:[/h3]
[b]Snowman Costume[/b]
[list]
[*] can be exchanged at Christmas Goblin Trading Center at 150 Christmas Tokens each.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/bd7c5a228bfde6b7cf6004db216436454bc75882.jpg[/img]


[h2]Missed Old Christmas Items? They are BACK![/h2]
[b]Christmas Goblin Trade Center[/b]
[list]
[*] Can be obtained by defeating Goblins wearing Red Hat or from Supply Drops.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/bd8502b6115a26fa2521ee21b2343930593aece5.jpg[/img]

[b]Christmas Reindeer Costume[/b]
[list]
[*] Can be purchased from Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 500 Christmas Tokens.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/31be07954bc87c20a81deebfff303bd983cc9be7.jpg[/img]

[b]Christmas Treant Costume[/b]
[list]
[*] Can be purchased from Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 500 Christmas Tokens.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/f589476d6586e1691ac3f825a49bc04a4bafc89d.jpg[/img]

[b]Christmas Reindeer Sleigh Saddle[/b]
Equipping it on a Reindeer allows one player to ride on it and fly across the map. With the Reindeer Christmas Platform Saddle, players can place up to 50 structures behind it. It can be purchased from Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 2000 Christmas Tokens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d9336d40134ae9af5b791701f1cb7742f4981058.jpg[/img]

[b]Christmas Hat[/b]
Players can get in the Christmas Spirit with these Christmas Hats! They can be purchased from the Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 200 Christmas Tokens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/924dae4b2c84b00f90243837a1cb7a4d06b9f1c4.jpg[/img]

[b]Rocking Reindeer[/b] - Drop rate of 10% from Christmas Tree Gift Boxes.
[b]Christmas Paintings[/b] - Drop rate of 40% from Christmas Tree Gift Boxes.
[b]Christmas Curtain[/b] - Drop rate of 30% from Christmas Tree Gift Boxes and Supply Drops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/4cf2d1742d11cdd8f410363e95e0e36fa91f79ef.jpg[/img]

[b]Christmas Fireplace[/b]
[list]
[*] Obtained from the Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 200 Christmas Tokens
[*] Placing a “Snow Devil Doll” at the Christmas Fireplace will start the Snow Devil Challenge
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ef794a8655492dcd10c2f95b1b1e2f968cf9e44d.jpg[/img]

[b]Snow Devil Doll[/b]
[list]
[*] Used at Christmas Fireplace to start the Snow Devil Challenge
[*] Can also be used as a Holiday Decor
[*] Can be obtained from Christmas Gift Box
[/list]   

[b]Creature Christmas Skins[/b]
All of the following skins have a chance of dropping upon defeating the Snow Devil Challenge, They can be purchased from Christmas Goblin Trade Center with Christmas Tokens:
[list]
[*] Christmas Dodo Skin (100 tokens)
[*] Christmas Pteranodon Skin (200 tokens)
[*] Christmas Iguanodon Skin (200 tokens)
[*] Christmas Gryphon Skin (400 tokens)
[*] Christmas Megarock Dragon Skin (400 tokens)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/0f292e6078ab985f6af9b842af345cd243f6759f.jpg[/img]

[b]Christmas Cape[/b]
Christmas Cape (Limited) can be obtained either from defeating the Snow Devil or from Christmas supply drops at a small chance.
Christmas Cape (Permanent) can be obtained by defeating the Snow Devil at a small chance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/3748cb41dff1be534350474b372fc245d1ea65ed.gif[/img]

Run into bugs? Help us squash them by reporting any bugs or issues here: 
http://bit.ly/2YMJQ3x

Please follow our Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, and Official Website for further news and updates for PixARK on Steam, PS4, Xbox One X, and Nintendo Switch.

notes.title: Pixark 1.145 Thanksgiving Patch
notes.content:
[h2]Steam Pixark 1.145 Thanksgiving Patch Notes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/003ff92c0583aa572892a88dd8a9da5de667dbca.jpg[/img]

[h3][u]Thanksgiving Gameplay[/u] [/h3]

[b]Thanksgiving Banquet[/b]
Place six different Thanksgiving dishes on the Thanksgiving Dining Table, and then press E to enjoy the treat and be rewarded with the Thanksgiving Buff. Placing Roasted Turkey right at the center of the Thanksgiving Dining Table will bring something special to Explorers.

[b]Pardoned Turkey Event[/b]
In the Noviceland biome, Explorers may find wild Turkeys locked in cages. Players will need to break the cage to free the Turkeys. Once they are freed, Turkeys will drop Turkey eggs that provide rewards. 
While freeing the caged Turkeys, explorers have a 30% chance of running into special Pardoned Turkey. Killing the Pardoned Turkey will drop the event item “Turkey Feather,” which can be used to summon Dodorex.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ef1f35f83c40a8167bcefc768cde45ac55064029.jpg[/img]
[b]Turkey Challenge - Summoning Dodorex[/b]
[list]
[*] Upon collecting a certain amount of Turkey Feathers, explorers can use them to summon either a Dodorex (20 mins at 90% chance) or a Dodorex (Permanent at 10% chance) at a cooking pot.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ad2a513442da8aa5d7dced861e18d78dd74e7d33.gif[/img]

[b]Dodorex[/b]
In the world of Pixark, even the weakest and humblest beings have dreams of becoming something stronger. And the Dodo, who is bullied by everyone, may become an existence to be feared by everyone. Legend has it that some dodos with exceptional talent were blessed by the ancestors of the dodo family and evolved into the most powerful Dodorex. Of course the legend is just a legend, in fact, people believe that Dodorex may be the descendants of Tyrannosaurus rex genetically modified by aliens. The biggest basis for this idea is that people have not yet found evidence of the existence of wild Dodorex.
[list]
[*] Tamed Dodorex can bite (LMB) and shoot flames (RMB)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/c88c0fba5deb52109bcb0714fbea803189851320.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/5d5169b14791ea7318d9e9bb7c4f112e830d9ccb.jpg[/img]
[h3][u]Thanksgiving Items:[/u][/h3]
[b]Thanksgiving Decor:[/b]
May drop from the Supply Drop and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event:
[list]
[*] Thanksgiving Dining Table
[*] Thanksgiving Chair
[*] Thanksgiving Recliner
[*] Thanksgiving Curtain
[*] Thanksgiving Decor Balloon
[*] Thanksgiving Wall Decor
[/list]

[b]Thanksgiving Dishes[/b]
May drop from the Supply Drop and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event.
[list]
[*] Roasted Turkey
[*] Pumpkin Pie
[*] Beef Wellington
[*] Salad
[*] Brownie
[*] Sweet Potato
[/list]

[b]Thanksgiving Equipment Skin[/b]
[i]Turkey Hat[/i] 
May drop from the Supply Drop and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/4a7a70e9475e13987f10a887cf85c41df9a1aa80.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/cc721c29e76af5eb7af4e0cece32fdab9d81f35a.png[/img]

[i]Drum-Stick[/i]
May drop from the Supply Drop and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event.

[i]Farmer’s Fork[/i]
May drop from the Supply Drop and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/c7aecb317cc79aa89a5b07515bea029f94854f27.jpg[/img]
[i]Dodo Chief Hat
[/i]Can be crafted using 30 Turkey Feathers at Tailor’s Workbench.
Can only be equipped on Dodorexes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ff1091019ac6b4ea586dc8ae29ce3a67f11fcd73.jpg[/img]
[h3][u]New items and Optimizations:[/u][/h3]
Skeleton horse is the most reliable partner of its knight. Wearing a set of knight armor can allow a skeleton horse to burst out more powerful energy, making its burning hell flames into a more scorching red hellfire. It also will cloak the skeleton horse with more defensive armor. 

[i]Effect:[/i] All damage is increased by 50%; damage taken is reduced by 50%; Sacrifice and flame path can deal damage to other fire creatures.


[b]Knight Armor Set:[/b]
Can be crafted at tailor’s workbench with turkey feathers
[list]
[*] Head：10 turkey feathers
[*] Top：5 turkey feathers
[*] Bottom：5 turkey feathers
[*] Hand：5 turkey feathers
[*] Foot：5 turkey feathers
[/list]

Wearing a set of Knight Armor will empower the skeleton horse while riding. 

[b]Knight Shield/Sword[/b]
Can be crafted at tailor’s workbench with turkey feathers
[list]
[*] Knight Shield：10 turkey feathers
[*] Knight Sword：20 turkey feathers
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/2b1025a61c6598d84a21b70cd871681bff0a516b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/f55a9951cfe977e7eea0a5f4d7268c2507e5fca8.gif[/img]

[b]Wyvern armor set upgrade[/b]
Equipping a set of wyvern armor on wyverns will enable the “Bless of the Ancient Wyvern King” buff, increase their attack damage by 20% and upgrade their RMB skills.

[i]Fire wyvern:[/i] Its flame will have explosive effects. The target inflicted by the explosion will take more damage in a small period of time.

[i]Poison wyvern:[/i] The poison will inflict a slowing effect. 

[i]Lightning wyvern:[/i] Its lightning will Inflict a short time immobilization effect on the target and a small area around it. 

[h3][u]Bug Fixes:[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*]    Fixed an issue where cloning rock drakes will consume a wrong amount of tek resources than expected. 
[/list]


Run into bugs? Help us squash them by reporting any bugs or issues here: 
http://bit.ly/2YMJQ3x

Please follow our Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, and Official Website for further news and updates for PixARK on Steam, PS4, Xbox One X, and Nintendo Switch.
PixARK is now available on Steam, PlayStation Store, Microsoft Xbox Store, and Nintendo eShop

notes.title: Steam 1.141 Halloween Patch Notes
notes.content:
Dear Explorers！ 
We are bringing you our brand new Halloween Patch! Happy Halloween! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/5af13278f3a65552c0d2e4e14b483695a1b1a727.png[/img]

[h3]New Gameplay: A Fantastic Beast and Where to Find It[/h3]
[b]Skeleton Horse[/b]

It is a skeleton war horse burning with the flames of hell. Legend has it that the skeleton horse is the mount of the knight of hell, and is the most reliable partner of the knight. It can fly to the sky and dive into the sea like walking on the ground, and the energy from hell also gives it the power of eternal life.

[u]Left click[/u] -  Normal attack

[u]Right click[/u]- Sacrifice: unleashes the flames of hell to inflict continuous damage to enemies within a certain range (damage value correlates to the HP of the  enemy, while damage upper limit correlates to the percentage of melee damage of the skeleton horse)

[u]'C' button[/u] - path of flame, activates its own hell energy, increases its own movement speed  by 50% and melee damage by 30%. Moving will leave a hell flame in place, enemies near the hell flame will take continuous damage (1-50 dmg/0.5 sec)

[i]Fire creatures are immune to the above skills[/i]

[u]Magical Crystal Berry: [/u]The food favored by skeleton horses that replenish their hell energy.  It can be crafted at magic workbench with a dark Magic Stone and a magic berry. 

[b]Where to find it? [/b]
[list]
[*] Skeleton Horse (permanent) can be summoned at “Conjuring Cooking Pot” at 70% chance with:
[list]
[*]  1x Breath Of the Dead
[*]  1x Pegasus DNA
[*]  2x Felhunter DNAs
[*]  5x Scent of the Pumpkin Soul Reaper
[/list]
[*] Upon failing, you will get a tamed Pegasus or a Felhunter.
[*] Defeating following monsters/BOSS will drop the corresponding items:
[list]
[*] Pegasus: Pegasus DNA at 20% chance, 
[*] Pumpkin Soul Reaper:  Scent of the Pumpkin Soul Reaper at 20% chance
[*] Felhunter:  Felhunter DNA at 20% chance 
[*] Death Lord (Boss)/ Bone Wyvern King (Boss): Breath of the Dead at 100% chance.
[/list][/list]Note：
[olist]
[*] “Conjuring Cooking Pot” can be crafted at magic workbench. 
[*] Breath of the Dead can be exchanged with 40  Scents of the Pumpkin Soul Reaper at the Conjuring Cooking Pot.  
[/olist]

Skeleton horse is endowed with strong vitality. Like any other bone creatures, it can resurrect as well.  It can be resurrected at the Conjuring Cooking Pot with 50 Magic Stone of any of the following types: Dark, Fire, Water, Thunder, Light, Earth, and Wind
[u]
Skeleton Horse Saddle:[/u]
Can be exchanged at tailor’s workbench with pumpkins. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/267ca412d493495947fac766e301e3098b982d54.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/a882752200f6fd9110632a9e312d9d69306c7704.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/e02c3890d3a4c72b4df0e2ee0b5c0233c98f6bb7.gif[/img]

[h3]THEY ARE BACK!![/h3]
Upon the arrival of Halloween, so do all those naughty Pumpkin Soul Reapers out there trick or treating. Hurry up and fight them off! 

During the event, Pumpkin Soul Reaper can be found in:
[u]Pixark[/u]: Novice Grassland, Grassland
[u]Skyward:[/u] Dawn Island, Woodland, and Void

Defeating it will drop:
[b]Scent of the Pumpkin[/b]
[b]Pumpkin Seed[/b]
[b]Magic Broom[/b] (7 days)
[b]Flying Firework[/b] (7 days)
[b]Clown Costume[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/e9ba5936c29ebd602db6add1e351fd404a973ab8.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Gameplay:  The Great Pumpkin Battle![/h3]

With Halloween fast approaching, we need plenty of pumpkins not only to decorate our homes but also to use them to exchange gifts! Hurry up and call your buddies to plant pumpkins together!

[b]Pumpkin seeds:[/b]
Defeating Pumpkin Soul Reapers will drop pumpkin seeds, which can be used to plant pumpkins.

Pumpkins can be exchanged for various Halloween gifts at the Tailor’s  Workbench

[h3]New Costumes! [/h3]

New skeleton costume set can be exchanged at the Tailor’s Workbench with: 
[u]Hat[/u]：400  pumpkins
[u]Top[/u]：200 pumpkins
[u]Hand[/u]：100 pumpkins
[u]Bottom[/u]：200 pumpkins
[u]Foot[/u]：100 pumpkins
[u]Skeleton Horse Saddle[/u]：1000 pumpkins

Remember the Scarecrow costume from before? They can be exchanged at 50% discount!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/74d3efc4b4bed3a5496822596722ac62e5f8e2b7.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d24310407b15373ad98197e08d25abfa2f2fcf0e.jpg[/img]

[h3]Old Events ARE BACK![/h3]
[olist]
[*] [b]Clown Supply Drops[/b] - Normal supply drops will turn into Clown Supply Drops. Explorers can obtain Halloween Decors and Halloween Candy Grenades at a chance from these drops.

[*] [b]Pumpkin Hat[/b]: Some creatures will be wearing Pumpkin Hats. There is a chance of them dropping the Hats that you can equip them on your tamed creatures.

[*] [b]Double Harvest rates on Ores and Exp rates[/b]
       Higher Exp from defeating Pumpkin Soul Reapers
[/olist]
[h3]Old Items ARE BACK! [/h3]
[olist]
[*] [b]Flying Firework[/b] (7 days)
 Can be obtained at a chance from defeating Pumpkin Soul Reapers. Expires in 7 days.

[*] [b]Flying Firework[/b] (permanent)
 Can be obtained at a small chance from defeating: Ancient Wyvern King, Aurora Butterfly King and Beach Bully.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/08c9010ea9e03547e00b53c34bb1d93062ec893c.jpg[/img]
 
[*] [b]Halloween Trees, Halloween Gravestones, Pumpkin Candle[/b] and [b]Pumpkin Wall[/b] Decors can be obtained from Clown Supply Drops.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/bd1445f70b44b07a7a1e8e18d3a53aa09a2f92d4.jpg[/img]
[*]  [b]Clown Costume[/b]
        Can be obtained from defeating Pumpkin Soul Reapers at a low rate.

[*][b] Halloween Candy Grenade[/b]
 Throw various Halloween Candy Grenade at other Explorers to transform them into characters wearing various Halloween Masks! The effect lasts for ten minutes. They can be obtained from the Clown Supply Drop. [/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/3a82f9064f284e15d0541f5c9f047c81b11f5b5c.jpg[/img]

Happy Halloween!

notes.content:
[h2]Steam Pixark 1.138 Mid-Autumn Festival Patch Notes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/35ee48914d5a3c567cee21d52ad8f7c3e8fdb030.jpg[/img]
[h3]New Events[/h3]

[b]Osmanthus Tree Challenge[/b]
Autumn, the season of harvesting, is finally upon us and there are a lot of Osmanthus trees blossoming on the land of Pixark. In China, it's customary to pick Osmanthus flowers and make Osmanthus drinks in autumn.

Grab the Wu Gang Axe (made in the Tailor's Workbench) and collect from Osmanthus trees with your friends!

Osmanthus Trees can be found on Novice Grassland, Dawn Island, Grassland, and Woodland.
Explorers can obtain “Mooncake token”  from Osmanthus trees using a Wu Gang Axe 

Mooncake Tokens can be used to exchange gifts from Mid-Autumn Festival Goblin Trading Center.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ea0211cb898525e3ce48873cfcd02653513de288.gif[/img]

[b]What’s THAT?! 
A [i]Lepursa[/i]?![/b]

Straight from the mad scientist's lair is a strange-looking creature with an equally strange name.  From its unique appearance, one can see the essence of other creatures, which could be extra-terrestrial in nature. This is a creature that has never before been found in the wild. It is a herbivore that has surprising combat expertise - especially after being fed carrots, which stimulate its potential and give it a burst of power. 

Defeating Pegasus, Icebear, Big-Ear Bunny will have a 20% chance of dropping their respective DNA.
Combine the following DNAs together at the cooking pot in order to summon the new Lepursa at a 60% chance:[list]
[*] 1 Pegasus DNA
[*] 2 Icebear DNA
[*] 5 Big-Ear Bunny DNA[/list]
Summoning has a 40% chance of failing and DNA will not be refunded in case of failure. One of the following creatures will be summoned instead:
 - Tamed Big-Ear Bunny
 - Tamed Pegasus
 - Tamed Icebear

Supply Drops will transform into Moon Rabbits that contain Mid-Autumn gifts:
[list]
[*] 20~30 Mooncake Tokens
[*] Mid-Autumn Festival Hat costume at a certain chance
[*] Mooncakes at a certain chance
[*] A Hou Yi Bow at a very small chance
[/list]
[b]Mid-Autumn Shining Moon[/b]
Whether it's day or night, a shining moon will appear in the sky to bless explorers!

[b]Double Harvest rates on mining ores.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/4996184863ff53556a7182661d4f3c5a66a2ea20.jpg[/img]
[h3]New Items[/h3]

[b]Mid-Autumn Festival Goblin Trading Center [/b]
Can be obtained from supply drops or by defeating goblins/goblin kings

[b]New Mid-Autumn Festival costumes[/b]
Can be exchanged at Mid-Autumn Festival Goblin Trading Center with Mooncake Tokens.
[list]
[*] Hat: 300 Mooncake Tokens
[*] Top/Bottom/Gloves/Foot: 200 Mooncake Tokens each
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/b343eeb0eef13050c9b84b708383488785c43f09.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/a8ed73975c7972f6ec7e9b79a2c87aecf44121d6.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[b]Wu Gang Axe[/b]
Can be crafted at Tailor’s Workbench

Can be exchanged at Mid-Autumn Festival Goblin Trading Center with 500 Mooncake Tokens.

notes.title: Creature/Structure Decay Timer Adjustments on Official PVE Servers
notes.content:
Dear Explorers,

In order to provide a smooth game environment and better game experience for our fellow explorers, the following adjustments will be made on August 20th. If you have any questions or concerns about these adjustments, feel free to reach out to us on social media.

[h3]Structure Timer Adjustment:[/h3]

For official PVE servers only, explorers who have not logged on 20 days, can have their structures demolished by other explorers. (Originally 14 days)

[h3]Creature Decay Timer Adjustment:[/h3]

For official PVE servers only, tamed creatures will auto-decay if explorers do not log on over 60 days. (Decay message will be shown in the tribe log, the creatures already turned into Pixblock won't auto-decay)

[b]Note:[/b] The calculation of the number of days the player has not been online starts right after the last time the player logged off on the official PVE server.

notes.title: PixARK Steam Summer Sale: Now available at $9.59 (lowest price ever)
notes.content:
[h2]PixARK Steam Summer Sale: Now available at $9.59 (lowest price ever) with the 2021 summer sports games edition included[/h2]

This weekend, PixARK will be taking part in Steam’s biggest promotion of the year - 2021 Steam Summer Sale. The voxel sandbox game has tons of whimsical and charming content to explore. During the sale, it will not only be offered at the historically low price of $9.59 (after 76% off), but it will also include the ground-breaking 2021 Summer Sports Games Edition, which includes boxing, racing, other contests, unique player uniforms, etc. Players can create a completely personalized arena in this open-world sandbox game. PixARK is the game you should not miss this summer!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/63b7a5606ffdedaeb40d30b518759ac717690c0f.png[/img]

[h3]Flexible combination, customization, be the lord of your game [/h3]
PixARK is a highly flexible and versatile voxel sandbox game. Players can tame all kinds of fierce and cute creatures in this magical world, create high-tech tools, and use resources and their own ingenuity to build a base of unlimited possibilities. The unique 2021 online sports games created by PixARK will improve continuously throughout the whole summer, for players to unleash their creativity.
Medals earned in the games can be used to redeem the latest sports uniform, which will make you the "hottest" girl or boy under the summer sun. There are also a variety of synthetic race tracks that can be combined. Use your imagination, create your own favorite track, and have your friends play together!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/8dca1b5aa622a9debd5b8f0ecd376157829f3470.jpg[/img]

Start a friendly competition and see who is best among your friends! In this summer sports games edition, you’ll be able to use the Starter Stand, Race Clock, and Finish Line to automate starting, timing, ranking, etc of any race you create. Use the synthetic race tracks and other items to create difficult courses and challenges and have a showdown with your friends in the game!
After the contests, reward your participants with unique items and celebrations. With the summer edition exclusive Podium, there will be a small ceremony to award the participants with gold/silver/bronze medals, which can be worn proudly to highlight the glory of the champions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/50c22067e9bb7f25e619fe869dd10d721269bd5e.jpg[/img]

The adventurers have their own sports games, and the creatures are eager for a match. These challengers can be found wearing gloves, ready to take on any boxer they encounter.

During this event, players will have to make boxing gloves to challenge creatures wearing gloves (Boxing Cyclops, Boxing Giant Claw Mole, Boxing Kairuku). If the players win, they can get corresponding medals the creatures drop, and redeem rewards in the Summer Sports Goblin Trading Center.

In addition, some creatures will be wearing the Summer Trophy Hat. Defeating them may drop the fashionable hat that can be worn by their tamed creatures.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/56a7fcea9c402fb16f2ce7a9284e0657202c76df.jpg[/img]
What? OMG! Your friends haven’t joined the happy world of PixARK? Tell them not to miss out on the Steam Summer Sale! At $9.59 (after 76% off), PixARK is at it’s lowest price ever. It is the best time to buy! Hurry up and ask your friends to join this summer carnival together!

notes.title: Pixark Steam 1.132 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Dear Explorers!

The blazing summer is here! It's time we compete with blood, sweat, and tears in this energetic summer together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/6b01fbcadf0a39dc88d56eccbef9fa80c83c2d63.jpg[/img]


[h2]New Events：[/h2]
[h3]-Boxing Match[/h3]
Even the creatures are eager for a match during this blazing summer! Explorers can make Boxing Gloves through recipes (lv6) to challenge creatures wearing boxing gloves, which will drop different medals. 
-Gold Medal Challenge: Boxling Cyclops
-Silver Medal Challenge: Boxing Giant Claw Mole
-Bronze Medal Challenge: Boxing Kairuku

Explorers can use the metals they obtain to exchange items at the Summer Sports Goblin Trading Center.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/9c17c7d8dfb72ed340faddb0ad63b4c49890b682.gif[/img]


[h3]- Summer Trophy Hat[/h3]
Explorers will have a chance obtaining a Summer Trophy Hat for their tamed creatures by defeating wild creatures wearing the hat. 
- 20% chance of looting the hat, and 80% chance of looting a bronze medal.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/56a7fcea9c402fb16f2ce7a9284e0657202c76df.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Event Creatures[/h2]
[h3]Boxing Cyclops[/h3]
Spawn Area：Doomlands，Black Rock Mountain，Frozen Land，Crystal Island
Upon defeating it with Boxing Gloves, players will have:
30% chance of obtaining 1 gold medal
70% chance of obtaining 2-5 silver medals

[h3]Boxing Giant Claw Mole[/h3]
Spawn Area：Grassland，Woodland，Desert，Twilight Forest
Upon defeating it with Boxing Gloves, players will have:
30% chance of obtaining 2 silver medals
70% chance of obtaining 2-5 bronze medals

[h3]Boxing Kairuku[/h3]
Spawn Area：Novice Grassland, Grassland, Dawn Island and Woodland. 
Upon defeating it with Boxing Gloves, players will have:
100% chance of obtaining 1-3 bronze medals


[h2]New Items[/h2]
[h3]Summer Sports Goblin Trading Center[/h3]
-Can be obtained through looting goblins, the goblin king, or in supply drops.
- Can be used to convert medals and exchange items:
  10 bronze medals to 1 silver medal;
  12 silver medals to 1 gold medal;
  1 gold medal to 8 silver medals;
  1 silver medal to 6 bronze medals.
[h3]Sports Uniform (Male/Female)[/h3]
- Can be exchanged at Summer Sports Goblin Trading Center with silver medals:
Head/Hands: 2 silver medals
Top: 6 silver medals
Bottom/Shoes: 5 silver medals

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/9ad23e79952ab64412a7869c6ea2abf6cf06a661.jpg[/img]

[h3]Synthetic race tracks[/h3]
- Use your imagination to create your very own race tracks! Hurry up! Call your friends and let’s race!
- Can be exchanged at Summer Sports Goblin Trading Center with medals
       -Straight track (can switch into 3 different forms with “Q” button): 2 bronze medals
       -Curve track (can switch into 5 different forms with “Q” button): 2 bronze medals
       -Numbered track (can switch into 5 different forms with “Q” button): 1 silver medal

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/8dca1b5aa622a9debd5b8f0ecd376157829f3470.jpg[/img]


[h3]Starter Stand/Race Clock/Finish Line[/h3]
-Race clock will start when a player activates the Starter Stand within 50 meters.
-Race clock will stop when a player crosses the Finish Line.
-Race clock can show the top three players of a single game.
-Race clock can be set to 100/200/400/800 meter race types.
- For each type of race, you can record a best score, record the player name and race results
-Can be exchanged at Summer Sports Goblin Trading Center with gold medals:
-Starter Stand: 2 gold medals
-Race Clock: 4 gold medals
-Finish Line: 4 gold medals
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/50c22067e9bb7f25e619fe869dd10d721269bd5e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/7aba2b80fbf0513996d60b44433163421818aac2.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/f8bec4801bac55c251f30c0a8f82d3c897ceca32.gif[/img]


[h3]Gold/Silver/Bronze Medal (cosmetic)[/h3]
-Upon using the item, it will display the medal in front of the character's chest for 2 hours.
-Can be exchanged at Summer Sports Goblin Trading Center with medals: 
            Gold medal(cosmetic): 2 gold medals
            Silver medal (cosmetic): 1 gold medal
            Bronze medal (cosmetic): 1 silver medal
            

[h3]Podium[/h3]
-Can be exchanged at Summer Sports Goblin Trading Center with 2 gold medals.


[h3]Torch[/h3]
-Can be exchanged at Summer Sports Goblin Trading Center with 1 gold medal.



[h2]Old Events/Items Are Back! [/h2]

[h3]- Holiday Dodo[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/8968d24d0cda0930a99c5d6950c30851ef0cc680.jpg[/img]
Some dodos who know how to treat themselves well have already put on their holiday beachwear! They are spotted at Novice Grassland/Grassland/Dawn Island/Woodland.

Upon defeating these Holiday Dodos, they will have a 10% rate dropping:
[h3]- Crab beachwear[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ba0c440efbc960454dcb72eecb9538bc2e7314f8.jpg[/img]
[h3]- Casual beachwear[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/f008c8c24ce3d80f37d281ce53a71a3b031bd188.jpg[/img]
They will also have a low chance dropping:
[h3]- Beach Lounger[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/783c31ee3c24bcf0462d0f690e4f697360d58cd0.jpg[/img]

notes.title: PixARK Patch 1.128 - Children’s Day Event
notes.content:
Dear Explorers!

 We bring you our Children’s Day Event! Hopefully you will enjoy it! The patch is scheduled to go live tonight at 12 am Pacific Time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/7705ccd42b336c1ba111a95e48d24d82a93dee32.jpg[/img]


[h2]New Items[/h2]

[h3]New Costumes! [/h3]

[b]Paperbox Head [/b]
- can be exchanged at Children’s Day Goblin Trading Center with 400 game coins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/b0fb8edd8587c8d85aed49bf28604da3ed107664.jpg[/img]

[b]Little Yellow Duckling Head[/b]
 - can be exchanged at Children’s Day Goblin Trading Center with 400 game coins.

[b] Rain boots [/b]
- can be exchanged at Children’s Day Goblin Trading Center with 400 game coins.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/43310ce7fbb9f8d0bdbc050e50e808c133f01565.jpg[/img]

[b]Fun Swing[/b]
  - Needs both Swing frame and Swing itself, which can be exchanged with 500 games coins each.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/c2947b96b0fb797e0b5486ccc7f591597b6dde25.gif[/img]

[b]Pirate Ship[/b]
  - Needs both Pirate Ship frame and Pirate Ship itself, which can be exchanged with 1200 game coins each.
  - Allows up to 4 players to board at the same time.
  - Electricity is required to power it up.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/61661f5c80bc03968db3f750b3335f0d05676591.gif[/img]

[h3]New Building Dyes[/h3]

[b]Shamrock/Parakeet/Seafoam/Mint/Pistachio[/b]

Seafoam and Pistachio will need to be exchanged with 50 game coins at the Children’s Day Goblin Trading Center.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/014b07af0c53ff5a2fc2b8003dd6aada29db717d.png[/img]

[h2]Old Items Are Back![/h2]

[b]Children’s Day Goblin Trading Center[/b]
- Can be obtained by defeating Goblins or Goblin Kings.
- Can also be obtained through Holiday supply drops.
- Used to exchange for Children’s Day event items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/9b3059e149c3579db7a38c6116b07ae13729bdba.jpg[/img]

[b]Children’s Day Costumes[/b]
- Hat: Can be obtained by hitting balloons during event.
- Top, Leg, Boot, Gloves：Can be exchanged through Children’s Day Goblin Trading Center for 200 game coins each.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/69b3caed7bfcb1098275d74e2d8eea5b36af2bcf.jpg[/img]

[b]Children’s Day Pickaxe/Sickle/Axe[/b]
- Has the same harvest rate as an Iron tool.
- Can be crafted using resources and dyes in Tailor’s Workbench.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/73b9deac70bf39a992849bc02c2c17267efc95b7.jpg[/img]

[b]Carousel[/b]
- Can be exchanged at the Children’s Daily Goblin trading center with 2000 game coins.
- A maximum of 4 players can ride together at a time.
- Needs electricity to function.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/cf5e2725068063d1486de7b1f560af38f2a9fa5c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/20534ea11eba386e2ae7b517ba2bbb6342a48d04.gif[/img]

[b]Paintball gun[/b]
- Equip dyes to create graffiti art on floors/structures (not including creatures).
- Can be exchanged at the Children’s Daily Goblin trading center with 500 game coins.
- Graffiti lasts 30 minutes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/4978bae5fca9ffca9bf579606ddd6599485e39e1.gif[/img]
	
[b]Candy Bomb[/b]
- Throw different types of candy towards players to transform them into different characters.
- Can be obtained through Children’s Day Goblin Trading Center with 50 game coins.
- Transformation lasts 10 minutes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d248793a0b73a1e0a270347f36a4f1d1ff8b5bc4.jpg[/img]

[b]Candy Arrow[/b]
- New level 15 recipe
- Used to shoot balloons.
- Crafting materials: Flint, Wood, and Tintoberry

[h2]Old Events Are Back As Well![/h2]

[b]Balloon shooting[/b]
-Balloons will Spawn in Novice Grassland/Grassland/Dawn Island/Woodland.
- Must be shot down by Bows with Candy Arrows.
[u]Drops:[/u]
- Balloon Backpack (20% drop rate, lasts 30 minutes)
- Children’s Day Hat Costume (10% drop rate)
- 4-6 Game coins
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/a6ddc642be7749767f62a4ff9e33f1fc328ed9cd.gif[/img]

[b]Candy Supply Drops[/b]
- Supply Drops have a new look with Children’s Day items inside!
[u]Drops:[/u]
- Candy Bomb
- Children’s Day Goblin Trading Center

[b] Tiny Yellow Hat[/b]
Some of the wild creatures found in PixARK are wearing tiny yellow hats. Defeat them for a chance to grab a Tiny Yellow Hat for your own tames and 2-4 Game Coins.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/45e01eb3d62efb9caecd754bf3d1aa63c82d6e54.jpg[/img]

[h2]Rate Boosts:[/h2]
- 2x harvesting rate boost on minerals.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/1a3bf0ea249152fd07ee1d140569c3a3c7d40570.jpg[/img]
Hi Explorers!

We have a familiar friend hopping into Pixark this weekend. Be sure to search high and low and maybe you'll find some tasty rewards!

[b]The patch is scheduled to go live tonight, April 2th at 1:30 am Pacific Time.[/b]

notes.content:

St. Patrick’s Day is upon us again! We are excited to bring back some of the classic events and a lot more new contents for our fellow Explorers to enjoy! 

[b]The patch is scheduled to go live tonight, March 12th at 12:00 am Pacific Time.[/b]

Servers will be down for a few hours to implement the following changes:

[*] Holiday Ribbon Cracker
[*] Balloon Arch
[*] St. Patrick’s Day Bed/table/chair/shelf/flower pot/painting

notes.title: Patch 1.118 - Lunar New Year 2021 Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/74a9bbe02ebc6e3ae90b8a1af495e19f51686a15.jpg[/img]
Hey Explorers!

Lunar New Year is just around the corner! [b]The Lunar New Year Patch is dropping tonight, 02/03 at 12:00 AM PT.[/b] It’s the Year of the Ox, and the Bull Demon King has long awaited for this moment to make his appearance in the world of PixARK. It is only around this time that daring Explorers may summon the Bull Demon King and battle him in a test of skill and bravery! Great rewards and great fortune await those powerful enough to defeat him!

The Lantern Dragon has made its way here for the Lunar New Year festivities as well! Players can obtain one by defeating the Bull Demon King, or build their very own by collecting pieces of the Dragon Lantern! Lantern Dragons come in many sizes - see if you and your friends can build a 5-seat Lantern Dragon for the ultimate ride! As a symbol of people’s aspirations for a better life in the new year, the Lantern Dragon and its pieces are also valuable against the nefarious  Bull Demon King!

What’s a celebration without glitz and glamor? A new Chainmail Set, Lance weapon, 8 additional structure colors are now available for all your Lunar New Year cosmetic needs! Returning are also some of last year’s Lunar New Year events! Don’t miss out on the Lunar New Year dishes - eat up for a full stomach and a variety of buffs!

Don’t forget to cash in on your Red Packets at the New Year Goblin Trading Center!

[h3]Community Features[/h3]
The past year has been full of fun and festive Holiday events, and we're looking forward to more in 2021! We would be happy to see how players are celebrating and partaking in the fun - please upload or send us screenshots or videos of the Lunar New Year event to the Steam Community Hub or on on Twitter (be sure to tag [b]@OfficialPixARK[/b] and/or use [b]#playpixark[/b]) for a chance to be featured on our Official Twitter account here: [url=https://twitter.com/OfficialPixARK]https://twitter.com/OfficialPixARK[/url]

Happy Lunar Year from the PixARK Team!

Full Patch Notes and details on the Lunar New Year festivities are below:

[h1]New Creatures[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/4c31bf89099ef1ca6ab42c98f3d2475a23fd7b26.jpg[/img]
[h2]New Challenge: [b]Bull Demon King[/b][/h2]
In mythology, the Bull Demon King is so powerful that he is said to be able to travel between heaven and hell, move mountains, and calm storming seas. Even the Adepti cannot do anything about him. In the Pixark world, he is the King of Minotaurs, with strength exceeding far more than its kind. The Bull Demon King’s only weakness seems to be special creatures such as the resilient Dragon Lanterns. Damage dealt by the Bull Demon King to the Dragon Lantern’s Head/Body/Tail, and players carrying a Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail is significantly reduced.
[list]
[*]The Bull Demon King is powerful, brave Explorers can take on the challenge by performing the traditional Chinese "Dragon Lantern Dance" 
[*]Players can obtain Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail by defeating Nian Beasts at Novice Grassland, Grassland, Dawn Island and Woodland.
[*]Players can initiate the Bull Demon Challenge at the Dragon Lantern Stand.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/7aa0bb371128069f738e220adda205fc04f632a8.jpg[/img]
[h3]Rules:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players will need to raise different types of Dragon Lanterns in a “Head-Body-Tail” order to initiate the Challenge. 
[*] Only the player holding the Dragon Head Lantern can initiate the challenge.
[*] The first and the final position have to be “Head” and “Tail” respectively. However, there can be up to 5 players holding “Body” in between.
[/list]

[h3]Challenge Requirements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] At least lv90 to initiate the challenge.
[*] Challenge can be done once per day.
[*] 3 players holding “Head-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 5 players and 8 creatures into the challenge. 
[*] 5 players holding “Head-Body-Body-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 8 players and 13 creatures into the challenge. 
[*] 7 players holding “Head-Body-Body-Body-Body-Body-Tail” will allow a total of 12 players and 19 creatures into the challenge. 
[/list]

[h3]Rewards:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lantern Dragon (Single Seat) at 100% chance, and another one at a small chance.
[*] Red Tassel Gold Lance at a small chance
[*] 50-100 Red Packets
[*] Chainmail avatar pieces at a small chance.
[/list]

[h3]Boss Skills:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Max Strike:[/b] An axe strike from above, lowers the speed of enemies. (Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail and players carrying a Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail will not be affected by the speed debuff)
[*] [b]Pierce:[/b] Pierces enemies with the end of the axe, causes a bleeding effect. (Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail and players carrying a Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail will not be affected by the bleed debuff)
[*] [b]Whirlwind:[/b] Spinning attack that hits enemies within range, inflicts an armor reduction effect. (Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail and players carrying a Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail  will not be affected by the armor reduction debuff)
[*] [b]War Stomp:[/b] Stomping initiates a shockwave that lowers the melee attack of all enemies nearby. (Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail and players carrying a Dragon Lantern Head/Body/Tail will not be affected by the debuff)
[*] [b]Boshosen:[/b] Blows enemies and knocks them back. Also increases the debuff effects of Whirlwind and War Stomp
[*] [b]War Cry:[/b] Raises its attack damage, defense and attack speed.  Applies additional effects on other skills:
[list]
[*] lowers Max Strike and Pierce cooldown
[*] Raises Whirlwind attack damage.
[*] Raises attack damage and range of the War Stomp
[*] Raises the range of Bashosen
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/b6d779bc9fca3a66da03df8eb7032cca84ec25e6.gif[/img]

[h1]New Items:[/h1]
[h2]New Year Goblin Trading Center [/h2]
Can be obtained from defeating goblins wearing God of Wealth hat or at event supply drops
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/42c8c7eb2e2615041396a1c3a9b03095567818b7.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Year Avatar Set - [b]Chainmail[/b][/h2]
Can be exchanged for at New Year Goblin Trading Center with red packets.
[list]
[*] Hat: 300 Red Packets
[*] Top: 200 Red Packets
[*] Bottom:150 Red Packets
[*] Gloves: 150 Red Packets
[*] Shoes: 150 Red Packets
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/cac5f6a288b8911ed4b0972083d083bb24905065.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Weapons[/h2]
[h3]Red Tassel Lance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Copper quality 
[*] Can be exchanged at New Year Goblin Trading Center with red packets
[/list]

[h3]Red Tassel Gold Lance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Iron quality
[*] Can be obtained from defeating the Bull Demon King at a low chance.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/24c7578c9c7da1fe1529fff6ff8efa0c1f9d5fc5.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Structure Dyes[/h2]
Adding 8 more color structure dyes
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/01d3b9002f4bdcee56b68962f7b6b09025043fc1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Dragon Lantern Stand[/h2]
[list]
[*] Can be used to start the Bull Demon King Challenge with: 
[list]
[*] Dragon Head Lantern 
[*] Dragon Body Lantern 
[*] Dragon Tail Lantern 
[/list]
[*] Can be exchanged for at New Year Goblin Trading Center with 300 Red Packets.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/65b634ee089b013cc899723f1db75c12fb3da48d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Dragon Head/Body/Tail Lantern [/h2]
[list]
[*] Defeating Nian Beast will drop Dragon Lantern parts (Head/Body/Tail) at 20% chance. 
[*] Dragon Head Lantern: Players can raise the Dragon Head Lantern to deal damage to the Bull Demon King. (Expires in 6 hours)
[*] Dragon Body Lantern:  Players can raise the Dragon Body Lantern to shield themselves. (Expires in 3 hours)
[*] Dragon Tail Lantern: Players can raise the Dragon Tail lantern to remove all buffs on Bull Demon King. (Expires in 3 hours)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/a62df3d9a192306ca56867d5c1f33ac24bac1c0b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/c68680dca2470704454fd32d4ad52686b3e2a3e3.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Mount: Lantern Dragon[/h2]
In China, lanterns are indispensable objects for festivals, and the flying Kong Ming lanterns are a symbol of people's aspiration for a better life. Now for the first time in Pixark, players can build their Lantern Dragon with lanterns and enjoy a ride with friends! 

Lantern Dragon can have up to 5 seats as you put more parts in! 
[list]
[*] Lantern Dragon（Single seat): can be obtained from defeating the Bull Demon King at a small chance.
[*] Lantern Dragon（Double seat): can be obtained from combining two Lantern Dragon（Single seat）at tailor’s workbench.
[*] Lantern Dragon（Triple seat): can be obtained from combining two Lantern Dragon（Double seat）at tailor’s workbench.
[*] Lantern Dragon（Quadra seat): can be obtained from combining two Lantern Dragon（Triple seat）at tailor’s workbench.
[*] Lantern Dragon（Penta seat): can be obtained from combining two Lantern Dragon（Quadra seat）at tailor’s workbench.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/b0597ae766af390ade082b0d9c5593337b4ba990.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/74b4dc234a44bbf1e9a4033b4f6bad4bbe1df591.gif[/img]

[h1]Old Lunar New Year Events Are Back! [/h1]
[h2]Boss: Flame Demon[/h2]
[list]
[*] Spawn rate is 50% at the Death Lord Altar in PixARK map and 50% at the Burial Ground Altar in Skyward map.
[*] Rewards:  Gargoyle Skin (5% drop rate)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/c9e29279f33a286206a5223911d4798a45b09ac1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/05c734b7557039e9a9bff737e5d873cd63070f6d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Lunar New Year Supply Drop[/h2]
[list]
[*] Supply Beacon will change its shape to a Chinese Lucky Bag, containing our Lunar New Year gift for explorers.
[*] Rewards: Spring Festival dishes (restores Food and HP), Spring Festival Fireworks, New Year Goblin Trading Center, Red Packets.
[/list]

[h2]Lunar New Year Reunion Party[/h2]
Placing different Lunar New Year dishes on the table will grant different buffs to the player, along with new year greetings. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/8b57c72b4d0453243e1843c7c47dc111db088332.jpg[/img]

[h2]God of Wealth Hat[/h2]
Players can obtain God of Wealth Hat at a small chance by defeating creatures that wearing it (Cosmetic for tamed creatures)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/3d569481272ee2c2c35de1efe7742fdd13725b4a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Nian Beasts are Back![/h2]
[list]
[*] Nian Beasts will be spawning in Novice Grassland, Grassland, Dawn Island and Woodland.
[*] Can only be defeated by the Firecrackers players crafted. 
[*] Rewards: Lunar New Year Dishes, Spring Festival Decors and blueprints, Red Packets.
[/list]

[h2]Double Harvest Rates on Mining![/h2]

[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]

notes.title: PixARK 1.117 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/b4aa68e1265c16f8ed820c5bcd665a4f0b82b9be.jpg[/img]

Happy new year! 

We hope everyone enjoyed the festive Holiday event and that you are all off to a wonderful start to the New Year! We would like to thank you for your continuing support and love from last year and are looking forward to more fun in 2021!

The patch will go live tonight at 12 am Pacific Time (Jan. 8th). Servers will be taken down to adjust the changes.

[h2]Event Changes：[/h2]
- Closing all Christmas Events

** Players will still be able to exchange Christmas Token at their Christmas Goblin Trading Center. 
** Players will still be able to challenge Snow Devil if they have “Snow Devil Dolls,” however, the boss will no longer drop Christmas Tokens.

[h2]Server Transfer Changes[/h2]
-Enabling the server transfer of following servers:

Asia-Pioneering-skyward9
Asia-Pioneering-skyward10

NA-Pioneering-skyward9
NA-Pioneering-skyward10

EU-Pioneering-skyward9
EU-Pioneering-skyward10

Run into bugs? Help us squash them by reporting any bugs or issues here: http://bit.ly/2YMJQ3x



Please follow our Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, and Official Website for further news and updates for PixARK on Steam, PS4, Xbox One X and Nintendo Switch.
