notes.title: PixARK Holiday Patch 1.116
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/4431a0349165d71f75a0274032b1a01a50e7f119.jpg[/img]
Dear Explorers!

We hope you had a wonderful Christmas and while the presents are all done, we have something new and exciting in store for the New Year!

[b]The patch will go live tonight at 12 am (PST). The servers will be taken down for a couple of hours during the maintenance.[/b]

[h2]New Year, New Event![/h2]
Invite your friends and celebrate 2021 with our new Jumbotron in the sky! On New Year’s Day at 12am (server time), there will be a firework showcase when the big clock reaches zero near the Jumbotron. Come and share an unique experience with friends!~ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/0cc10025f4229112a0a212ad1da0a4f8dafa10cc.gif[/img]

Happy Holidays and may the new year bring laughter, joy, and more exciting adventures to come!

-The PixARK Team

tags.feature: On New Year’s Day at 12am (server time), there will be a firework showcase when the big clock reaches zero near the Jumbotron.

notes.title: PixARK Christmas Patch 1.115
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/4431a0349165d71f75a0274032b1a01a50e7f119.jpg[/img]
Dear Explorers!

Happy Holidays and Merry Christmas! The end of the year is upon us, let’s take a look at what we have for the Holidays this year!

[b]The patch is scheduled to go live tonight, 12/18 at 12 am Pacific Time. The servers will be taken down for a couple of hours during the maintenance.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/007676dacde30eb2d8336dfda73346dec21868d5.jpg[/img]
[h1]New Boss:[/h1]
[h2]Snow Devil[/h2]
The legend has it that the horrifying Snow Devil was born in the land of sheer cold. The perpetual blizzard grants it endless power, allowing it to cast many powerful spells.

[h3]Skills:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Snowball:[/b]Activating blizzard energy and firing a gigantic snowball from its chest to attack the enemy from a long distance, dealing damage, and lowering enemy speed and cold resistance.
[*] [b]Blizzard:[/b]Rotating its body and releasing a snow tornado to attack enemies, dealing damage, and lowering enemy speed and cold resistance. 
[*] [b]Snow Pillar:[/b]Summoning a snow pillar to attack enemies on the ground.
[*] [b]One-Punch Devil:[/b]Gathering energy to its right fist and punching enemies afront, dealing damage, and lowering enemy speed and cold resistance.
[/list]

[h3]Special Abilities[/h3]
[list]
[*] Player’s cold resistance is reduced and heat resistance is increased within 50 meters of Snow Devil. The closer player gets to the Snow Devil, the stronger the effect.
[*] Snow Devil generates an aura of cold air beneath its foot when its HP is under 50%, dealing damage and lowering speed&cold resistance to enemies who touch it. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/cd318331f04dbd9d1006278b9ca8356d2bfec43d.gif[/img]

[h1]New Gameplay[/h1]
[h2]Snow Devil Challenge[/h2]
[list]
[*] Players can start the challenge by placing “Snow Devil Doll” at the Christmas Fireplace.
[*] Christmas fireplace can be obtained at Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 200 Christmas tokens.
[*] Snow Devil Doll have a chance of droppingn from Christmas gift boxes.
[/list]

[h3]Challenge Prerequisites[/h3]
[list]
[*] Character level ≥90
[*] A maximum of 10 creatures 
[*] A maximum of 5 players
[*] [b]Note:[/b] Each character can challenge Snow Devil only once per day.
[/list]

[h3]Boss Loot[/h3]
[list]
[*] Small chance of obtaining following skins:
[list]
[*] Christmas Dodo Skin
[*] Christmas Pteranodon Skin
[*] Christmas Iguanodon Skin
[*] Christmas Gryphon Skin
[*] Christmas Megarock Dragon Skin
[/list]
[*] A small chance of obtaining following items:
[list]
[*] Christmas Cape (Limited)
[*] Christmas Cape (Permanent)
[*] Christmas Reindeer Sleigh
[*] 300-600 Christmas Tokens
[/list]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ef794a8655492dcd10c2f95b1b1e2f968cf9e44d.jpg[/img]
[h1]New Items[/h1]
[h2]Christmas Fireplace[/h2]
[list]
[*] Obtained from Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 200 Christmas Tokens
[*] Placing a “Snow Devil Doll” at the Christmas Fireplace will start the Snow Devil Challenge
[/list]

[h2]Snow Devil Doll[/h2]
[list]
[*] Used at Christmas Fireplace to start the Snow Devil Challenge
[*] Can also be used as a Holiday Decor
[*] Can be obtained from Christmas Gift Box
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/0f292e6078ab985f6af9b842af345cd243f6759f.jpg[/img]
[h2]New Creature Skins[/h2]
All of the following skins have a chance of dropping upon defeating the Snow Devil Challenge, They can be purchased from Christmas Goblin Trade Center with Christmas Tokens:
[list]
[*] Christmas Dodo Skin (100 tokens)
[*] Christmas Pteranodon Skin (200 tokens)
[*] Christmas Iguanodon Skin (200 tokens)
[*] Christmas Gryphon Skin (400 tokens)
[*] Christmas Megarock Dragon Skin (400 tokens)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/3748cb41dff1be534350474b372fc245d1ea65ed.gif[/img]
[h2]Christmas Cape[/h2]
[list]
[*] Christmas Cape (Limited) can by obtained either from defeating the Snow Devil or from Christmas supply drops at a small chance.
[*] Christmas Cape (Permanent) can be obtained by defeating the Snow Devil at a small chance.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/98501877c54eeb393bf3ef7db651cff7de5fceb9.jpg[/img]
[h1]Previous Christmas Events Are BACK![/h1]
[h2]Christmas Blessing Tree[/h2]
Decorating Christmas Tree with various decor will grant you a Christmas Blessing buff. The Christmas Tree can be exchanged with Christmas Token at the Christmas Goblin Trade Center. Decorating the tree with Christmas Dolls in five unique colors, will gift players with the Christmas Blessing and a Christmas Gift Box. 

Christmas Gift Box may contain one or more of the following items: 
[list]
[*] Rocking Reindeer
[*] Christmas Painting
[*] Christmas Curtain
[*] Snow Devil Doll
[/list]

[b]Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Christmas Dolls may be obtained by looting Snowman.
[*] Christmas Goblin Trade Center can be obtained by looting Goblins wearing a Christmas Hat or from Christmas Supply Drop.
[*] Christmas Token can be harvested from Snow Cubes in Christmas Blizzard
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/eaa8bf8c80316961635c7002cdf1581b9c51e8f9.jpg[/img]
[h2]Snowman Fight[/h2]
Snowmen will spawn in Noviceland, Grassland, Dawn island, and Woodland. Players will need to craft Snowballs to attack the Snowmen, which will drop one or more following items: 
[list]
[*] Christmas Candy 
[*] Christmas Dolls (50% drop rate)
[*] Snowman Figure
[*] Snowman Costumes
[*] Christmas Token
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/f45ac8fabf180e1e6fe51a0ab19659b6fc5bae1b.jpg[/img]
[h2]Red Hat Creatures[/h2]
Christmas Red Hats have a small chance of dropping from any creature wearing them. Creatures wearing Christmas Red Hats may also drop Christmas Tokens!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/d9336d40134ae9af5b791701f1cb7742f4981058.jpg[/img]
[h2]Christmas Supply Drop[/h2]
Santa will be riding his Reindeer Sleigh to give away some gifts! Christmas Supply Drop may contain following items:
[list]
[*] Christmas Paintings (small chance)
[*] Christmas Candy
[*] Christmas Fireworks
[*] Christmas Cape (small chance)
[/list]

[h2]Christmas Snowy Biomes[/h2]
A majority of the biomes will be enjoying snowy views. During snowy seasons, some biomes might experience a “Christmas Blizzard”. Explorers digging blizzard snow cubes in Christmas Snowy biomes will have a chance of obtaining Christmas Tokens, Christmas Blizzard Snow Cube and Christmas Candy.

[h2]Rate Boosts:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Double Harvest Rates on ores
[*] Higher Exp from defeating Snowmen.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/bd8502b6115a26fa2521ee21b2343930593aece5.jpg[/img]
[h1]Missed the old Christmas Items? They're back![/h1]
[h2]Christmas Goblin Trade Center[/h2]
Can be obtained by defeating Goblins wearing Red Hat or from Supply Drops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/31be07954bc87c20a81deebfff303bd983cc9be7.jpg[/img]
[h2]Christmas Reindeer Costume[/h2]
Can be purchased from Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 500 Christmas Tokens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/f589476d6586e1691ac3f825a49bc04a4bafc89d.jpg[/img]
[h2]Christmas Treant Costume[/h2]
Can be purchased from Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 500 Christmas Tokens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/9887e269fac234fa1ea82ab2db024a46f8bfcb44.jpg[/img]
[h2]Christmas Reindeer Sleigh Saddle[/h2]
Equipping it on a Reindeer allows one player to ride on it and fly across the map. With the Reindeer Christmas Platform Saddle, players can place up to 50 structures behind it. It can be purchased from Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 2000 Christmas Tokens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/924dae4b2c84b00f90243837a1cb7a4d06b9f1c4.jpg[/img]
[h2]Christmas Hat[/h2]
Players can get in the Christmas Spirit with these Christmas Hats! They can be purchased from Christmas Goblin Trade Center with 200 Christmas Tokens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/4cf2d1742d11cdd8f410363e95e0e36fa91f79ef.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Rocking Reindeer - Drop rate of 10% from Christmas Tree Gift Boxes.
[*] Christmas Paintings - Drop rate of 40% from Christmas Tree Gift Boxes.
[*] Christmas Curtain - Drop rate of 30% from Christmas Tree Gift Boxes and Supply Drops.
[/list]

Happy Holidays!

-The PixARK Team

notes.title: Patch 1.112 - Thanksgiving Event - 2x Ores & 2x Exp!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/6a3fe2fa5f2365a47a11c69fbf532489006125b8.jpg[/img]
When could be a better time to show our sincere gratitude to explorers other than Thanksgiving! Thank you so much for your continuing support and love!  

[b]The Thanksgiving patch is scheduled to go live on November 20th at 12 am (PDT). [/b]

Let’s take a look at what we prepared for you this year! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/003ff92c0583aa572892a88dd8a9da5de667dbca.jpg[/img]
[h1]Thanksgiving Event Gameplay[/h1]

[h2]Thanksgiving Banquet[/h2]
Place six different Thanksgiving dishes on the Thanksgiving Dining Table, and then press E to enjoy the treat and be rewarded with the Thanksgiving Buff. Placing Roasted Turkey right at the center of the Thanksgiving Dining Table will bring something special to Explorers.

[h2]Pardoned Turkey Event[/h2]
In the Noviceland biome, Explorers may find wild Turkeys locked in cages. Players will need to break the cage to free the Turkeys, which will drop Turkey eggs that provide rewards. While freeing the caged Turkeys, explorers have a 10% chance of running into special Pardoned Turkey. Killing the Pardoned Turkey will drop the event item “Turkey Feather,” which can be used to summon Dodorex.

*Pardoned Turkeys have a relatively high HP, and will run away even if they are under attack.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/cb97d59bff514a9570f70d7b1e705c7ce73cf243.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/7f3ac06213856e34cdb1de6906b31ff046e7179c.gif[/img]

[h1]New Creature[/h1]

[h2]Dodorex[/h2]
In the world of Pixark, even the weakest and humblest beings have dreams of becoming something stronger. And the Dodo, who is bullied by everyone, may become an existence to be feared by everyone. Legend has it that some dodos with exceptional talent were blessed by the ancestors of the dodo family and evolved into the most powerful Dodorex. Of course the legend is just a legend, in fact, people believe that Dodorex may be the descendants of Tyrannosaurus rex genetically modified by aliens. The biggest basis for this idea is that people have not yet found evidence of the existence of wild Dodorex.

-Upon collecting a certain amount of Turkey Feathers, explorers can use them to summon either a Dodorex(Limited-time) or a Dodorex (Permanent) at a cooking pot.
 
-Tamed Dodorex can bite (LMB) and shoot flames (RMB)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/a38d879dbf4134e1972bec2ab6083e72821bb2e8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/f30b403c7d6c6b78f2eae8425ec3ed213e46ab7c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Thanksgiving Event Items[/h1]

[h2]Thanksgiving Decor [/h2]
May drop from the Supply Drop and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event.
[list]
[*] Thanksgiving Dining Table
[*] Thanksgiving Chair
[*] Thanksgiving Recliner
[*] Thanksgiving Curtain
[*] Thanksgiving Decor Balloon
[*] Thanksgiving Wall Decor
[/list]

[h2]Thanksgiving Dishes [/h2]
May drop from the Supply Drop and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event.
[list]
[*] Roasted Turkey
[*] Pumpkin Pie
[*] Beef Wellington
[*] Salad
[*] Brownie
[*] Sweet Potato
[/list]

[h2]Thanksgiving Equipment Skin[/h2]
[list]
[*] Turkey Hat: May drop from the Supply Drop and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/6c10cc71119031c81e3af719113d7e64972b7bd3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/e7ba3f7e06d94704885e46925d53bc8a662faffc.png[/img]

[h1]New Items[/h1]
[h2]Drum-Stick[/h2]
Drop from the Supply Drop and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event.

[h2]Farmer’s Fork[/h2]
Drop from the Supply Drop and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/c63bb8070daf3cf8269eb247f57d3eafa355062f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Dodo Chief Hat[/h2]
[list]
[*] Can be crafted using 30 Turkey Feathers at Tailor’s Workbench. 
[*] Can only be equiped on Dodorexes.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/8854e00de5c020521ca1b52d43c8a11b10b5a99a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Rate Boost[/h1]
Harvest rate on Ores and Exp rates will be doubled during the event period.


Have a Happy Thanksgiving!

-PixARK Team

notes.title: PixARK Patch 1.111
notes.content:
Dear Explorers,

Hopefully you all had an awesome Halloween! Due to a recent issue with Flying Firework (permanent) disappearing from the inventory, we will make it available again for everyone!

The patch is scheduled to go live tonight at 12:00 a.m. (Pacific Time) on November 9th. You will be able to get permanent Flying Firework again from defeating bosses (Ancient Wyvern King/Aurora Butterfly/Beach Bully) until November 20th at 12:00 a.m. (Pacific Time). 

We apologize for the inconvenience, and thank you for your continuing support!

notes.title: Patch 1.109 - Halloween Fun returns to PixARK!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/12cb2a105fb5126f92e959c8e8668dd11fe58c41.jpg[/img]
Dear Explorers,

Happy Halloween!! The Halloween patch is scheduled to go live on October 23rd at 12 am (PDT). Let’s take a look at what we prepared for you this year!

A spooky makeover for the main menu:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/76c02db2a8fce0eae87ceb5f69324f0a4d4158c1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Special Event Creature - Pumpkin Soul Reaper[/h1]
During the event, Pumpkin Soul Reaper can be found in:
[list]
[*] [b]Pixark:[/b] Novice Grassland,Grassland
[*] [b]Skyward: [/b]Dawn Island, Woodland, and Void
[/list]

Defeating it will drop:
[list]
[*] Pumpkin Seed
[*] Magic Broom (7 days)
[*] Flying Firework (7 days)
[*] Clown Costume 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/932b9f1cf967f3e0c044e0e931020d248c494a10.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Halloween Items[/h1]
[b]Flying Firework (7 days) [/b]
Can be obtained at a chance from defeating Pumpkin Soul Reapers. Expires in 7 days.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/8fce5b3f59ee3cc13b4e11c09b038b0e1d8ecbcd.gif[/img]

[b]Flying Firework (permanent)[/b]
Can be obtained at a small chance from defeating: Ancient Wyvern King, Aurora Butterfly King and Beach Bully.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/3421d097db6e9f6cc007c7aad3cbe8cb08acca58.gif[/img]

[b]Halloween Costume: Scarecrow Costume[/b]
Pumpkin Seeds from Pumpkin Soul Reapers can be planted in order to harvest pumpkins. Explorers can then use them as crafting material for the costume at Tailor’s Workbench.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/b60597053029898cf77b461366afab54f7e8cb2f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Halloween Decorations ARE BACK![/h1]

notes.title: Update On the Server Closure
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ae10febdff384d93a954dbe110d677bcf0431cfd.jpg[/img]

Dear Explorers,

We first and foremost would like to express our deepest apologizes for the server shutdown, and the trouble it caused to our fellow explorers. We would then like to thank you for not only all the feedback you provided but also the time and effort that you have put into the game that we love. 

We will postpone our server closure, and focus on optimizing item/dino transfer experience for all explorers. Our goal is to save as much player data as possible so that players can have a smooth gameplay experience.

Additionally, we will push out a new tool in the near future where explorers could save an area of structures and transfer to another server altogether. Explorers could use this tool and create different strategies on PVE and PVP servers. 

We will also provide brand new servers for players to build/transfer on after the server closure.

We value every input and appreciate your feedback. Thank you for your understanding and continuing support!

notes.title: PixARK Patch 1.106
notes.content:
Dear Explorers!

Introducing a cool steel airship and more new creatures! This patch will go live tonight at 12 am (PT), August 14th. 

New Creatures:
1.	Iguanodon

A medium-sized herbivore with a pair of pointy thumbs that excels at gathering berries and seeds.It possesses well-developed hind limbs that allow it to stand up and walk on two feet, as well as run quickly on four! Normally wild Iguanodons are gentle and do not actively attack other creatures, but they will not hesitate to fight back when they are assaulted.

Tamed Iguanodons have been found to not only aid in the collection of berries and seeds, but also in special methods to help extract seeds from berries. When ridden, an Iguanodon can also be switched to travel mode, allowing it to use its four feet to run quickly without draining stamina.


Left-click: normal attack, harvest bushes, and grass.
Right-click: switching between travel and normal mode
“C” button: Eats a berry or crop will greatly enhance its attack, and there is a chance of extracting a random berry, crop, or magic crop seed.

Can be found in the Swamp (PixARK) and Glittering Ridge (Skyward)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/f24bc0087cdaee1edc0a7cc0cd3d4dc49feb2896.jpg[/img]
 
2.	Cobalt Winged Serpent 

Can be found at Twilight Woods

3.	Cobalt Void Manta

Can be found at the Void

4.	Cobalt Ghost Dragon

Can be found at the Blackrock Mountain
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/3fa2ac0f65c5fa8103df8913b2a4746a5ee11b32.jpg[/img]

 
New Structures:
Steel Airship
Steel Airship can be learned under Industrial Engrams and crafted at a Fabricator at lv70. Steel Airships will require gasoline as fuel. It’s a sturdy structure with high HP and Weight limit, allowing players to build other structures on top. Steel Airships can be controlled by WASD keys as well as the right-click button for direction, and the C & X keysfor elevation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/14402eb75849a2f424246e0cd99afb4e6c1201a5.gif[/img]

New Item
1.	Iguanodon Saddle,can be learned at lv35. 
Optimization:
1.	Fertilizers can now have 100 per stack.

BUG Fixes
1.	Fixed a bug where Flash Grass Block cannot be crafted.
2.     Fixed a bug where the creature costumes can add armor.
3.     Fixed a bug where the Chomper/Green Vine/Nepenthes  attack not consume fertilizer.

notes.title: Summer Update
notes.content:
And ITTTTT’S SUMMER!! Let’s put on our stylish beachwear and enjoy this energetic Summer! The patch is scheduled to go live later tonight!
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ed7357ac1a3322bf2ed4c417696d5d26f083c252.jpg[/img]

New Creatures:

- New Boss: Beach Bully

A gigantic, vicious crab with 4 claws and 8 long legs coming from deep ocean that attacks any creatures near the beach!  

Special ability: Upon reaching 50% HP or lower, its body will transform from blue to red, increasing its attack by 20% and decreasing its defense by 15%.

Regular attack: Using its enormous claws to attack enemies

Skills:
1. Clawing Pressure: Using its claw to immobilize a target in front of it, lowering the target’s movement speed greatly. 
2. Hydro Pump: Pumping out a stream of water from its claws to attack enemies.
3. Rampaging destruction: Using its 4 claws to attack target, dealing tons of damage. (Using this skill will release any target it held previously; however, additional damage will be dealt to that target)
4. Bully Smash: Using its claws to smash target in front of it (apply additional armor penetration effect to target it held)
5. Body Slam: Jumping high from its position and smashing any targets within its range upon landing (Using this skill will release any target it held previously; however, additional damage will be dealt to that target)
6. Bubble beam: A spray of water is forcefully ejected at the target. It also deals more damage to target it held.
7. Blizzard: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the target from its claws, dealing damage to enemies in front and either lowering movement speed/lowering melee attack damage once hit. (Both debuffs will be applied to the target it held)

Rewards:
- 325 Tek energy cubes and one or two of the following items:

- Master wand (with rather high quality)
- TekTapejara Saddle
- Tek Rex Saddle
- TekRockdrake Saddle
- Ancient Gargoyle skin
- Magic broom
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/cb81d0d639734faabd520ecc7513a74e593183bf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/855190af29802d32831b7fde7c03ac3d05a63ae0.jpg[/img]
 
- Holiday Dodo
Some dodos who know how to treat themselves well have already put on their holiday beachwear! They are spotted at Novice Grassland/Grassland/Dawn Island/Woodland.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/8968d24d0cda0930a99c5d6950c30851ef0cc680.jpg[/img]

Upon defeating these Holiday Dodos, they will have a 10% rate dropping:
- Crab beachwear
- Casual beachwear

They will also have a low chance dropping:
- Beach Lounger
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ba0c440efbc960454dcb72eecb9538bc2e7314f8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/f008c8c24ce3d80f37d281ce53a71a3b031bd188.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/783c31ee3c24bcf0462d0f690e4f697360d58cd0.jpg[/img]

You could build your own fountain with these Sprinklers! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/03fa359294c44717f3b7b217d1d02a61c4bfb115.gif[/img]

Fixed a production-related issue with alien research platform

-The PixARK Community Team

notes.title: 03/12 Patch 1.90 - St. Patrick's Day Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/959839f1c3f6275781d01bd2c8e063567ed94309.png[/img]
Greeting Explorers!

We are excited to bring you our brand new St. Patrick’s Day patch! We hope you’ll have lots of fun as St. Patrick's Day approaches next week. :)

[b]The patch is scheduled to go live tonight, Mar 13th, at 12:00, am Pacific Time. [/b]

Servers will be down for a few hours to implement the following changes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/f5b2a805975f73b46f745e9a9b77e9aed0728528.jpg[/img]
[h1]New Boss: Aurora Butterfly King[/h1] A gigantic creature in the shape of a butterfly with aurora glowing from its wings. It will enter an “Aurora” phase in battle where its body will turn almost invisible. Explorers, look out for a fascinating beam of butterfly-shaped Aurora!

[b]Skills:[/b]
[list]
[*] Normal attack: Uses its mouth to bite down enemies. 
[*] Aurora beam: Releases a beam of aurora from its mouth. The attack power is increased if it is in invisible mode.
[*] Butterfly Powder: The powder from its wings will deal poison damage over time to its enemies nearby, also lowering their attack powers. While in its shining mode, Butterfly powder will lower the attack and defense of its enemies nearby.
[*] (powder can be eliminated by the breath of fire from fire wyverns)
[*] String shot: Deals a small amount of damage while immobilizing enemies for a long period of time.
[*] (Wyverns cannot be immobilized)
[*] Butterfly Dance: Deals damage to enemies nearby and confuses them. Enemies will be unable to coordinate their movements for a short period of time.
[*] (Wyverns cannot be confused)
[*] Mirage: Creates a mirage of itself. Mirage will have  70% of its attack and 20% of its HP. 
[*] (Lightning/poison wyvern will deal triple damage to mirages)
[*] Aurora Mode: Turns itself, as well as its Mirages, to nearly invisible beams of aurora. Their attack damages will be lowered, but their defense will raise. Some skills are changed in Aurora mode as noted.
[/list]

[b]Dungeon:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players will need to summon the “Ancient Gate” to teleport and challenge the Aurora butterfly king.   
[*] Players will need to collect 7 types of magic stone (Dark/Water/Wind/Thunder/Fire/Light/Earth) and summon the “Ancient Gate” through the inscription book.
[*] Different sizes of the “Ancient Gate” can be summoned at different rates, which determines the amount of players/creatures that can go into the challenge. 
[*] Upon summoning,  “Ancient Gate” will be in inactivated mode. Players will need to obtain Energy Stone, which is craftable in the Alchemy Stove, to be placed on the Ancient Gate to activate the portal. If you wish to challenge the Aurora Butterfly King again, you will have to place another energy stone to activate the portal again.
[*] Upon activation, holding “E” button will allow you to choose which boss you would like to challenge. You can only challenge one boss per activation
[*] The cooldown for the boss fight will be 24 hours.
[/list]

[b]Rewards:[/b]
250 Tek energy cubes and one or two of the following items:
[list]
[*] - Ancient Gargoyle Skin (30% drop rate)
[*] - Magic Broom (permanent)  (30% drop rate)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/da010b5baf5dd73f8cf71f06f94f29ad6a8de9e4.jpg[/img]
[h1]New Creatures[/h1][list]
[*][b]Cobalt Beetle:[/b] Spawns at Glittering Ridge
[*][b]Cobalt Firespider: [/b]Spawns at Twilight Forest
[*][b]Cobalt Mantis:[/b] Spawns at Twilight Forest
[/list]

[h1]New Items[/h1]
[h3]New greenhouse items:[/h3][list]
[*]Unlocked at lv35 under the “Industrial Skill” tab.
[*]Greenhouse can raise plant growth rate by 300%
[*] Effective only for plants that can be planted in pots. 
[/list]
[b]Note: [/b]There cannot be structures above the greenhouse blocking the sunlight, otherwise the boosting effect will disappear.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/efee45c1c65b01f4c1259f32752686266a6b068e.jpg[/img]

[h3]New St. Patrick’s Day goblin trading center[/h3][list]
[*]Can be obtained by defeating Goblins or Goblin Kings. 
[*]Can also be obtained through Holiday supply drops.
[*]Used to exchange for St. Patrick’s Day event items.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/c2714a9b55f60576ce9079c5c1df625858ea832f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/9e230cd9e745971159f988014b792b866490502f.jpg[/img]
[h3]St. Patrick’s Day Costumes:[/h3][list]
[*][b]Hat:[/b] Can be obtained through St. Patrick’s Day goblin trading center using 4-leaf clover.
[*][b]Top:[/b] Can be obtained through St. Patrick’s Day Wishing tree and red handkerchief event at a certain rate
[*][b]Leg, Boot, Gloves:[/b] Can be obtained through St. Patrick’s Day goblin trading center using Shamrocks.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/0c5a5d793f1fe9b67a5526103c992a01076f8467.jpg[/img]
[h3]St. Patrick’s Day Wishing Tree[/h3]
Obbtained through St. Patrick’s Day goblin trading center. Upon tying Red Handkerchief (also obtained through St. Patrick’s Day goblin trading center) to the tree, the following rewards can be obtained:
[list]
[*] St. Patrick’s Day Top
[*] 4-leaf Clover
[*] Cobalt Organic Matter
[*] DarkGreen Creature Coloring
[*] Green Dye
[*] Dark Green Dye
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/bcdc6c22a3ebe202d07f2f4fb2412455a9221fbb.jpg[/img]
[h3]Shamrocks and 4-leaf clovers:[/h3][list]
[*]Shamrock seeds can be obtained by harvesting regular grass using [strike]Triceratops[/strike] Parasaur
[*]Planting the seed will either allow you to harvest Shamrocks or 4-leaf clovers
[*]Using greenhouse allows Shamrock seeds to grow much faster.
[*]Can be used at St. Patrick’s Day goblin trading center to exchange event items.
[/list]

[h3]Additional Changes:[/h3]
[b]- Supply drops will be Pot of Gold Shaped and contain:[/b]
[list]
[*]St. Patrick’s Day goblin trading center
[*]Red handkerchief
[/list]

[b]- Water will be turning green during the event![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/9749380743db770cd81dda655ced3cddbc8abc8e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Years Countdown Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/11df7b9f483c3d824d8b5cf980437adca8cd471b.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Explorers!

We hope you all had a wonderful year, and look forward to an even greater 2020! The next PixARK update is scheduled to go live at 12:00 am PDT on December 27th. Official Servers will be offline for a few hours.

[b][i]Update: the patch is delayed to go live at 9:00 am PDT on December 27th. [/i][/b]

[h1]New Year Countdown[/h1]
In celebration of the upcoming new year, we are adding a noticeable New Year Countdown Timer in the sky at the center of the map. From any biome in both the PixARK map or the Skyward map, when you look up, you can see the timer counting and when it reaches 2020/01/01 00: 00: 00 (server/local time), all explorers will be treated to a fireworks show NEARBY the timer! (Note: fireworks visuals won't be rendered if the players are too far away from the giant clock.)


[h1]New Items[/h1]
[list]
[*] Countdown Clock: needs to be powered; players can input the time they want to count down from, and when it counts down to zero, the Trigger will send an activation signal to switch all the electricity-powered devices to “on”. The Countdown Clock engram can be unlocked at level 55, and craftable in the Fabricator.
[*] Fireworks Launcher: needs to be powered; players can place Fireworks Bullets inside its inventory, and turn on the switch to automatically shoot the fireworks in the sky; when aiming at the Fireworks Launcher, you can also hold E to select how high you want the fireworks to be fired. The Fireworks Launcher engram can be unlocked at level 55, and craftable in the Fabricator.
[/list]

[h1]Fireworks Drops[/h1]
Fireworks can be obtained at a higher drop rate from the Supply Beam which will also spawn at a higher rate. 

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list] 
[*] Fixed an issue where the Cobaltenergy Golem did not show the correct required time for a mutation in the Radiation Mutation Platform. 
[/list]

Be sure to report bugs

[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSftwSjr9FShosX8xvNEug1J_sCcPVqrgckqE0i39WhqWuROMw/viewform]here.[/url]

notes.title: PixARK Christmas Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/e9ed2dacc176e7bca91d94f6107af35ecd5ac4b6.jpg[/img]

Greeting Explorers!

Merry Christmas & happy holidays! Our Christmas Patch is scheduled to go live at [b]12:00 am PDT on December 17th[/b]. Official Servers will be offline for a few hours.
[h1]New Creatures[/h1][list][*]Cobalt Kairuku and Cobalt Griffin.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/a92024b9f988c53a63a99b8b06a0130a3a5cdeaf.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/9aae6e5bc55e9008d18f4c258d35908ab2128327.jpg[/img]
[h1]New Gameplay[/h1] [list][*][b]The Blessing Christmas Tree[/b] - Decorate the Christmas Tree with various decor, and activate the Christmas Blessing buff. The Christmas Tree can be exchanged for Christmas Token at the Christmas Goblin Trade Center. Decorate the tree with Christmas Dolls in five unique colors, and you will be gifted with the Christmas Blessing Buff and Christmas Gift Box, which may contain one or more of the below gifts: Rocking Reindeer, Christmas Painting, and Christmas Curtain.[/list]

Note:
-Christmas Dolls drop from Snowman kill. 
-Christmas Goblin Trade Center will drop from Red-Hat Goblin kill and the Christmas Santa Supply. 
-Christmas Token can be harvested from digging Christmas Blizzard Snow Cube.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/98501877c54eeb393bf3ef7db651cff7de5fceb9.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b]Snowman Fight[/b] - Snowmen will spawn in Noviceland, Grassland, Dawnisland, and Woodland. Players will need to craft Snowballs to attack the Snowmen, to receive their drops: Christmas Candy, Christmas Dolls (50% drop rate), Snowman Model, Snowman Clothing Skins, and Christmas Token.
 [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/eaa8bf8c80316961635c7002cdf1581b9c51e8f9.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b]Red Hat Creatures[/b] - Some dinos will be wearing Christmas Red Hats. Killing them could drop Red Hat (wearable on tames), and Christmas Token.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/f45ac8fabf180e1e6fe51a0ab19659b6fc5bae1b.jpg[/img]	
[list][*][b]Christmas Santa Supply[/b] - Santa will be riding his Reindeer Sleigh to give away Santa Supply, which might contain Christmas Paintings, Christmas Candy, Christmas Fireworks, and more. [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/9887e269fac234fa1ea82ab2db024a46f8bfcb44.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b]Christmas Snowy Biomes[/b] - The majority of the biomes will be enjoying snowy views. During snowy seasons, some biomes might be blessed with specific “Christmas Blizzard”. Explorers digging blizzard snow cubes in Christmas Snowy biomes will have the chance of getting Christmas Tokens, Christmas Blizzard Snow Cube and Christmas Candy.[/list][list][*][b]Double Harvest Rate and Snowman Kill Exp[/b] - Explorers will enjoy double ore-harvest rate and higher exp from Snowman kills. [/list]
[h1]New Items[/h1]
[list][*][b]Christmas Goblin Trade Center[/b] - Drops from Red-Hat Goblins or the Santa Supply. [/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/bd8502b6115a26fa2521ee21b2343930593aece5.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b]Christmas Reindeer Costume[/b] - Exchangeable at the Christmas Goblin Trade Center for 500 Christmas Tokens. [/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/31be07954bc87c20a81deebfff303bd983cc9be7.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b]Christmas Treant Costume[/b] - Exchangeable at the Christmas Goblin Trade Center for 500 Christmas Tokens. [/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/f589476d6586e1691ac3f825a49bc04a4bafc89d.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b]Reindeer Sled Saddle[/b] - Equipping it on the Reindeer allows one player to ride on it and fly across PixARK and Skyward. With a Reindeer Christmas Platform Saddle, players can place a max of 50 structure pieces. The Reindeer Sleigh can be exchanged at the Christmas Goblin Trade Center for 2000 Christmas Tokens.[/list]
                          [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/aa0c6ec98236ea94e80a44903064f2884f9581c2.gif[/img]
[list][*][b]Christmas Hat (2019) Skin[/b] - A new Character-wearable Christmas Hat skin dedicated to celebrating Christmas 2019. It can be exchanged at the Christmas Goblin Trade Center for 200 Christmas Tokens.[/list][list][*][b]Rocking Reindeer[/b] - Has a drop rate of 10% from Christmas Tree Gift Boxes. [/list] [list][*][b]Christmas Paintings[/b] - Has a drop rate of 40% from Christmas Tree Gift Boxes.[/list] [list][*][b]Christmas Curtain[/b] - Has a drop rate of 30% from Christmas Tree Gift Boxes and Santa Supply. [/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/4cf2d1742d11cdd8f410363e95e0e36fa91f79ef.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b]White Creature Dye and Dark Green Creature Dye[/b] -Craftable at the Dye Workbench.[/list] 
[h1]Optimization[/h1]
[list][*]Added a Get Free option at the pause menu, so that when players get stuck at certain locations, they can get unstuck by being teleported to a random spawn point. The Get Free option has a cooldown of 30 minutes, and it can not be used when your characters are engaged in a fight. [/list]
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[b]Breeding[/b]
[list][*]Imprint Stats: imprint Health Points will be buffed from 20% to 40%, and imprint Stamina will be buffed by 20%. 
[*]Mutation levels: offspring will have their max mutation level raised by 30 [/list]

[b]Bone Creatures[/b]
[list]
[*]Bone creatures will now consume Void Energy in order to sprint. 
[*]Bone Griffin and Bone Ghost Dragon now have faster-flying speed.
[*]Bone Carno may fly using Void Energy
[*]Bone Trike’s RMB skill now depends on melee damage and can be used when its Fury is zero. 
[*]Bone creatures now receive 1.5x damage from Cobaltenergy Golem.
[*]Each server will now spawn 10 Bone creatures at the Summoning Altar.
[*]The cost for reviving bone creatures will now depend on the type of bone creature & their level (see below). A success rate is added to the summoning process. If the summoning fails, the material will be used, but the bone creature cube will be kept intact.[/list]

Christmas Santa Supply - Santa will be riding his Reindeer Sleigh to give away Santa Supply, which might contain Christmas Paintings, Christmas Candy, Christmas Fireworks, and more.

Christmas Snowy Biomes - The majority of the biomes will be enjoying snowy views. During snowy seasons, some biomes might be blessed with specific “Christmas Blizzard”. Explorers digging blizzard snow cubes in Christmas Snowy biomes will have the chance of getting Christmas Tokens, Christmas Blizzard Snow Cube and Christmas Candy.
Double Harvest Rate and Snowman Kill Exp - Explorers will enjoy double ore-harvest rate and higher exp from Snowman kills.
Christmas Goblin Trade Center - Drops from Red-Hat Goblins or the Santa Supply.
Christmas Reindeer Costume - Exchangeable at the Christmas Goblin Trade Center for 500 Christmas Tokens.
Christmas Treant Costume - Exchangeable at the Christmas Goblin Trade Center for 500 Christmas Tokens.

Reindeer Sled Saddle - Equipping it on the Reindeer allows one player to ride on it and fly across PixARK and Skyward. With a Reindeer Christmas Platform Saddle, players can place a max of 50 structure pieces. The Reindeer Sleigh can be exchanged at the Christmas Goblin Trade Center for 2000 Christmas Tokens.
Christmas Hat (2019) Skin - A new Character-wearable Christmas Hat skin dedicated to celebrating Christmas 2019. It can be exchanged at the Christmas Goblin Trade Center for 200 Christmas Tokens.
Rocking Reindeer - Has a drop rate of 10% from Christmas Tree Gift Boxes.
Christmas Paintings - Has a drop rate of 40% from Christmas Tree Gift Boxes.
Christmas Curtain - Has a drop rate of 30% from Christmas Tree Gift Boxes and Santa Supply.
White Creature Dye and Dark Green Creature Dye -Craftable at the Dye Workbench.

Added a Get Free option at the pause menu, so that when players get stuck at certain locations, they can get unstuck by being teleported to a random spawn point. The Get Free option has a cooldown of 30 minutes, and it can not be used when your characters are engaged in a fight.

tags.balance_change: Imprint Stats: imprint Health Points will be buffed from 20% to 40%, and imprint Stamina will be buffed by 20%.
Mutation levels: offspring will have their max mutation level raised by 30
Bone creatures will now consume Void Energy in order to sprint.
Bone Griffin and Bone Ghost Dragon now have faster-flying speed.
Bone Carno may fly using Void Energy
Bone Trike’s RMB skill now depends on melee damage and can be used when its Fury is zero.
Bone creatures now receive 1.5x damage from Cobaltenergy Golem.
Each server will now spawn 10 Bone creatures at the Summoning Altar.

The cost for reviving bone creatures will now depend on the type of bone creature & their level (see below). A success rate is added to the summoning process. If the summoning fails, the material will be used, but the bone creature cube will be kept intact.

notes.title: Thanksgiving Update!
notes.content:
Greetings, Explorers!

We would like to extend our gratitude to your love and support for PixARK. We will continue our work on PixARK and bring to you an even better game. Happy Thanksgiving!

The Thanksgiving update is scheduled to go live at 12:00 am PDT on November 22nd. Official Servers will be offline for a few hours.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/003ff92c0583aa572892a88dd8a9da5de667dbca.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Gameplay[/h1]

Since the discovery of Cobalt Ore in Skyward, resulting mutations from the emitting radiation has been observed. Don’t worry, this is something explorers can utilize! 

[list][*]Added Radiation Mutation Platform. Craftable at level 90. Players can place Pixblocked tames into the Platform. Place the required materials to trigger the mutation. The result will be the creature’s mutated counterpart.
[*] Added Cobalenergy Golem. Currently the only mutable tame. We’re looking into expanding the list of mutable tames in later patches. [/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/fe65a72600e3bf5f1bc0d3b5c0c696dd2ae7f74f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Thanksgiving Gameplay[/h1][list]
[*]Thanksgiving Banquet. Place six different Thanksgiving dishes on the Thanksgiving Dining Table, and then press E to enjoy the treat and be rewarded with the Thanksgiving Buff. Placing Roasted Turkey right at the center of the Thanksgiving Dining Table will bring something special to Explorers. 
[*]Pardoned Turkey Event. In the Noviceland biome, Explorers may find wild Turkeys locked in cages. Players will need to break the cage to free the Turkeys. Once they are freed, Turkeys will drop Turkey eggs that provide rewards. While freeing the caged Turkeys, explorers have a 10% chance of running into special Pardoned Turkey, which can take players up in the sky once tamed. [/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/cb97d59bff514a9570f70d7b1e705c7ce73cf243.jpg[/img]

[h1]Thanksgiving Creatures[/h1][list]
[*]Pardoned Turkey. While freeing the caged Turkeys, explorers have a 10% chance of running into special Pardoned Turkey, which can take players up in the sky once tamed. [/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/1368cfe638896d9bb641870e5d5b32b71dc0d9d3.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Items[/h1][list]
[*]Thanksgiving Decor: Thanksgiving Dining Table, Thanksgiving Chair, Thanksgiving Recliner, Thanksgiving Curtain, Thanksgiving Decor Balloon, and Thanksgiving Wall Decor. All of which may drop from the Supply Beam and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event.   
[*]Thanksgiving Dishes: Roasted Turkey, Pumpkin Pie, Beef Wellington, Salad, Brownie, Sweet Potato. All of which may drop from the Supply Beam and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event.   
[*]Thanksgiving Equipment Skin: Turkey Hat. Drop from the Supply Beam and the Turkey Egg rewards from Pardoned Turkey Event.   [/list]
[h1]Functional structures[/h1]
[list][*]Alien Crop Plot: craftable at level 90 in the Industrial Skill Engram. It is used to plant Cobalt Berries. Cobalt Berry Seed can only be harvested with Cobaltstar Beetle from bushes in Cobalt biomes.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/51610f23329c15bbb3a8672647fdf6731cca8c49.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/a6a21a59fd1058b432494342d13ce1dcd027bd48.png[/img]

[h1]Balancing and Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]The Ancient Wyvern King and the Poison Wyvern will do 50% of their poisoning effect on Cobaltstar robotic creatures. 
[*]Cobaltenergy Golem: Iron Fist skill attack will have longer cast animation and effect area indication. Once cast, the first round of damage will be effective immediately. The second round of damage will be effective 5 seconds later if it is not interrupted by Light magic.  
[*] Optimized how tames are released from tame Pixblocks to reduce tame loss. 
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list] 
[*] Fixed an issue where Tek Cloning Chamber incorrectly cloned tames’ stats. 
[*] Fixed an issue where in some cases, the Cobaltstar Spaceship Challenge can be taken unlimited times. 
[*] Fixed an issue where blueprints placed in the Hotbar might get lost upon character death. 
[*] Fixed an issue where in some cases dropped items could not be retrieved. 
[/list]



Be sure to report bugs
[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSftwSjr9FShosX8xvNEug1J_sCcPVqrgckqE0i39WhqWuROMw/viewform]here.[/url]

notes.title: PixARK Halloween Patch 1.73
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Explorers![/h1]
Halloween is just around the corner, and our next PixARK Halloween update is scheduled to go live around 12:00 am PDT on October 26. Official Servers will be offline for a few hours.

First, let’s take a peek at the Halloween main menu screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/f07eee4fa9549992c1a2dfbcdbbcce129f1e6b97.png[/img]

[h1]New Dungeon/Challenge[/h1]
To start the Ancient Wyvern King challenge, players will need to Summon an Ancient Wyvern King Challenge Gate and be teleported to where the Wyvern King resides. 

The Challenge Gate can be summoned in the Inscription Book when you put in Dark Magic Stone, Water Magic Stone, Wind Magic Stone, Thunder Magic Stone, Fire Magic Stone, Light Magic Stone, and Earth Magic Stone. You have the chance to produce one of the three different Challenge Gates once the summoning is done. Each of the three Challenge Gate has its own color, size, and summoning rate. The numbers of players and tames allowed to be teleported through these Challenge Gates also vary. 

Once the Challenge Gate is summoned, the dungeon challenge is not activated yet. Players will need to obtain Energy Stone, craftable in the Alchemy Stove, and place them on the Challenge Gate to initiate the portal to the Ancient Wyvern King. If you want to challenge the Ancient Wyvern King for another time, you will have to place Energy Stone to create the portal again. 

Out of the three Ancient Gate, only one can be activated via the Teleportation Platform at a time. A cooldown of 24 hours will be attached to players who have taken on an Ancient Wyvern King challenge. 
[list]
[*]Challenge Gate (Blue): summoning rate is 70%; teleport up to 5 players and 5 tames
[*]Challenge Gate (Green): summoning rate is 25%; teleport up to 10 players and 10 tames
[*]Challenge Gate (Purple): summoning rate is 5%; teleport up to 15 players and 15 tames
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/54bcc0a83669b71c421e667c0aa427e79342d947.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Boss -  Ancient Wyvern King[/h1]
The Ancient Wyvern drops Wyvern Armor (Wyvern Head Armor, Wyvern Claw Armor, Wyvern Body  Armor, and Wyvern Wing Armor, equitable on Fire Wyvern, Lightning Wyvern, and Poison Wyvern.) It also drops Magic Broom.  
[list]
[*]Wyvern Head Armor: reduces damage by 15%; drop rate is 10%
[*]Wyvern Claw Armor: reduces damage by 10%; drop rate is 25%
[*]Wyvern Body  Armor: reduces damage by 15%; drop rate is 40%
[*]Wyvern Wing Armor: reduces damage by 10%; drop rate is 20%
[*]Magic Broom: drop rate is 5%
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/ababecd64fc0700a882fa5017ad15326df6c80e6.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Halloween Creature - Pumpkin Soul Reaper [/h1]
Pumpkin Soul Reaper can be found in these biomes: PixARK - Novice Grassland and Grassland; SkyARK - Dawn Island, Woodland, and Void.

They drop Pumpkin Seed, Limited-Time Magic Broom (spoils in 7 days), and Clown Costume Blueprint.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/4fd58e8df4e291dbbe16fcf035bbc7d2ea629be1.gif[/img]

[h1]New Engram and Items[/h1]
[b]Limited-Time Magic Broom (Halloween-only):[/b] drops from Pumpkin Soul Reaper; includes a spoil timer and disappears once the timer is up. 

[b]Magic Broom:[/b] drops from Ancient Wyvern King.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/16e9f2d077f276afb7c50b1dbaef02c66fbd3688.jpg[/img]

[b]Halloween Decor:[/b] Halloween Trees, Halloween Gravestone, Pumpkin Candle, and Halloween Wall Decor: obtainable from Clown Supply Beam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/83f5209a5e9f9b4b7de0201652fdf2b3456da6d6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/cea4745a0b40e43fdbb37fc4289d82edf3378306.jpg[/img]

[b]Halloween Clown Costume:[/b] Craftable at the Tailor’s Workbench, but first players will need to obtain Clown Costume blueprints from the Pumpkin Soul Reaper. They will need to obtain Pumpkin Seed from Pumpkin Soul Reaper to grow Pumpkin, which is used as a crafting material for Halloween Costume. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/14311252bbb8ed627108bbe7eea0081d22d2dc5a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/812c0ba3c90cff4cce0daddd3d73bd74461434db.png[/img]

tags.feature: To start the Ancient Wyvern King challenge, players will need to Summon an Ancient Wyvern King Challenge Gate and be teleported to where the Wyvern King resides.

The Challenge Gate can be summoned in the Inscription Book when you put in Dark Magic Stone, Water Magic Stone, Wind Magic Stone, Thunder Magic Stone, Fire Magic Stone, Light Magic Stone, and Earth Magic Stone.
You have the chance to produce one of the three different Challenge Gates once the summoning is done.
Each of the three Challenge Gate has its own color, size, and summoning rate.
The numbers of players and tames allowed to be teleported through these Challenge Gates also vary.
Once the Challenge Gate is summoned, the dungeon challenge is not activated yet.
Players will need to obtain Energy Stone, craftable in the Alchemy Stove, and place them on the Challenge Gate to initiate the portal to the Ancient Wyvern King.
If you want to challenge the Ancient Wyvern King for another time, you will have to place Energy Stone to create the portal again.
Out of the three Ancient Gate, only one can be activated via the Teleportation Platform at a time.
A cooldown of 24 hours will be attached to players who have taken on an Ancient Wyvern King challenge.
The Ancient Wyvern drops Wyvern Armor (Wyvern Head Armor, Wyvern Claw Armor, Wyvern Body Armor, and Wyvern Wing Armor, equitable on Fire Wyvern, Lightning Wyvern, and Poison Wyvern.)
It also drops Magic Broom.
Pumpkin Soul Reaper can be found in these biomes: PixARK - Novice Grassland and Grassland; SkyARK - Dawn Island, Woodland, and Void.
They drop Pumpkin Seed, Limited-Time Magic Broom (spoils in 7 days), and Clown Costume Blueprint.
Limited-Time Magic Broom (Halloween-only): drops from Pumpkin Soul Reaper; includes a spoil timer and disappears once the timer is up.
Magic Broom: drops from Ancient Wyvern King.

Halloween Clown Costume: Craftable at the Tailor’s Workbench, but first players will need to obtain Clown Costume blueprints from the Pumpkin Soul Reaper.
They will need to obtain Pumpkin Seed from Pumpkin Soul Reaper to grow Pumpkin, which is used as a crafting material for Halloween Costume.
Halloween Candy Grenade: Throw various Halloween Candy Grenade at other players to turn them into characters wearing various Halloween Masks for ten minutes.
Halloween Candy Grenade can be obtained from the Clown Supply Beam.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31873084/142a28b5081786f9e400d5856922a6dbf1320013.png[/img]

Greetings, Explorers!

The next PixARK update is scheduled to go live at 2:00 am PDT on September 29. Official Servers will be offline for a few hours or less.


[h1]New Items[/h1]
Added Obelisk Chamber Portal (aka ARK Lab Portal), which will randomly spawn in all Skyward biomes at noon server time every day. The Portals will last for 12 hours before they despawn and they will respawn at another random location at noon the next day. The requirement for accessing the ARK Lab Portal to start the dungeon challenge is the same as initiating it via the three Obelisk terminals. 


[h1]Balancing and Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Servers no longer share a unanimous cooldown on Obelisk Chamber dungeon challenge and Cobaltstar UFO dungeon Challenge. Instead, the cooldown will be labeled in each individual player, meaning as long as the player enters the dungeon/challenge, the cooldown will be effective upon that player, and the player won’t be able to enter the dungeon/challenge again until the cooldown is over. 
[*] Resource stored in Tek Storage Box can now be recognized by workbenches when players want to craft items in them. 
[*] The amount of available slots in the Tek Feeding Trough is increased to 150. 
[*] Increased the damage Rocket Propelled Grenade, Fire-type Rocket Launcher Grenade, Ice-type Rocket Launcher Grenade, and Poison-type Rocket Launcher Grenade do on Tek Forcefield.
[*] Increased the damage Tek Grenade does on Auto Turret.
[*] Tek Grenade could no longer be automatically intercepted by the Auto Turret

[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list] 
[*] Fixed an issue wherein some cases wearing Tek Chestpiece would grant players the ability to utilize Tek Chestpiece’s flying mode without consuming Tek Energy Cube.
[*] Fixed an issue wherein some cases wearing the Tek Gloves would allow the players to get stuck in the flying mode and never land. 
[*] Fixed an issue wherein some cases holding the Tek Shield once would allow the players to no longer receive damage from attackers’ ranged weapon without the need to constantly holding the Tek Shield. 
[*] Fixed an issue where some tames could not use the Tek Feeding Trough to get feed.
[*] Fixed an issue where Pixblocked bone dinos did not show up in the Pixblock Container. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the Central Control Unit that is powered by a Tek Generator would not function as designed. 
[/list]



Be sure to report bugs [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSftwSjr9FShosX8xvNEug1J_sCcPVqrgckqE0i39WhqWuROMw/viewform]here.[/url]

notes.title: PixARK Patch 1.65
notes.content:
Greetings, Explorers!

The next PixARK update is scheduled to go live at 2:00 am PDT on September 5. Official Servers will be offline for a few hours or less.


[h1]Balancing and Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added the number of slots in the Tek Replicator to 150. 
[*] Allowed Tek equipment to be repaired by the Plier.
[*] Reduced the cost of Tek Energy Cube on using the special skills with Tek Chestpiece, Tek Gloves and Tek Legging.
[*] Added Cobalt Organics to the Cobalt enemy’s drop table. 
[*] Added the Transfer Gate that will teleport challengers out of the Cobaltstar UFO Challenge.
[*] Allowed Automatic Miner to mine Cobalt Ore.
[*] Added the amount of Tek Energy Cube looted from Obelisk Chamber boss kill and Cobaltstar UFO boss kill.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Tek Light could not be picked up. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the Tek Ceiling engram could not be learned. 
[*] Fixed an issue where demolishing Tek structures would not return the material. 
[*] Fixed an issue where some items could not be transferred across servers. 
[/list]

[h1]Cobaltstar UFO Challenge Information[/h1]
• It has come to our attention that some players are ready to face the Cobaltstar UFO challenge, and here is some useful information for the daring challengers. 
• To access the UFO, explorers will need to obtain the Alien Challenge Transfer Gate Blueprint, which can be looted from Obelisk Chamber challenge, difficult. 
• Ultimate Boss: Cobaltstar Subject, a gigantic war machine with overarching power that can destroy everything. It takes explorers joint effort to defeat it. 
• Serial Boss Challenge:  explorers need to defeat four bosses in subsequent order. 
[list]
[*] Cooldown: 16 hours
[*] Challenge Time: 100 minutes
[*] Max tames allowed:  15
[*] Lowest required character level: 90
[*] Max player allowed in the same tribe: 15
[*] How to activate: craft and place a UFO Portal, and place 30 Tek Energy Cube plus 100 Cobalt Ingot in it. 
[*] Boss 1: Cobaltenergy Golem Fist, which drops Tek Helmet Blueprint, Tek Light Blueprint, Tek Generator Blueprint, 80 Tek Energy Cube (100% drop rate)
[*] Boss 2: Cobaltenergy Golem Fire, which drops Tek Rifle Blueprint, Tek Megalodon Saddle 
[*] Blueprint, Giant Tek Beast Gate Blueprint, 100 Tek Energy Cube (100% drop rate) 
[*] Boss 3: Cobaltenergy Golem Hammer, which drops Tek Sleeping Pod Blueprint, Tek Cloning Chamber, Tek Tapejara Saddle Blueprint, Tek Megarock Dragon Saddle Blueprint, and 100 Tek Energy Cube (100% drop rate)
[*] Boss 4: Cobaltstar Subject, which drops Tek Portal Blueprint, Tek Turret Blueprint, Tek Forcefield Blueprint, Tek T-Rex Saddle Blueprint, 120 Tek Energy Cube (100% drop rate)
[/list]

Be sure to report bugs [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSftwSjr9FShosX8xvNEug1J_sCcPVqrgckqE0i39WhqWuROMw/viewform]here.[/url]

notes.title: PixARK Patch 1.61
notes.content:
Greetings, Explorers!

The next PixARK update is scheduled to go live at 1:00 am PDT on August 23.

[h1]Balancing and Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Optimized some tooltip and UI descriptions.
[*] Balanced the Magic Power Armor set.
     Magic Power Helmet now provides 10 Hyperthermic Insulation and 50 Radiation Insulation.
     Magic Power Shirt now provides 30 Hyperthermic Insulation and 80 Radiation Insulation.
     Magic Power Gloves now provides 10 Hyperthermic Insulation and 50 Radiation Insulation.
     Magic Power Pants now provides 20 Hyperthermic Insulation and 70 Radiation Insulation.
     Magic Power Boots now provides 10 Hyperthermic Insulation and 40 Radiation Insulation.
[*] Increased the tame limit per tribe to 60.
[*] Balanced the material required for crafting Cobalt Tranquilizer Dart.
[*] Balanced the crafting speed of Polymer in Kairuku Dish.
[*] Increased the drop amount of Cobalt Organics.
[*] Reduced the amount of Cobalt Organics required in crafting Cobalt Battery.
[*] Increased the amount of Food Wyvern Milk provides.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where releasing a Pixblocked tame would incur a cooldown.
[*] Fixed an issue where, in Creator Mode, characters riding Cobalt tames did not have the correct animation.
[*] Fixed an issue where transferring character across servers might cause the client to crash.
[*] Fixed an issue where loading the Skyward DLC map might cause the client to crash.
[*] Fixed an issue where Alien Equip Cube and Alien Structure Cube were showing spoil time.
[*] Fixed an issue where health generation was incorrect for Bone Ghost Wyvern.
[*] Fixed an issue where wild creatures did not die if they fell off the edge of an island and onto the lower clouds.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Acceleration Buff was not showing correctly when flying across the Void between islands at a height between 0 to 40 cubes. 
[*] Fixed an issue where Small Patrol did not drop the correct loot.
[*] Fixed an issue where baby tame could be turn into a Pixblock.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Rock Drake Saddle could not be crafted.
[*] Fixed an issue where Oriental Foundation could not show up correctly when placed. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the whistle "Attack this target" was not working when its hotkey was changed to Q.
[/list]

[b]NOTE[/b]: 

We are aware of the item loss issues occurring during server transfers. At this time, we recommend that players do not transfer items, especially crafted items. We are working on a hotfix and we hope to push it out as soon as possible. We apologize for any inconvenience! We appreciate your patience in this matter.

We are also aware of the issue with the Rock Drake where the second rider mounted on the back seat of the Rock Drake Saddle would be forced to respawn and lose the inventory when the Rock Drake uses its invisibility skill.
